hindi: ऐसे अक्सर केसेस होते हैं शनि का दोष होता है भयंकर
says: Opening claim of the preview clips: sudden, severe trouble that surfaces without warning is often a case of a heavy Saturn affliction (shani dosha). Health outcomes are only the setting here; recorded as his claim, not as a diagnosis rule.
cells_derived_method: He gives no house or sign split. By classical logic Saturn's affliction is heaviest in the dusthana houses (6, 8, 12) or in its debilitation sign Aries, and lighter in own or exalted signs (Capricorn, Aquarius, Libra).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 8th house (lagna Virgo) is the strongest 'hidden, slow-surfacing trouble' placement in this scheme.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) is a dignified placement, so the 'severe dosha' reading would be weak here.

ambiguity: 'दोष' may mean a natal affliction or a running dasha/transit effect; he does not say which.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Saturn as karaka of chronic, slow-building troubles; the wording that the dosha makes illness invisible is not classical.

gist: Anecdote of a person whose tests three days earlier were clear and who is now reported with a fourth-stage serious illness.
Rhetorical question: why was it not detected in the first, second or third stage?

hindi: वो डिटेक्ट नहीं होने देता अगर ऐसी कोई दिक्कत हो तो अच्छे खासे जोशी डिटेक्ट नहीं कर पाते
says: Answers his own question: the afflicting planet (Saturn in this context) does not allow the problem to be detected, and when this kind of trouble is running even competent astrologers fail to spot it in the chart. Medical-flavoured claim, recorded only as what he said.
cells_derived_method: none - the claim is about a concealing nature of the planet; no house or sign split is given.
ambiguity: The subject of 'वो' is not named in this sentence; Saturn is inferred from the previous and next sentences.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says Saturn or any planet blocks detection of illness; hidden/chronic ailment as Saturn karakatwa is classical.

hindi: तेरी प्रॉब्लम क्या है प्रॉब्लम दिखने नहीं देता पर्दा केतु और शनि
says: Names the two 'curtain' planets: Ketu and Saturn hide the real problem from view, so it does not show up in reports or in the astrologer's reading.
cells_derived_method: none - he does not tie the curtain effect to any house or sign.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means Ketu and Saturn together (conjunction/aspect) or either one alone.
classical_check: Ketu and Saturn as obscuring, hidden-matter planets agree with classical karakatwa; the 'curtain on diagnosis' idea is his own.

hindi: शनि अंधकार वो पर्दा डाल देता है बंदे की किस्मत पे कि ज्योतिष भी नहीं देख पाता
says: Saturn is darkness (andhakar); he draws a veil over the native's destiny so thickly that even astrology cannot see through it.
cells_derived_method: none - a planet-nature statement with no house or sign condition.
classical_check: Saturn as darkness/shadow significator is classical (son of the Sun, chhaya putra); the veil-over-fate idiom is his.

gist: Says not finding the problem adds tension, but one must not lose courage.
Garbled fragment 'क्योंकि ग्रह कर र', cannot be read.

hindi: इसलिए हम कहते हैं कंपैरिजन मत करो आपका ब्रेन वक्री चलेगा
says: Links a mental habit to retrograde motion: do not compare yourself with others, because comparing makes your own brain run retrograde (backward-looking).
cells_derived_method: none - behavioural advice, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'Retrograde brain' is used loosely for backward-looking thinking; it is not a chart factor by itself.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text connects social comparison with retrograde motion.

hindi: जैसे ही वक्री चलेगा आपकी जन्म कुंडली में जो ग्रह वक्री है वो पावर पकड़ लेगा और जहां वो बैठा है वहां की दिक्कत देगा
says: Core rule of the lecture: once the mind goes retrograde, whichever planet is retrograde in the birth chart takes power and then produces trouble in the house where it sits.
cells_derived_method: The trouble lands on the topics of the house the retrograde planet occupies, coloured by the planet's nature and the nature of the sign it is in. He gives no house-by-house table here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra; a retrograde Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th would put the backward pull on marriage and partnerships (delay, re-opening of old ties).
Derived: lagna Virgo; a retrograde Jupiter in Gemini in the 10th would pull career back toward earlier fields or force repeated restarts.
Derived: lagna Scorpio; a retrograde Mercury in Sagittarius in the 2nd would show as speech and money matters needing revisions or being revisited.

ambiguity: Does not say whether 'power' means strength (as classical cheshta bala) or malefic intensity; he uses it in the second sense.
classical_check: Classical texts (Saravali, Phaladeepika) say a retrograde planet has full cheshta bala and gives strong results; 'gains power' agrees, but his negative framing is partly his own.

hindi: अगर मान लो आपका कोई ग्रह मान लेते हैं मंगल वक्री बैठा चौथे घर के अंदर और आपने बैक बैक पीछे की ओर जाना शुरू कर दिया अपने भाई दोस्त मित्र परिवार घर के बारे में सोचकर
says: Worked example: with retrograde Mars in the 4th house, if you start mentally going backward (dwelling on brother, friends, family and home), the retrograde Mars is activated and hits exactly those matters.
cells_derived_method: Mars retrograde in the 4th harms 4th-house topics (home, mother, property, peace of mind); how it shows depends on the sign Mars is in and on which lagna makes the 4th that sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn; Mars (lord of 4th and 11th) retrograde in own sign Aries in the 4th - old home or property issues reopen, but the planet is dignified.
Derived: lagna Aries; Mars (lagna lord) retrograde in debilitation sign Cancer in the 4th - strained peace of mind at home, old family hurts resurface.
Derived: lagna Libra; Mars retrograde and exalted in Capricorn in the 4th - strong but also the classic mangal-dosha 4th position, so the backward pull shows in domestic harmony.

ambiguity: He lists brother with the 4th-house topics, but brothers are the 3rd house; here it follows Mars as karaka of brothers.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of brothers and Mars in the 4th as a mangal-dosha position are classical; reading retro Mars as 'going backward on those topics' is his own.

hindi: चौथा घर दोस्त का है मां का है प्र का जायदाद का है मित्रों का है उनके बारे में बैक चले गए मंगल का
says: Gives his list of 4th-house topics: friends, mother, property or estate (the caption fragment 'प्र का' most likely means property), and adds that retrograde Mars has taken you backward on all of them.
cells_derived_method: The same 4th-house topics read differently by the sign that falls on the 4th: an earth sign points to land and assets, a water sign to mother and emotions, a fire sign to pride and family conflict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; 4th house in Venus's sign Taurus, so retrograde Mars here hits land, vehicles and mother's comfort through possession disputes.
Derived: lagna Taurus; 4th house in the Sun's sign Leo, so old family quarrels with relatives and mother's side revive with ego involved.
Derived: lagna Leo; Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 4th as lord of 4th and 9th - the pull is strongest on inheritance and property, yet the planet is dignified.

ambiguity: Caption fragment 'प्र का' is garbled; read as property from the neighbouring word जायदाद.
classical_check: Mother, friends (as comforts), home and property under the 4th agree with BPHS; friends are more often 11th, so 'friends' under the 4th is his emphasis.

hindi: वक्री ग्रह पावर पकड़ लेगा यह वक्री जो ग्रह है यह आपकी लाइफ को पीछे खींचता है
says: Restates that a retrograde planet 'takes power' and adds what that power does: it drags the native's life backward (setbacks, regressions, returning to old matters).
cells_derived_method: none - general statement about retrograde planets, no house or sign split.
ambiguity: The first half repeats the previous sentence of the preview; only the 'pulls life backward' part is new.
classical_check: Classical texts read retrograde as strength, not as a backward pull; the 'backward' reading is a modern teacher's interpretation.

hindi: मान लेते हैं आपकी जन्म पत्रिका में दो ग्रह वक्री है मान लो मंगल है और शनि है अगर य वक्री है तोय अपने अपने कुंडली के फलादेश के अनुसार आपकी लाइफ में धमाल मचाए रखेंगे
says: If two planets are retrograde in a birth chart (his example Mars and Saturn), each will keep creating turmoil in life according to what it signifies in that particular chart, meaning its house, lordship and sign.
cells_derived_method: The turmoil of each retrograde planet follows its own house position, lordship and sign dignity; two retrograde planets act separately and add up.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini; Mars retrograde in own sign Scorpio in the 6th (lord of 6th and 11th) - turmoil through enemies, debts and repeated reopening of conflicts at work.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Saturn (lagna lord) retrograde and exalted in Libra in the 10th - turmoil as career pressure and repeated restarts, though the planet is strong.
Derived: lagna Cancer; Saturn retrograde in own sign Aquarius in the 8th (lord of 7th and 8th) - sudden reversals in partnerships and hidden matters.

ambiguity: Mars and Saturn are only an example; he does not say they are specially bad when retrograde together.
classical_check: Classically each planet's results follow house and lordship, which agrees; calling the result 'dhamaal' (turmoil) is his idiom.

hindi: तो पहला तो सीधा साही प्रिंसिपल है अगर ग्रह वक्री है तो भैया उसका उपाय कर लो
says: First and simplest principle he gives: if a planet is retrograde in your chart, do its remedy (upaya).
cells_derived_method: none - applies to any retrograde planet in any house or sign; the specific remedy is not named.
ambiguity: The remedy itself (mantra, donation, gem) is not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Remedies for planets are traditional, but classical texts do not say every retrograde planet needs one; it is his teaching rule.

hindi: आपके अंदर एक वाक सिद्धि डेवलप हो सकती है आपके अंदर वो शक्ति डेवलप हो सकती है कि सारी दुनिया कहेगी अरे नीलम मत पहनाओ आपके कहने से सूट करेगा ऐसी विचित्र सी बात होगी
says: Claimed benefit of doing the remedy: speech-power (vaak siddhi) can develop in you, so strong that even when the whole world says do not make someone wear a blue sapphire (neelam, Saturn's gem), it will suit the person because you said so. Gemstone advice is a tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign condition is given for the power or for the gem.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled; 'you' may be the person doing the remedy or the astrologer who prescribes. Saturn is inferred from neelam.
classical_check: Classical texts warn that neelam must be tested before wearing; the idea that the speaker's word makes it suit is not classical.

gist: Points to powder-packet babas and jhaada-style healers who seem to cure people.

hindi: केतु की कृपा से झाड़ा लगके ठीक होंगे आप पुड़िया खाके ठीक होंगे असंभव है जब तक आपका वो सेट नहीं होगा केतु की कृपा नहीं मिलेगी आप झाड़े से ठीक नहीं होंगे
says: Folk cures (jhaada, charmed powder) work only through Ketu's grace; unless your Ketu is set right you will not be healed by them, which he calls impossible. Health-related claim, recorded as stated and not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: none - the dependence on Ketu is stated without house or sign conditions.
ambiguity: 'वो सेट' is garbled; read as 'your Ketu is set (favourable or remedied)'.
classical_check: Ketu as karaka of occult, tantra and unexplained healing is classical; the claim that folk cures need Ketu's grace is his own.

hindi: और केतु ही अगर रिस्पांसिबल है तो वो झाड़े से ही ठीक कराएगा
says: If Ketu is the planet responsible for a trouble, the trouble will be cured only through a jhaada-type (occult or folk) route and not through ordinary means. Health-related, recorded as stated.
cells_derived_method: Ketu is 'responsible' by sitting in a house tied to the trouble (6, 8, 12 or with the Moon or lagna lord); the type of trouble follows that house and the sign it is in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries; Ketu in the 8th in Scorpio - hidden or unexplained trouble, the typical place where his 'occult cure only' idea would be applied.
Derived: lagna Capricorn; Ketu in the 12th in Sagittarius - isolation, loss or hospital-type themes with a spiritual remedy suggested.

ambiguity: He does not say how to decide that Ketu is responsible.
classical_check: Silent on jhaada as a cure; Ketu with 8th/12th for hidden and occult matters is classical.

gist: Mentions people's belief that black magic (tantra-mantra) has been done on them.

hindi: चंद्रमा अब आपका दूषित है यह नेगेटिव हो गया अब आपको स्किन की प्रॉब्लम देगा
says: An afflicted (dushit) Moon turns negative and gives skin trouble. Health-related karaka claim, recorded as stated and not as a diagnosis rule.
cells_derived_method: How strongly the Moon is afflicted depends on its sign dignity (Scorpio worst, Taurus best) and on the house; trouble topics move with the house it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Scorpio; Moon debilitated in the lagna - the body-level affliction themes (skin, sensitivity) would be most visible here.
Derived: lagna Leo; Moon (lord of the 12th) in Capricorn in the 6th - affliction through Saturn's sign in the disease house, so recurring sensitivity themes.
Derived: lagna Libra; Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th - the Moon is dignified, so the 'afflicted Moon' result would need another afflictor before it applies.

ambiguity: 'दूषित' is not defined here (conjunction with Saturn/Rahu, debilitation, or dusthana placement are all possible).
classical_check: Moon as a significator of skin moisture and body fluids appears in classical lists; the specific link to skin problems is his emphasis.

hindi: डब्ल्यूबीसी कम करेगा बॉडी के अंदर लिंफोसाइट्स कम हो जाएंगे आपके इस्नोफिलिया नाम की तकलीफ आपको देगा
says: An afflicted Moon is said to lower white-blood-cell count and lymphocytes and to bring a condition he calls eosinophilia. Medical-sounding blood-count claim; only recorded that he said it, not usable as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign split is given for these body-count effects.
ambiguity: Eosinophilia means raised eosinophils while he says lymphocytes fall; the subject planet is inferred as the Moon from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no blood-count terms; Moon as karaka of body fluids is the nearest classical link.

hindi: आईजी लेवल होता है जो एलर्जी की प्रॉब्लम वो बॉडी के अंदर बढ़ जाएगी
says: With the Moon afflicted the body's IgE level, the marker he ties to allergy, rises so that allergic tendency increases. Medical-sounding claim, recorded as stated only.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'आईजी' is read as IgE from the allergy context; the planet is carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; allergy is a modern concept.

hindi: आपकी सिर्फ होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन से ठीक हो सकते हैं क्योंकि चंद्रमा यही है
says: Such Moon-linked conditions can be set right only by homeopathic medicine, because homeopathy belongs to the Moon (Moon = homeopathy). Treatment claim, recorded not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: none - a karaka assignment without house or sign conditions.
ambiguity: 'सिर्फ' (only) is strong and may be rhetorical emphasis.
classical_check: Classical karakatwa gives the Moon fluids, mind and gentle medicines; homeopathy post-dates the classical texts, so this assignment is a modern extension.

hindi: लेकिन क्योंकि चंद्रमा खराब है तो होम्योपैथी सूट कर जाए के लिए भी आपके उपाय चाहिए नहीं तो होम्योपैथी भी काम नहीं करेगी
says: Because the Moon itself is bad in the chart, even homeopathy will not work or suit unless you also do Moon remedies first. Health and remedy claim, recorded not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign condition given.
ambiguity: The specific Moon remedies are not named here.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie the success of a treatment to prior planetary remedies.

hindi: इसी के दम प हड्डियां ठीक होंगी
says: Says that by the strength of 'this one' bones will heal; from the surrounding Moon talk the referent is probably the Moon, but the referent is not certain. Health-related, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign split given.
ambiguity: Referent of 'इसी' is not named; bones are classically Saturn/Sun, so the Moon reading may be wrong.
classical_check: Differs if the Moon is meant: classical karakatwa gives bones to Saturn and the Sun, not the Moon.

hindi: यही आपके लिवर से खुजली पैदा कराता है
says: The same planet (the Moon by context) is blamed for producing itching that comes via the liver. Health-related, recorded only as what he said.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: Referent of 'यही' is unnamed; the liver is classically Jupiter's, so the Moon reading is uncertain.
classical_check: Differs if the Moon is meant: classical texts assign the liver to Jupiter.

hindi: इसी के पास लिंफ है बलड सारी बॉडी के वाइट ब्लड जिसमें आरबीसी दौड़ता है उसको स्पॉइल कर देगा
says: The Moon governs lymph and the body's fluid medium (he calls it the white blood in which red cells run); a spoiled Moon damages that fluid system. Health-related, recorded as stated.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign split given.
ambiguity: 'वाइट ब्लड' likely means plasma-like fluid; caption is noisy and the subject may be Moon only by inference.
classical_check: Moon as karaka of body fluids, lymph and blood-water agrees with classical karakatwa.

hindi: इसका वैसे उपाय होता है शमशान का पानी घर में रखना होता [संगीत] है
says: Remedy offered for the afflicted Moon: keep water from a cremation ground (shamshan) at home. Ritual remedy, a tradition claim and not an endorsement.
cells_derived_method: none - the remedy is not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: 'इसका' is taken to mean the Moon problem from context; the music tag splits the sentence.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; usual Moon remedies are milk, white items and Shiva worship. Cremation-ground water is a folk or tantric practice.

gist: Music marks the end of the preview montage before the real lecture starts.
Greeting and thanks to everyone for joining.
Says classes are running and calls Jyotish a very wonderful subject.
Announces today's topic: retrograde (vakri) planets, what vakri means.
Says everyone is so eager that they want a formula today with which to do a miracle.
Wish to say something to someone so strongly that the person exclaims it was amazing.
Says this fire for doing a miracle will keep burning in the mind again and again.
Says that for a miracle one first needs to understand how one is connected to God.
Says scholarship or learning is useless without real knowledge (gyan).
Says that if you have knowledge then it will be implemented.
Example of a person who knows the share market yet invests and loses money, used to show knowing is not the same as wisdom; no investment advice given.
Says knowledge (gyan) and scholarship are two different things.

hindi: यह भी हमारे ग्रह ही हम पर प्रेशर डालते हैं कि बेटा पढ़ लिख तो जा लेकिन ज्ञानी नहीं बनने दूंगा
says: Claims the planets themselves press on us so that one may become educated but is not allowed to become wise (gyani). A general planetary-influence claim; no planet or house is named.
cells_derived_method: He names no house or sign. By classical topics learning sits in the 4th and 5th with Mercury, wisdom in the 5th and 9th with Jupiter, so an affliction splitting the two would show as a strong 4th/5th but a damaged 9th or Jupiter - derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius; 5th house in Mercury's sign Gemini - good schooling and cleverness, which is the 'educated but not wise' side if the 9th is weak.
Derived: lagna Cancer; 9th house in Jupiter's sign Pisces - wisdom house; an afflicting planet here would be the block on becoming gyani.

ambiguity: Which planets or houses cause this is not stated; the reading is chart-wide.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule says planets let one become learned but not wise; learning and wisdom houses are classical.

hindi: ज्ञानी का अर्थ यह हुआ कई बार ज्ञानी ऐसे ही कुछ भी बक देता है और काम हो गया जिसे कहो कि वाक सिद्धि हो गई मुंह में
says: Defines the wise person (gyani) by an example: he casually says something and it simply happens; this is what is called vaak siddhi, speech-power in the mouth.
cells_derived_method: none from him; he ties vaak siddhi to no house or sign here (classically the 2nd house, its lord and Mercury or Jupiter govern speech, but that is not derived further).
ambiguity: The sentence continues across the 3:05 and 4:02 caption chunks.
classical_check: Vaak siddhi as spoken words coming true is a recognised yogic and astrological idea; the 2nd house as the speech house is classical.

hindi: और वो इतना जबरदस्त कॉन्फिडेंस होता है कि जैसे वह नहीं कोई देवता बोल रहा हो कोई पराशक्ति कोई बाहर से आई हुई शक्ति उसके अंदर से बोल रही है
says: Describes how vaak siddhi appears: the speaker has such strong confidence that it seems not him but a deity or a higher external power (para-shakti) is speaking through him.
cells_derived_method: none - descriptive, with no house or sign condition.
classical_check: Silent as an astrological rule; consistent with the yogic idea of vak siddhi.

gist: Says the real aim is not just to learn astrology but to connect with the unknown powerful universe.
Spiritual talk that God is already connected to us and is breathing through us.
Says every spiritual practice has one centre, the breath: meditate and connect with the breath, which means connecting with God.
Says connecting via human consciousness removes the hurry for two quick formulae and instant magic, which will not happen.

hindi: क्योंकि ग्रह लगातार आपको खींच रहे हैं हमारे शरीर में लगातार अंतरिक्ष में गोल गोल घूमने वाले ग्रह खूब अटैक मोड प काम कर रहे हैं
says: Gives the reason there are no shortcuts: the planets revolving in space continuously pull at us and act on our body in 'attack mode'.
cells_derived_method: none - a general statement about planetary influence, with no house or sign split.
ambiguity: 'Attack mode' is figurative; he does not say which planets or how.
classical_check: Planetary influence on the body is a basic assumption of Jyotish; the 'attack mode' wording is his.

hindi: ये सूर्य चंद्र मंगल बुध बृहस्पति फलाना ढिमरा ऐसे ऐसे ग्रह चलते हैं
says: Sets up a parallel: the planets named in order (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and the rest) move in the sky like this, and a matching set is then described inside the human body.
cells_derived_method: none - only a list of planets with no house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence begins with 'ये' at the end of the 4:02 chunk; the list is cut short with 'फलाना ढिमरा' (and so on).
classical_check: The macrocosm-microcosm idea is traditional; this list order (Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter) follows the usual weekday-style listing.

hindi: और ऐसे ही हमारे शरीर में सूर्य चंद्र बुध राहु इनका नीचे का स्थान दिया गया है घुटने मोड़ के यदि व्यक्ति बैठे तो इंद्र वरुण और यम ये ऐसे चलते हैं
says: Body map: Sun, Moon, Mercury and Rahu are given the lower places in the body, as seen when a person sits with folded knees, while the three outer planets Indra, Varuna and Yama (Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) work at the upper end. The caption is garbled and the mapping is uncertain.

hindi: क्योंकि ग्रहों के अनुसार कई ग्रह अलग अलग हिसाब से चलते हैं शनि महाराज जो है उनका बहुत लंबा साइकिल है चलने का प्लेनेट के अंदर

cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence.

hindi: शनि महाराज 30 साल में धरती की परिक्रमा सूर्य की परिक्रमा करते हैं 30 इयर्स

cells_derived_method: none - an astronomical period with no house or sign dependence.

hindi: अब धरती यहां कहीं बैठी है यह एक साल में घूम रही है सिर्फ एक साल में
says: The Earth, sitting somewhere in his picture, goes around the Sun in just one year; he sets the observer's own period at one year.

hindi: अब एक साल में घूमने वाली धरती जो सूरज के तगत घूम रही है यह 12 साल में घूमने वाले बृहस्पति के हिसाब से बहुत धीरे चल रही है

hindi: ये 12 साल लेता है बृहस्पति 11 12 13 अलग अलग हिसाब है 12 साल मान लो ऐसे मोटे तौर पर

hindi: ये 30 साल यह हालाकि 29 साल के आसपास लेता है लेकिन हम मोटे तौर पर बात कर रहे हैं

hindi: ढाई साल ढाई साल एक राशि में चलता है 12 राशि इसलिए शनि की ढैया का क्लेश चलता है

hindi: अब जब यह धरती के साथ यहां ऐसे ऐसे ऐसे धरती चली धरती य चली यं चली तो बृहस्पति महाराज तो यहां से यही आ पाया अभी सर फोटो है और धरती घूम भी ली वो पूरी घूम ली

hindi: तो कहते है अबे तोत पीछे रह गया वो वक्री है उसके ग्रहों ने वक्री दृष्टि मार रखी है

classical_check: Silent: no classical text calls a slow-progress person vakri.

hindi: उसकी लाइफ स्लो है वो धीमी गति के समाचार की तरह चल रहा है
says: Describes how a vakri person's life looks: slow, moving like the slow-speed news bulletin, compared with peers who run faster.
cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence.

hindi: तो अब ऐसा कैसे करें इसको जेट प बिठा दे क्योंकि जेट के बिना काम नहीं होगा इसके अपने तो बस की है नहीं

cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence; the specific remedy is not named.

gist: Garbled fragment 'जिसने पा साल में जलंधर पहुंचना है पांच में ही है' about someone reaching Jalandhar in five years; cannot be read reliably.

The same man abuses his friend and asks what sins he has committed.

hindi: तो बेटा इसलिए क्योंकि तू वक्री है बेटा तू पीछे को बहुत जाता है तेरी खोपड़ी पीछे बहुत सोचती है तू साले कंपैरिजन बहुत करता है तू इसको क्यों देखता रहता है सारे टाइम
says: Gives the diagnosis for the lagging man: you lag because you are vakri in nature, going back a lot, thinking backward and comparing constantly with the friend who is ahead; the slowness is a retrograde habit of mind.
cells_derived_method: none - behavioural diagnosis with no house or sign dependence.

gist: Repeats the advice from the preview: stop comparing or your brain runs retrograde (see G05-01-009).
Repeats the core rule that a natal retrograde planet takes power and troubles the house where it sits (see G05-01-010).

hindi: जैसे ही वो पावर पकड़ेगा उस समय अगर अंतरिक्ष जन्म के समय वक्री था तभी वक्री कहेंगे और आपकी वही कुंडली बन गई
says: A planet counts as retrograde in your chart only if it was retrograde in the sky at the time of birth; the sky of that moment is what became your kundali.
cells_derived_method: none - a chart-definition rule with no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: The first half ('जैसे ही वो पावर पकड़ेगा') repeats the earlier 'takes power' line; the new content is the birth-time condition.

hindi: अगर आज की डेट में वो वक्री नहीं है तो आपके लिए फिर उल्टा है
says: If the planet that was retrograde at your birth is not retrograde in today's sky, it is the opposite for you; the natal retrograde planet is out of step with the present sky and works against you.

hindi: अब आपकी जब मंगल अंतरिक्ष में सीधा चल रहा है तो आपकी खूब कुटाई होगी

cells_derived_method: He gives no house. The rough time falls on the topics of the house where the natal retrograde Mars sits, coloured by its sign - derived, not said.

hindi: आपके लिए पॉजिटिव तब होगा जब अंतरिक्ष में भी वक्री है क्योंकि आप वक्री में पैदा हुए

cells_derived_method: none - no house or sign dependence; it compares the natal and transit retrograde states.

classical_check: Silent in classical texts.

hindi: लेकिन अगर आपका नेगेटिव बैठा है तो नेगेटिव को ही फल बढ़ाएगा

classical_check: Silent in classics; the amplification idea is his own.

hindi: इसलिए बिना सहसरारा चक्र बिना अन्य ग्रहों की पावर और ताकत या कृपा के बिना आप सुनकर समझकर मुन्ना आपको सुला देगा

hindi: यह सब ा पर और वीडियोस पर बिकता है द आप यह कर ले शनि के लिए वो दान कर दें काम हो गया कुछ नहीं होता

hindi: अगर ऐसे ही कोई जेनेरिक मेडिसिन बनी होती तो कोई ना गंगाराम और फोटस में जाकर भीड़ में लाइन में लगता क्योंकि स्पेशलाइज केसेस है

hindi: हम जितने लोग हैं उन सबकी कुंडलियां अलग अलग है जुड़वा की कुंडली तक अलग है उसकी बात होगी
says: Every person's kundali is different, even the charts of twins differ, and he will discuss how twins differ later.

hindi: है अगर ग्रह वक्री है तो भैया उसका उपाय कर लो
says: If any planet in the chart is retrograde (vakri), do a remedy for that planet; this is his opening rule for the retrograde topic, given before any reasoning.

classical_check: Classical texts treat a retrograde planet as strong (cheshta bala), not as a defect needing a remedy; remedy-for-every-retrograde is his school's emphasis.

gist: Aside to the audience: many will understand astrology only after many classes, and he cannot tell how many classes are needed.

hindi: लेकिन एक चीज तो गांठ बांध लो जो ग्रह वक्री है भैया उसका रत्न धारण करना है हर हालत में रतन धारण करना है
says: Tie this in a knot: the gemstone of every retrograde planet has to be worn in every circumstance, with no case where the stone is skipped.
cells_derived_method: none: stated as universal for any retrograde planet in any house and sign; the exception he raises in the next sentence concerns lords of the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 12th.

classical_check: Differs: classical gem advice favours lagna and trine lords and is cautious with dusthana lords; a blanket stone for every retrograde planet is not classical.

hindi: उसमें एक बड़ा पंगा है कहीं कहीं बार ग्रह तीसरा छठा आठवा 12वां ये लगभग मौत के खाने हैं इनका मालिक होता है अगर वहां का आप स्टोन पहनेंगे ना तो उसको सूट कराना बड़ा मुश्किल है
says: The catch to the 'always wear the stone' rule: when the retrograde planet is the lord of the 3rd, 6th, 8th or 12th house (which he calls almost 'death houses'), wearing its stone is hard to make suit the wearer.
cells_derived_method: Which planets become problem-stone planets depends on the lagna, because each lagna gives different lords to the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 12th. Count the houses from the lagna, take the sign falling there, then its lord. A planet that also lords a trine or kendra gives a mixed case, which his sentence does not separate.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna has Scorpio as its 3rd house and Aries as its 8th, so Mars lords both; if Mars is retrograde, red coral is a double problem-stone case under his rule.
Derived: Taurus lagna has Sagittarius as its 8th house; Jupiter lords the 8th and the 11th, so yellow sapphire for a retrograde Jupiter is flagged, though the 11th-lord side softens it.
Derived: Pisces lagna has Aquarius as its 12th house; Saturn lords the 11th and the 12th, so blue sapphire for a retrograde Saturn falls in his hard-to-suit group.

Derived: Aquarius lagna has Cancer as its 6th house; the Moon lords only the 6th, so a pearl for a retrograde Moon would be flagged cleanly (the Moon itself is never retrograde, so this is a pure lordship illustration).

ambiguity: Could mean planets that lord the 3rd/6th/8th/12th, or planets placed in them; 'इनका मालिक होता है' (is the owner of these) favours lordship. 'Maut ke khaane' is his name for the houses, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical gem advice avoids lords of 6/8/12 (dusthana); the 3rd is only a mild trishadaya house, so including it is his extension.

hindi: वो साइड इफेक्ट मारेगा 1 लाख पर साइड इफेक्ट मारेगा
says: He says the stone of such a 3/6/8/12 lord will show a side effect, likening it to a medicine whose side effect hits about one person in a lakh; the figure is a rhetorical analogy, not a measured rate.
cells_derived_method: none beyond the previous row: it refers to the same lords of 3, 6, 8, 12; the nature of the side effect is not described, so it cannot be mapped to a house topic.
ambiguity: '1 लाख पर' most likely means one case per lakh (medicine analogy) but could mean a lakh of cases; the sentence repeats itself in the caption.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text quantifies gem side effects.

hindi: लेकिन ये वो केस है किसी व्यक्ति को कोरोना हो गया अब वो तो मर जाएगा तो डॉक्टर कहता है क्या करो इसे भाई स्टेरॉइड दे दो

cells_derived_method: none: an analogy, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: the steroid analogy is his own.

hindi: स्टेरॉइड भी एक स्टोन की तरह काम कर रहा है वो साइड इफेक्ट तो मारेगा 101 पर क्योंकि दो साल बाद लोग कहेंगे बाल झड़ गए गए मेरी किडनी पे लोड आ गया मेरे तो हार्ट पेशेंट हो क
says: Extends the analogy: the steroid acts like a stone, and as patients later blame it for hair fall, kidney load or heart trouble, wearers will later blame the stone for its side effects; he accepts that as the price. These are his illustrations, not medical claims to follow.
cells_derived_method: none: analogy only, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Silent: no classical parallel to the steroid comparison.

hindi: लेकिन वो मर जाएगा अगर नहीं खाएगा स्टेरॉइड इसलिए
says: Punchline of the analogy: the patient would die without the steroid, so the risk is accepted; by parallel, the stone of a dangerous retrograde planet is worn anyway (the 'therefore' is completed in the next minute).
cells_derived_method: none: an argument step, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence ends on 'इसलिए' (therefore); its conclusion is in the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन स्टोन तो पहनना ही है कुछ स्टोन सूट कराने के उपाय कराने पड़ेंगे उसे बांधना पड़ेगा
says: Conclusion of the argument: the stone must still be worn, but supporting remedies have to be done so that it suits the wearer, and the planet's energy has to be 'bound' (the caption 'उसे बांधना पड़ेगा' is unclear).
cells_derived_method: none: general rule for retrograde planets; no house or sign split is given.
ambiguity: 'उसे बांधना' could mean tying the stone on the body or binding the planet's force; the supporting remedies are not named here.
classical_check: Silent on binding; classical texts do prescribe mantra and charity alongside a gem, which is close in spirit.

hindi: क्योंकि ग्रह जो है बहुत ताकतवर है और यह हमारी कॉन्शियस में तब तक फल नहीं देंगे जब तलक सहसरारा यानी कृपा का इलाका ऑन नहीं होगा
says: A retrograde planet is very powerful, but its results do not register in our conscious experience until the sahasrara (crown chakra, which he calls the zone of grace) is switched on.
cells_derived_method: none: a statement about all retrograde planets and the crown centre, not about houses or signs.
ambiguity: 'सहसरारा' is read as sahasrara (crown chakra); 'कृपा का इलाका' (area of grace) may be a garbled Ketu reference, since he talks of Ketu's grace right after.
classical_check: Agrees on strength only: classical texts call a retrograde planet strong (cheshta bala); the crown-chakra condition is tantric or his own and classical Jyotish is silent.

hindi: आपके अंदर एक वाक सिद्धि डेवलप हो सकती है आपके अंदर वो शक्ति डेवलप हो सकती है कि सारी दुनिया कहेगी अरे नीलम मत पहनाओ आपके कहने से सूट करेगा ऐसी विचित्र सी बात होगी
says: Once the crown centre is active you can develop vak-siddhi (speech that comes true), so strongly that even if the whole world says 'do not wear blue sapphire', the stone suits the wearer because you said so; he calls it a strange but real possibility.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent as stated; neelam (blue sapphire) is Saturn's stone, so it is read as the example of a risky stone.
ambiguity: Saturn is inferred from 'नीलम'; he gives no condition for when vak-siddhi arises.
classical_check: Differs: classical practice treats blue sapphire as a stone to test with caution; the idea that spoken power overrides this is a yogic claim, not a classical rule.

gist: Mentions the baba who hands out puriya (small powder packets) and the jhaada healers who treat people; a set-up example for the Ketu claim that follows.

hindi: केतु की कृपा से झाड़ा लग के ठीक होंगे आप पुड़िया खाके ठीक होंगे असंभव है जब तक आपका वो सेट नहीं होगा केतु की कृपा नहीं मिलेगी आप झाड़े से ठीक नहीं होंगे
says: Cures by jhaada (ritual sweeping healing) or by eating a baba's puriya work only through Ketu's grace; unless your inner centre is set, that grace does not arrive and such healing will not work on you. The healing claim is his and is not endorsed here.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level claim about Ketu, no house or sign split stated.
ambiguity: 'आपका वो सेट' is unclear; from context it points to the sahasrara or crown centre being activated.
classical_check: Consistent: classical texts make Ketu karaka of mantra, tantra and unexplained or occult cures; the crown-centre condition is not classical.

hindi: और केतु ही अगर रिस्पांसिबल है तो झाड़े से ही ठीक कराएगा
says: If Ketu is the planet responsible for a person's trouble, then only jhaada-type healing will settle it: the cure has to match the planet that is causing the problem.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level matching of cure to cause; where Ketu sits would change which life area is troubled, but he does not say so.
ambiguity: 'रिस्पांसिबल' (responsible) does not say whether Ketu is by placement, by dasha or by affliction.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not name jhaada as Ketu's cure, though Ketu remedies are mantra and ritual based.

hindi: फिर लोग कहते तंत्र मंत्र किया हुआ है हम पर कुछ किया हुआ है
says: Observation that when such unexplained troubles appear, people conclude that tantra-mantra or black magic has been done on them; he neither endorses nor denies it in this sentence.
cells_derived_method: none: a remark about what people say, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: No planet is named; the link to Ketu comes only from the previous sentences.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has abhichara and tantra references but this remark is his own framing.

hindi: चंद्रमा यि दूषित हो जाए तो आपको ऊपर खुद की नजर लगती है
says: If the Moon is spoiled (dooshit), the native suffers the evil eye (nazar) of his own self, on top of others' nazar; this is the first symptom he gives for a spoiled Moon.
cells_derived_method: none: the claim is planet-level; which signs make the Moon spoiled is given in the next sentence.
ambiguity: 'ऊपर' is read as 'on top of' (in addition to others); the sentence runs across the 22:00 caption break ('की नजर लगती है' begins that chunk).
classical_check: Classical texts link an afflicted Moon to mental unrest, not to a self-inflicted nazar, which is a folk idea.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित मतलब चंद्रमा एक और आठ नंबर राशि का यह मोटे तौर पे यानी मंगल की यानी आग में चला गया पानी तो चंद्रमा दूषित हो गया सड़ गया गंदा हो गया
says: Defines a 'spoiled' Moon: the Moon placed in sign number 1 (Aries) or 8 (Scorpio), both Mars signs; water (Moon) has fallen into fire (Mars), so it has rotted and become dirty.
cells_derived_method: The sign test is fixed, so the spoilage is the same in every house; what changes is the house topics it touches: the house the Moon sits in, and the houses of the sign Cancer in that lagna (the Moon's own house). Lagna = sign number - house number + 1, wrapping at 12.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 4th means Capricorn lagna; the Moon lords the 7th there, so the spoiled Moon sits in the home and mother house and colours partnership matters.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 10th means Aquarius lagna; the Moon lords the 6th and sits in the career house, so spoilage would show as mental strain and disputes at work.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 12th means Taurus lagna; the Moon lords the 3rd, so the effort-and-courage house lord is spoiled in the loss and sleep house, showing as drained effort and unrest.

ambiguity: He says 'राशि', so numbers 1 and 8 are signs (Aries, Scorpio); but his habit of using house numbers the same way means a house reading cannot be fully excluded; the 'Mars = fire' logic fits signs.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon in Aries is in a friend's sign and in Scorpio it is debilitated; Scorpio is a water sign, so calling it fire follows his Mars-lordship logic, not the classical element.

hindi: और नीच का भी वो भी लेते हैं अभी वक्री प लगेंगे फिर वो भी आ जाएगा ये एग्जांपल के लिए
says: Low confidence: adds that the Moon in debilitation (neech, Scorpio) will also be counted as spoiled, to be taken up later when retrograde cases are covered, and that the present Moon case is only an example; the first words of the caption ('सर एक हमच') are garbled.
cells_derived_method: Same logic as the spoiled-Moon sign test: the sign is fixed, the house changes the topic. Debilitation for the Moon is Scorpio, so the cell follows from 'neech'.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 5th means Cancer lagna; the lagna lord is debilitated in the house of children and intelligence, so spoilage would touch mind, study and children.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 2nd means Libra lagna; the Moon lords the 10th, so the career lord is debilitated in the house of speech and family wealth.

ambiguity: Only 'नीच का भी' is clear; whether he treats debilitation as a separate spoilage condition or the same Scorpio case is not certain, and the rest of the caption is noisy.
classical_check: Agrees on the sign: the Moon is debilitated in Scorpio; classical texts do not use the word 'spoiled' but do call this a weak Moon.

hindi: तो क्या करेंगे चंद्रमा अब आपका दूषित है ये नेगेटिव हो गया अब आपको स्किन की प्रॉब्लम देगा डब्ल्यूबीसी कम करेगा बॉडी के अंदर लिंफोसाइट्स कम हो जाएंगे
says: Claims a spoiled Moon turns negative and gives skin problems, lowers the white blood cell count and reduces lymphocytes in the body. These are his health claims recorded as said; they are not diagnoses and not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level health claim for a spoiled Moon; no house or sign split given.
ambiguity: 'तो क्या करेंगे' is a rhetorical opener and not a question about remedies.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon rules body fluids, blood and skin moisture classically, so a fluids-and-skin link is traditional; naming WBC and lymphocytes is his modern gloss.

hindi: आपके स्नोफीलिया नाम की तकलीफ आपको देगा आईजी लेवल होता है जो एलर्जी की प्रॉब्लम वो बॉडी के अंदर बढ़ जाएगी
says: Adds that the spoiled Moon causes an eosinophilia-type blood problem (caption 'स्नोफीलिया') and raises the IgE level that goes with allergy. His health claim only; not a diagnosis or advice.
cells_derived_method: none: same planet-level claim as the previous row, extended to allergy markers.
ambiguity: 'स्नोफीलिया' is read as eosinophilia and 'आईजी लेवल' as IgE level; both are caption guesses.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no blood-marker terms; the allergy link follows from the Moon's fluid and phlegm nature.

hindi: सिर्फ होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन से ठीक हो सकते हैं क्योंकि चंद्रमा यही है
says: Claims these Moon-caused problems can be cured only by homeopathic medicine, because in his view homeopathy belongs to the Moon. Recorded as his claim, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: karaka-type link between the Moon and homeopathy, no house or sign dependence.
ambiguity: 'क्योंकि चंद्रमा यही है' (because the Moon is exactly this) is cryptic; the homeopathy-is-Moon reading is an interpretation.
classical_check: Silent: homeopathy is modern; classical texts give the Moon watery, subtle medicines in general terms only.

hindi: लेकिन चकि चंद्रमा खराब है तो होम्योपैथी सूट कर जाए के लिए भी आपके उपाय चाहिए नहीं तो होम्योपैथी भी काम नहीं करेगी
says: Because the Moon itself is bad, even homeopathy will not work unless astrological remedies are done first so that the medicine suits the person; the remedy has to come before the treatment.
cells_derived_method: none: general condition for treatment to work when the Moon is spoiled.
ambiguity: 'चकि' is read as 'चूंकि' (since).
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not condition medical treatment on a graha remedy in this way.

hindi: इसी के दम पर हड्डिया ठीक होंगी यही आपके लिवर से खुजली पैदा कराता है
says: Credits the Moon with the power to knit bones and says the same Moon causes itching coming from the liver; the caption is rough, so this is a low-confidence reading of his body-part claims. Health claim as stated by him.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level body-part claim, no house or sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'इसी के दम पर' may refer to the Moon or to homeopathy; 'लिवर से खुजली' is a rough caption.
classical_check: Differs: classically bones belong to the Sun and Saturn and the liver to Jupiter; the Moon is fluids, mind and blood.

hindi: इसी के पास लिंफ है वाइट ब्लड सारी बॉडी के वाइट ब्लड जिसमें आरबीसी दौड़ता है उसको स्पॉइल कर देगा
says: The Moon holds the lymph and the white fluid of the whole body in which the red cells travel; a spoiled Moon damages that fluid. Recorded as his body-part allocation, not as medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level karaka claim.
ambiguity: 'वाइट ब्लड जिसमें आरबीसी दौड़ता है' most likely means plasma, the fluid carrying red cells.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: classical medical astrology makes the Moon karaka of body fluids, plasma and lymph.

hindi: इसका वैसे उपाय होता है शमशान का पानी घर में रखना होता है बोरिंग वाटर शमशान के अंदर जो बोरिंग नीचे से उठाया हु पानी है
says: Remedy for a spoiled Moon: keep cremation-ground water at home, specifically borewell water drawn from the bore inside a cremation ground (shamshan).
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy for the spoiled Moon in any house or sign.
ambiguity: 'बोरिंग वाटर' is read as borewell water from a bore inside the cremation ground.
classical_check: Differs: classical Moon remedies are white items, milk, rice, pearl and Monday fasting; the cremation-water remedy is his own or folk practice.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित हो तो घर में रख दो कहीं भी पड़ा रहे सील्ड बॉटल बंद करके रखे रखो
says: Practical detail of the water remedy: for a spoiled Moon, keep the water in a sealed, closed bottle; it can lie anywhere in the house, as exact placement does not matter.
cells_derived_method: none: handling instruction, no house or sign dependence.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical remedy.

hindi: डिटेलिंग करेंगे तो आपको खुद की नजर नहीं लगेगी
says: He promises the full procedure later; with this water kept in the house, he says you will not be hit by your own evil eye.
cells_derived_method: none: promised result of the remedy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'डिटेलिंग करेंगे तो' can mean 'we will detail it later' or 'if the details are followed'; the Moon is implied by the previous sentence only.
classical_check: Silent: self-nazar and its cure are not classical.

hindi: कैसी अजीब बात है खुद की नजर लग जाती है शनि और चंद्र से होता है खुद की नजर लग जाती है और हम कहते हैं यार पता नहीं किसकी नजर लग गई
says: Strange but true: you can be hit by your own evil eye, and it comes from Saturn and Moon acting together; people wrongly blame some unknown outsider for it.
cells_derived_method: Not house or sign specific as stated. Derived: the house where the Saturn-Moon pair sits would decide which life area the self-inflicted nazar hits, and the sign changes how strong each planet is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn and Moon together in Aquarius in the 4th (Scorpio lagna): the self-nazar would show at home and in peace of mind, since the 4th is the house of mother and home; Saturn lords the 3rd and 4th there and the Moon lords the 9th.
Derived: Saturn and Moon together in Capricorn in the 10th (Aries lagna): the self-inflicted nazar would hit career and public image, with Saturn strong as sign lord and the Moon a guest in its sign.

Derived: Saturn and Moon together in Cancer in the 12th (Leo lagna): the self-nazar would show through sleep, expenses and isolation; the Moon sits in its own sign in the house of loss while Saturn, lord of the 6th and 7th, sits in an enemy sign.

ambiguity: 'शनि और चंद्र से' could mean conjunction, mutual aspect, or both being afflicted; he does not specify.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Saturn-Moon combination is a known troubled yoga (punarphoo or vish yoga) giving mental heaviness; 'self evil eye' is folk tradition and not in the classics.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में आप खुशी नहीं मना सकते सेलिब्रेशन नहीं
says: With this self-inflicted evil eye you cannot celebrate or enjoy happiness; joy gets blocked whenever occasions for celebration come.
cells_derived_method: none: consequence of the previous claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'ऐसी स्थिति' points back to the Saturn-Moon nazar; it could also mean any spoiled-Moon state.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn-Moon is classically linked with joylessness and gloom; the celebration wording is his.

gist: Digression marker: says the funny thing is coming and that the evil-eye point was a small extra that came in between.

hindi: मजे की बात क्या है कि हमारे ग्रहों के अंतर्गत हमारा शुक्र वक्री होता है मंगल वक्री होता है बुध वक्री होता है बृहस्पति वक्री होता है और शनि वक्री होता है
says: States which planets can turn retrograde: Venus, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn each go vakri; these are his normal retrograde planets of the chart.
cells_derived_method: none: planet list, not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees: the five star-planets (tara-grahas) are the ones with retrograde motion in classical Jyotish.

hindi: बाकी ग्रह यूरेनस नेन प्रोटो तो होते ही है राहु केतु तो परमानेंट वक्री है
says: The remaining bodies: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are retrograde too in his scheme, and Rahu and Ketu are permanently retrograde.
cells_derived_method: none: planet list, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are not retrograde all year in the sky (about five months each); he may mean they are also retrograde at times; 'नेन' is read as Neptune and 'प्रोटो' as Pluto.
classical_check: Rahu and Ketu always retrograde (mean node) agrees with classical texts; the three outer planets are not in classical texts.

hindi: ल वक्री तो मुख्य तौर पे ये ग्रह है जो वक्री होते हैं चंदा मामा कभी वक्री नहीं
says: Summarises that the planets that truly turn retrograde are mainly the five he listed, and the Moon ('chanda mama') never does.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence ends at 'वक्री नहीं' and continues with 'होते' in the next caption chunk; the Sun is not mentioned.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon (and the Sun) are never retrograde in classical Jyotish.

hindi: होते क्योंकि वो धरती से भी तेज चल रहे हैं
says: Gives his reason for the Moon never being retrograde: it moves faster than the earth, so it cannot appear to go backward.
cells_derived_method: none: astronomical reason, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence begins mid-thought ('होते'), continuing the 'चंदा मामा कभी वक्री नहीं' line of the previous chunk.
classical_check: The fact agrees; the reason is loose: the Moon orbits the earth, so its geocentric motion is always direct.

hindi: तो हम धरती चंद्रमा के लिए वक्री हो सकते हैं उल्टे चल सकते हैं क्योंकि हम स्लो हैं तो जो हमसे स्लो चल रहा है वो वक्री हो गया
says: Relative-motion idea: the slow earth can be the one 'going backward' relative to the Moon, and any body slower than us shows up as retrograde. The caption is rough, so the exact logic is uncertain.
cells_derived_method: none: astronomical explanation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Garbled logic: it is unclear whether he says the earth is retrograde for the Moon or that slower bodies appear retrograde to us.
classical_check: Half right: Mars, Jupiter and Saturn look retrograde when the faster earth overtakes them, but Mercury and Venus are faster than the earth and still turn retrograde, so 'slower than us' is not the full rule.

hindi: यानी अगर हम उसको रोकने संभालने उठाने में लगेंगे तो हमारे जीवन की गति रुक जाएगी
says: Life analogy for retrograde: if we spend ourselves holding up, steadying or lifting the slow (retrograde) one, our own life's pace will stall.
cells_derived_method: none: a psychological reading of retrograde, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'उसको' (it/him) refers to the slow or retrograde body or person; he mixes the planet and people in life.
classical_check: Silent: this is his psychological reading of retrograde, not a classical rule.

hindi: अगर आपके जीवन की गति स्लो है और स्पीड से नहीं चल रहे हो आप आगे इसका मतलब आप औरों को भी घसीट में लगे हो और अब वो आप पीछे खींच रहे
says: Diagnostic claim: if your life moves slowly and you are not advancing at speed, it means you are dragging other people along, and they in turn are pulling you back.
cells_derived_method: none: a life observation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: It is not stated which chart factor shows the slowness; the link to retrograde planets is by context.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical rule.

hindi: इसलिए हम जब भी औरों के तकलीफ औरों के दर्द औरों के सपे में लगे रहते हैं बड़ी महान आत्मा बनने में लगे रहते हैं हमारा जीवन स्लो हो जाता है
says: Whenever we stay busy with other people's troubles and pains and try to become a great soul, our own life slows down; he ties retrograde-style slowness to over-involvement with others.
cells_derived_method: none: a life observation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The word 'सपे' is unclear (possibly 'support' or 'trouble'); the meaning is read from the surrounding words.
classical_check: Silent: this is his own life-advice framing.

gist: The person who lives for himself, single-pointed with his own attention, is happy.
Many people rise like rockets in life but are not happy even slightly, with big sorrows hidden inside them.
Describes the lavish lifestyle of such people and how much money they have; the sentence runs on into the next caption.
The onlooker's reaction to such a rich house: horses seem to be running in it and there is a swimming pool inside; an exaggerated description of wealth.
Inside their homes there will be a terrible shortage of inner (spiritual) happiness; the caption says 'दुख' (sorrow) but context implies 'सुख'.

hindi: क्योंकि वह लोग क्या करेंगे एक मेजर फॉल्ट इन चक्रों को स्पॉइल करेंगे दूसरों के साथ आपके यह चक्र जिस प्रकार चल रहे हैं जैसी आपकी कुंडली है
says: Gives the cause: the major fault of such people is that they spoil their own chakras through dealings with others, and the way your chakras run follows your kundali.
cells_derived_method: none: a chart-wide principle linking chakra function to the kundali; no house or sign split given.
ambiguity: 'दूसरों के साथ' means through contact with others; the mechanism (jootha) is explained in the following sentences.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish does not map chakras to the chart in this way; this is a modern or tantric overlay.

hindi: मंगल या शनि वक्री है राहु बृहस्पति वक्री है आपका नहीं है लेकिन आप उसके साथ झूठ पीठ का कोई वहम नहीं करते तो उसके गह की वाइब्रेशन आप में जाएगी
says: If another person has Mars, Saturn, Rahu or Jupiter retrograde and you do not, but you observe no care about jootha (food touched by the other's mouth) with him, his retrograde planet's vibration will pass into you.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level transfer claim; which house suffers in the receiver would follow from the house the planet occupies in the receiver's own chart, but he does not say.
ambiguity: 'झूठ पीठ' is read as 'jootha' (leftover, mouth-touched food) with a caption error; Rahu is always retrograde, so naming it as 'retrograde' is loose.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no vibration-transfer idea, though Dharmashastra has jootha purity rules.

hindi: और आपके ग्रह की वाइब्रेशन वो स्टील करेगा
says: The reverse transfer: through the same jootha contact the other person will also steal the vibration of your planet, so the loss runs both ways.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: 'स्टील' is read as steal; which of your planets is taken is not specified.
classical_check: Silent: not a classical idea.

hindi: हर हालत में हम लोग झूठ का ध्यान नहीं रखते झूठ एक दूसरे के मुह में एक दूसरे का झूठा जा रहा है बड़ा कल्चर मानते हैं बड़ा बढ़िया मानते हैं
says: Criticises that in every situation people ignore jootha: each puts another's leftover in his own mouth and calls it a fine culture; in the context of the previous point, this habit is the route for planet-vibration transfer.
cells_derived_method: none: a social observation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'झूठ' appears as both 'jootha' (leftover) and, in other places of this talk, 'lie'; here it clearly means jootha.

hindi: बच्चे की बैंड बज गई कोई बकरी है उसके लिए आपको ये सिलेक्शन मात्र चाहिए कितना पीला कितना नीला

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्या नीलम पुखराज मूंगा मोती पन्ना पहनना है
says: Names the stones to choose from: blue sapphire (neelam), yellow sapphire (pukhraj), red coral (moonga), pearl (moti) and emerald (panna), standing for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Moon and Mercury.
cells_derived_method: none: a stone list, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Agrees with the classical gem-planet map; the Moon is never retrograde, so including the pearl is only a general list of stones.

hindi: आपको वो एकदम वश करेगा
says: The correctly chosen stone will bring the retrograde planet fully under your control.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'वो' (it) is read as the right stone, continuing 'क्या नीलम ... पहनना है' from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not promise control of a planet through a gem.

hindi: वो आ गई बीच रास्ते में चाय छानने की छल्ली आपने डाली अंदर सब अंदर कोई थू थू थू नहीं करना कुछ नहीं अड़ रहा

cells_derived_method: none: an analogy, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'छल्ली' is read as 'छलनी' (strainer).
classical_check: Silent: his own analogy.

hindi: इस फिल्ट्रेशन के साथ-साथ आपके कई वास्तु के प्रॉब्लम्स आ सकते हैं कई कृपा के आ सकते हैं
says: Alongside this filtering, several Vastu problems and several grace (kripa) issues may also come up and need handling.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'आ सकते हैं' could mean the problems may be present or may newly arise during the filtering; 'कृपा के' problems means grace-related ones.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर कोई उपाय फेल हो रहा है तो इसका यह मतलब नहीं उपाय काम नहीं कर रहा इसका मतलब सहस्रार कृपा लेनी है बची हुई

cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'सहस्रार कृपा' is the crown-centre grace he spoke of at 21:05.

gist: Doctor anecdote: a patient who is a maternal uncle's son was operated on, all the nerves joined perfectly and the operation was a complete success.

hindi: लेकिन डॉक्टर भी आखिर में कहता है उसको उसको पकड़ो उसको कौन है परमात्मा
says: Yet even the doctor finally says to hold on to Him, and he identifies 'Him' as God; the point is that a technically perfect remedy still needs divine grace behind it.
cells_derived_method: none: not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'उसको पकड़ो' (hold on to him) is read as 'seek God's support'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: परमात्मा कहां है नाइंथ हाउस जहां हम इष्ट की कहानियां इतने लंबे टाइम से कर रहे हैं
says: Locates God in the 9th house, where for a long time we have been telling the stories of our ishta (chosen deity).
cells_derived_method: The 9th house falls on a different sign for each lagna (the 9th sign is the lagna number plus 8, wrapping at 12). The lord of that sign and the planets sitting there colour the channel through which grace is sought.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna has Sagittarius as its 9th house; Jupiter lords it, so the grace channel works through the guru, dharma and teachings.
Derived: Libra lagna has Gemini as its 9th house; Mercury lords it, so the grace channel works through learning, mantra recitation and speech.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna has Leo as its 9th house; the Sun lords it, so grace is sought through father figures, authority and light-based worship.
Derived: Taurus lagna has Capricorn as its 9th house; Saturn lords it, so the grace channel runs through discipline, service and patient karma.

ambiguity: 'नाइंथ हाउस' is read as the ninth house, not the ninth sign; 'इष्ट की कहानियां' is a loose aside and he does not say how the house is to be read.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 9th is the house of dharma, fortune, guru and divine support; the ishta devta is classically read from the 5th house or from the 12th from the Atmakaraka in the navamsa (Jaimini), so '9th = God' is a simplification.

hindi: कि गलती से भी गलती हो रही है तो इष्ट की कृपा लो
says: If mistakes and troubles keep happening, take the grace of your ishta (chosen deity); this is the first rung of his grace ladder.
cells_derived_method: none: no house is named in this sentence; the 9th-house link comes from the previous sentence.
ambiguity: 'गलती से भी गलती हो रही है' is garbled; it is read as 'if you keep making mistakes' or 'if things keep going wrong'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: worship of the ishta devta is a classical remedy; no classical text frames it as a first rung before the ancestors.

hindi: गलती से भी ईश्वर नहीं सुन रहा है तो पितरों की लो
says: If God is still not listening, take the grace of the ancestors (pitras); this is the second rung of the ladder.
cells_derived_method: none: no house is named in this sentence; the 5th-house link comes from the next sentence.
ambiguity: 'गलती से भी' is repeated as a filler phrase; the meaning is 'even then, if God does not listen'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: propitiating the pitris is a classical remedy; the order after the ishta is his own.

hindi: वो है पांचवा घर फिफ्थ हाउस वहां पितर बैठे हुए हैं
says: Locates the ancestors in the 5th house: the pitras sit there.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house falls on a different sign for each lagna (the 5th sign is the lagna number plus 4, wrapping at 12). The lord of that sign and the planets sitting there colour the ancestral channel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna has Leo as its 5th house; the Sun lords it, so ancestral blessing runs through the father's line and the paternal side.
Derived: Cancer lagna has Scorpio as its 5th house; Mars lords it, so the ancestral link would show in family courage, land and inherited disputes.
Derived: Libra lagna has Aquarius as its 5th house; Saturn lords it, so ancestral matters link to old karma, duty and long-standing family obligations.

ambiguity: 'वो है' points back to the pitras of the previous sentence; the caption mixes 'पांचवा घर' and 'फिफ्थ हाउस' for the same house.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th is purva-punya (past merit) and lineage, but the 9th is the classical house of the father and pitris, and pitru dosha is read from the 9th, the Sun and Rahu, so the assignment overlaps but differs.

hindi: आपके जीवन में इन ग्रहों की मूवमेंट का वकृत्व हटाने के लिए आपको उस ग्रह के या तो उपाय करने
says: To remove the backwardness (vakratva) of these planets' movement in your life, you must either do that planet's remedies or one other thing (the sentence is cut off at the end of the batch).
cells_derived_method: none: applies to any retrograde planet; no house or sign split is given.
ambiguity: 'वकृत्व' is read as 'वक्रत्व' (retrograde-ness); the alternative to 'उपाय करने' falls in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not speak of removing retrograde-ness.

hindi: हैं या आपको स्टोन पहनना है स्टोन महंगा बहुत आता है सबसे बड़ी प्रॉब्लम है सर्जरी महंगी बहुत होती है
says: He admits the main practical difficulty of gemstone remedies: stones are very expensive, and he compares that cost with surgery, which is also very costly (only a cost comparison between heavy fixes, not medical advice).
cells_derived_method: none: a cost remark, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence begins mid-thought ('हैं या आपको...'); the first half of the thought is in the previous slice.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe ratna (gems) to strengthen planets; they are silent on the cost problem.

gist: Analogy: a short-lived cough is cured by a doctor's cheap medicines (the rupee amount is garbled in the caption) and if it returns you simply take them again.
Analogy continued: a cough lasting 15 years means deeper trouble, medicines keep failing, so scans and a very expensive surgery become necessary.

hindi: तो अगर आपकी लाइफ में कोई प्रॉब्लम 10 साल 15 साल 20 साल से चल रही है तो आपको स्टोन पहनना ही पड़ेगा आपके पास पैसे हैं या नहीं है सर्जरी करानी ही पड़ेगी क्योंकि वो परमानेंट डैमेज है
says: Rule of thumb for choosing remedy strength: a problem that has run for 10, 15 or 20 years is deep-rooted, so a gemstone becomes unavoidable whether or not you have the money, just as permanent damage forces surgery; light remedies will not be enough.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy-strength principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet's stone to wear; that depends on the afflicted planet found in the chart.
classical_check: Classics grade remedies by severity (mantra, daan, ratna) but give no 10 to 20 year yardstick; the threshold is his own.

hindi: इतनी बड़ी प्रॉब्लम है आप छोटे से दान ट के उपाय क्यों नहीं कराते क्योंकि ये दो दिन की खांसी नहीं है पिछले 10 साल 15 साल से आप सफर कर रहे हो आपको बहुत हैवी रेमेडी चाहिए
says: He answers the objection 'why not give small donations or tona-type remedies for such a big problem': because it is not a two-day cough, you have suffered for 10 to 15 years, and that needs a very heavy remedy, not a token one.
cells_derived_method: none: remedy-strength argument, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'दान ट के उपाय' is garbled; it probably reads 'daan and tote (tona) remedies', i.e. small charity and folk fixes.
classical_check: Classics themselves list daan as a remedy for malefics; his claim that it is too weak for old problems is a practitioner view, not a classical rule.

hindi: यह रेमेडी राजा लोग कर पाते थे इसलिए राजा बनते थे आजकल इसके लिए पैसा नहीं होता
says: He says such heavy and costly remedies were within the reach of kings, which is why they became kings, whereas ordinary people today lack the money for them; a claim of his about wealth and remedies, not a chart rule.
cells_derived_method: none: a social remark, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the 40:03 and 41:06 captions ('पैसा' then 'नहीं होता'); the cause-and-effect 'they became kings because of remedies' may be a loose remark rather than a claim.
classical_check: Classics mention royal yajnas and large daan, but the link 'they were kings because they could afford heavy remedies' is his own reading.

gist: He says people with no money or good fortune only reach an astrologer or vastu specialist after failure, so remedies will cost them whether they like it or not.

hindi: अच्छा उपाय में क्या मुख्य सीक्रेट है तन मन धन जो सुख चाहिए उसको धन पर डाल दो धन का स्यापा निपटा
says: He gives the 'main secret' of remedies: whichever comfort you want (body, mind or money), turn it into spending money on the remedy, and settle the grumbling about money first instead of haggling over the cost.
cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'धन पर डाल दो' and 'स्यापा निपटा' are colloquial; it could mean 'pay money to solve any of the three kinds of problem' or 'stop lamenting about money before doing a remedy'.
classical_check: Classics are silent on this; the idea that remedies need real sacrifice (daan) is classical, but the tan-man-dhan framing is his own.

hindi: पर साले सारे चोर हैं यह सोच के करो तो आपको चोर ही मिलेगा इसलिए आपने चोर है का मतलब
says: He warns that your attitude draws the outcome: if you go into a remedy (or to a doctor or priest) thinking everyone is a thief, you will meet a thief, so approach with trust.
cells_derived_method: none: an attitude principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The tail 'इसलिए आपने चोर है का मतलब' is broken; only the first half (thinking everyone is a thief brings a thief) is clear.
classical_check: Classics are silent; this is a faith-based practitioner principle.

hindi: चोर कहां रहते हैं चोर रहते हैं नीचे शनि परमात्मा कहां रहता है ऊपर सहस्रार
says: He places thieves low down, under Saturn, and the divine high up at the sahasrara (crown centre), tying Saturn to the lowest, grasping level of life and the crown to God.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-level association with no house or sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'नीचे शनि' could mean Saturn governs the base chakras or only that thieves sit at a low level with Saturn used as a label; he names no chakra besides sahasrara.
classical_check: Classics make Saturn karaka of servants, the low-born and thieves, which agrees; the chakra placement is modern chakra-astrology, not classical.

hindi: आप बोलो जो करेगा परमात्मा अच्छे के लिए करेगा आपको सही डॉक्टर मिलेगा आपको चोर डॉक्टर मिलेगा वो भी आपको कहेगा कोई बात नहीं रख ले
says: He advises saying 'whatever God does is for the good': with that faith you will meet the right doctor, and even if you meet a dishonest one the result is still read as grace; the last clause (a thief doctor saying 'never mind, keep it') is garbled.
cells_derived_method: none: an attitude principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The caption gives both 'you will find the right doctor' and 'you will find a thief doctor'; these are probably the two attitudes (trust versus suspicion), but the closing clause is unclear.
classical_check: Classics are silent; this is a faith-based remark and not a chart rule.

gist: Story: a recent case in Delhi where three men tried to rob one man at knife-point and threatened to kill him.
Story: they opened his purse, found nothing, and instead put some money into it (amount garbled) before leaving, and a camera recorded it all.
Story: the police caught the men, who said they had been to rob him but left money; asked why, they said pity came over them.
Story end: even robbers can feel pity, and they could not say what mood the victim put them in; they say the man got money out of them.

hindi: यानी कि कुछ भी संभव है आपके पास कृपा होनी चाहिए और कृपा लेने के लिए आपको पित और अपना इष्ट यह ध्यान रखना है
says: Moral of the robbery story: anything becomes possible when divine grace is with you, and to earn grace you must keep two things in mind, your pitr (ancestors, caption says 'पित') and your ishta (chosen deity).
cells_derived_method: none: a general grace principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'पित' is most likely पितृ (ancestors) but could be पिता or पति; 'इष्ट' is the personal deity. He gives no chart factor to find either.
classical_check: Pitr dosha and ishta-devata worship are standard in Jyotish practice (ishta devata is usually read from the 5th/9th or the atmakaraka); he cites no rule here.

hindi: आप जब जब अपने किसी ग्रह के लिए गड़बड़ करते हो तब तब वो एक्टिवेट होता है
says: General mechanism he will illustrate with Mercury: each time you mishandle something that belongs to one of your planets, that planet gets activated in your life and its effect in your chart is triggered.
cells_derived_method: none at this stage; the house or sign dependence appears in the Mercury example that follows later in the slice.
ambiguity: 'गड़बड़ करना' is loose: it could mean misusing the planet's colour, metal or people, or wrong remedies; the later Mercury example is about giving green things to a spouse.
classical_check: Not a Parashari idea; closer to Lal Kitab, where acts toward a planet's relatives or items trigger that planet.

hindi: मंगल के पास आपके सारे मित्र सारे पुरुष मित्र पुरुष मित्र हैं आपके पुरुष मित्र नहीं बनते
says: He puts all your friends, especially male friends, under Mars; if you cannot make male friends, that points to a Mars problem.
cells_derived_method: Planet-level karaka, but the house shows where the friend issue lands: the 11th (friends, gains) and the 3rd (peers, brothers, courage) are the natural places, and Mars's sign strength (own, exalted, debilitated) shows how easily male friends form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 11th (lagna Virgo) puts a weak Mars in the house of friends, so male friends are hard to make or keep.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) gives plentiful peers and fellow fighters, so male friendship should come easily.

ambiguity: He does not say whether all friends or only male friends fall to Mars; the text repeats 'पुरुष मित्र' as if male friends are the focus.
classical_check: Classics make Mars karaka of brothers and the 3rd house, and friends come from the 11th with Jupiter or Mercury; Mars as karaka of male friends is his emphasis, not classical.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जोश नहीं है आपकी नाभी डी एक्टिवेटेड है आपको मानसिक रूप से दृढ़ता महसूस नहीं होती विल पावर की बहुत ज्यादा कमी है
says: He lists signs of a weak or unactivated Mars: no zest in life, a deactivated navel centre, no mental firmness and a big shortage of willpower.
cells_derived_method: Planet-level karaka; the lack of drive is worst where Mars is debilitated or in dusthanas, and strongest where Mars is exalted or in own sign in a kendra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 1st house (lagna Cancer) weakens drive and willpower at the self house.
Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) gives strong zest and firmness in career, the opposite of the deficiency he describes.

ambiguity: He does not say whether these signs come from a weak Mars placement or from a Mars not activated by remedy; the 'navel deactivated' wording is a chakra idea, not a chart factor.
classical_check: Classics make Mars karaka of energy, courage and strength, which agrees; the navel (manipura) and willpower links are modern chakra-astrology.

hindi: आपके हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस है आपका हनुमान नहीं है आपके पास कोई सेवा ही नहीं करता कोई साला काम राम काज करी बे को आतुर कुछ ऐसा है ही नहीं आपका
says: He ties Mars to 'Hanuman consciousness', the devoted, service-ready quality: if it is missing in you, nobody serves you and no one is eager to do your work (he alludes to the line 'Ram kaj kari-be ko aatur').
cells_derived_method: Planet-level karaka; house shows whose service is missing: 6th (servants, helpers), 3rd (siblings and willing hands), 11th (supporters).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini) shows helpers and servants who do serve, so the missing-Hanuman complaint is milder.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 11th (lagna Virgo) leaves supporters unwilling and the network unreliable.

ambiguity: 'हनुमान कॉन्शसनेस' is a personal term; he does not explain whether it is read from Mars alone or also from the 3rd and 11th houses.
classical_check: Hanuman is traditionally the deity of Mars (Mangal) in remedy practice, which agrees; classical texts do not call it a consciousness.

hindi: आपके सपोर्ट सिस्टम उड़े हुए सारे के सारे आपका काम नहीं होना मंगल का लफड़ा है
says: He concludes that when your whole support system has vanished and your work does not get done, that is a Mars problem.
cells_derived_method: Planet-level diagnosis; the same Mars flaw shows in different life areas by house: in the 3rd it is siblings and courage, in the 10th it is career support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 3rd (lagna Taurus) means weak self-effort and helpers who do not come.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) shows work stalling because no team backs it.

ambiguity: It is not stated whether a Mars flaw means debilitation, affliction or retrograde motion; he moves straight to the retrograde case in the next sentence.
classical_check: Classics read support and work from the 3rd, 10th and 11th houses and Mars as courage-giver; the 'work does not happen = Mars' diagnosis is his shorthand.

hindi: अब अगर गलती से मंगल महाराज वक्री है तो आपको के लिए मूंगा पहनना ही पड़ेगा कंडीशनली अगर वो 6 आ 12 को पकड़ नहीं रहा नछ 8
says: If Mars is retrograde, coral (moonga) has to be worn, on the condition that Mars is not holding the 6th, 8th or 12th (houses of loss); the garbled tail 'नछ 8' repeats the 8th.
cells_derived_method: Coral is advised for retrograde Mars unless the dusthana condition applies; if 'holding' means occupying, only Mars placed in 6, 8, 12 is excluded; if it means lordship, only lagnas where Mars owns the 6th, 8th or 12th are excluded (6th: Gemini and Scorpio lagnas; 8th: Aries and Virgo lagnas; 12th: Taurus and Sagittarius lagnas). The two readings give different cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) passes the placement test, but Mars owns Aries (1st) and Scorpio (8th) for Aries lagna, so it fails the lordship test.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer) is in a trikona and owns the 5th and 10th, so coral passes on both readings.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mars in Leo in the 6th (lagna Pisces) fails the placement test (6th house) but owns only the 2nd and 9th for Pisces lagna, so it passes the lordship test.

ambiguity: 'पकड़ना' could mean occupying or ruling the 6th, 8th and 12th; 'छ आ 12' is read as 6, 8, 12; 'नछ 8' is garbled and may be a repeat of 8.
classical_check: Classics advise coral for a Mars that is strong and well placed, and warn against stones for planets that lord dusthanas, so the dusthana exclusion agrees; the 'always wear for retrograde Mars' part is his own view.

hindi: 12 तीन को भी इसमें हम निकाल सकते हैं एक्सक्लूड कर सकते हैं
says: He adds that the 3rd house can be excluded too: besides 6, 8 and 12, a Mars that holds the 3rd house also fails the test for wearing coral.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd is added to the list of disqualifying houses for the coral rule; whether it is placement or lordship changes the lagnas that fail.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mars in own sign Aries in the 3rd (lagna Aquarius) is excluded on both placement and lordship, since Mars owns the 3rd and 10th for Aquarius lagna.
Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra) is not in 3, 6, 8 or 12 and owns the 2nd and 7th, so coral is still allowed.

hindi: ये मंगल है यह क्रूर ग्रह है मंगल क्रूर ग्रह है क्रूर कातिल है ये मंगल को आप याद रखें

hindi: क्रूर क्रूर सिंह यानी मंगल छोड़ता नहीं है अमंगल और मंगल ये कत्ल कर देता है काट देता है तबाह करता है यह बहुत जोर से काम करता है

hindi: अग्नि है मंगल नाभि पर यह बहुत ज्यादा जोर से काम करता है
says: Mars is fire (agni) and its seat is the navel, where it acts with great intensity.
cells_derived_method: none: element and body-centre association, not house or sign dependent.

hindi: चंद्रमा सौम्य ये धीरे-धीरे काम करता है चंद्रमा बहुत धीरे काम करता है चंदा मामा स्लो चांद धीमे मंगल काट देता है
says: Contrast: the Moon is soft (saumya) and works slowly, 'chanda mama slow', while Mars cuts through immediately.
cells_derived_method: none: speed-of-action contrast between two planets, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: None for the meaning; 'काट देता है' is figurative for abrupt, decisive action.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is a benefic in classical texts and Mars a malefic; the slow versus fast framing is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा किसी को रिच बनाता है हले होले मंगल बनाता है करोड़पति ाए लॉटरी आग लगा डाली एकदम से ही पागलों की तरह पैसा आया सफलता आई जोश
