cells_derived_method: Planet-level contrast; for wealth the 2nd and 11th houses and sign strength decide whether sudden Mars gains or slow Moon gains show.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in own sign Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini) suits sudden, forceful gains rather than slow accumulation.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon in own sign Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) favours slow, steady building of wealth.

classical_check: Classics link Mars with sudden gains from property and effort and the Moon with fluctuating, gradual wealth; the lottery image is his own.

hindi: मंगल जोश का ग्रह है इंसान लड़ाई करता है ना कितने जोश में करता है जोर से जोश आता है

cells_derived_method: none: karaka statement for the planet, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is karaka of courage, aggression and fighting spirit.

hindi: चंद्रमा प्रेम इमोशन का देता है आंसू लाता है धीरे-धीरे प्रेम आता है गले लगा ल तुझे क्या करूं ऐसी स्थिति
says: The Moon gives love and emotion, brings tears, and love arrives slowly in a hugging 'what shall I do with you' way, the gentle counterpart to Mars.

classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is karaka of emotion, mind and affection.

hindi: यह बुद्ध है यह वाणी है आपकी वाणी मैथ्स अकाउंट्स बनिए बिजनेस

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is karaka of speech, intellect, mathematics, commerce and accounts.

hindi: अगर आपका बुध वक्री है ऐसे ज्यादा चांसेस है कि बुध का कई दोष है
says: If Mercury is retrograde in your chart, there is a higher chance that Mercury carries one or more doshas (afflictions), which he then lists as speech and money symptoms.
cells_derived_method: none: planet-level condition (retrograde), not house or sign dependent; the house dependence appears in the symptom rows that follow.

hindi: आप हकला हैं तो हकलाने का दोष बचपन में ही ट्रेस कर लिया जाए और बुध के लिए उपाय किया जाए

gist: Roadmap: many remedies will be covered over the course; today's session is only about retrograde planets and stones, and other remedies exist.

hindi: अभी सब इसमें लाल किताब भी ऐड होगी उसके उपाय भी होंगे वो बहुत सस्ते उपाय हैं
says: He says Lal Kitab will be added to the course later with its remedies, which he describes as very cheap compared with gemstones.

hindi: जैसे वास्तु में कभी तोड़ के उपाय किए जाते हैं और कभी-कभी टेपे टोपे लगा के काम हो जाता है कई बार मसाज करके ठीक होता है इंसान कई बार उसे आइबूप्रोफेन खानी पड़ती है उस तरह से

hindi: तो बुध का अगर वक्री दोष पड़ जाता है तो आप हक ला सकते हैं आपका पैसा लीक कर जाएगा आप में पेशेंस एक भेले की नहीं होगी

hindi: जिस बच्चे का मैथ्स वीक है उसका बुद्ध दोषी है वक्री है चाहे नहीं है हो सकता है उसको पन्ना पहन के ठीक हो जाए

Derived, not said by him: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini) is strong, so a weak-maths child here would point to some other cause than Mercury's sign.

classical_check: Emerald is the classical gem for Mercury, which agrees; classics do not give a rule that weak mathematics means a flawed Mercury.

hindi: लेकिन यह तो गांठ बांध लो जिसका बुध बकरी है वह तेज तेज बोलेगा पेशेंस नहीं होगी बोलने में

Derived, not said by him: retrograde Mercury in Virgo in the 3rd (lagna Cancer) gives a fast, hurried communicator in media or sales.

classical_check: Classics tie Mercury to speech, but a fast-talking trait for retrograde Mercury is not a classical rule.

hindi: महा बदतमीज होगा इतना भगड़ भगड़ बोलेगा कि पता ही नहीं चलेगा क्या बोल रहा है यार धीरे बोलना तेज क्यों बोल रहा है

hindi: अगर वक्री नहीं है तो दूषित होगा छ आ 12 या तीसरे घर से या किसी प्लेनेट के द्वारा

Derived, not said by him: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo) is afflicted twice, by sign and by the dusthana.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries) is afflicted only by his added 3rd-house rule, not by a classical dusthana.

classical_check: Classics treat 6, 8, 12 as dusthanas and malefic influence as affliction, which agrees; adding the 3rd house is his own extension.

gist: He says this is a very long khichdi (mixed bag), tells students to take whatever they understand, and says what is learned will be useful in this birth or the next.
Story: a class-ten girl learned to make rotis for fun during holidays at her maternal aunt's house and never cooked at her own mother's home.
Story continued: after marriage there was conflict because she could not cook, then her body remembered the roti-making from 15 years earlier and it worked at the first try.
Moral: any learning is useful later, like riding a bicycle which one never forgets; no education goes to waste.

hindi: यह बुध आपका वाणिज्य देखता है सारा कैश
says: Mercury looks after your commerce, trade and all your cash dealings.
cells_derived_method: Planet-level karaka; the 10th (trade as career) and 11th (cash gains) show it most, and Mercury's own signs make it stronger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo) supports a steady cash flow from trading and communication.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) makes commerce and cash handling shaky and needs support.

ambiguity: 'सारा कैश' is a loose gloss; he means cash flow and money transactions, not the 2nd-house stock of wealth.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is karaka of trade, commerce and accounts.

hindi: ऐसी ऐसी स्थिति होती है कई बार बुध आपका मान लेते हैं मीन राशि का सातव घर में बैठा है

Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 1st (lagna Pisces) rules the 4th and 7th and sits in the self house, so self-confidence and home life carry the weakness.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Virgo (own and exalted) in the 7th (lagna Pisces) is the opposite case: a strong Mercury in the spouse house.

classical_check: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces in classical texts, which agrees; it is a teaching example, not a rule.

gist: He says small points like this will keep coming in between and the class will go on regardless; the word 'इंडिसिन' is garbled and its meaning is unclear.
Filler: he says let us take an example, since the talk is about Mercury he has named Mercury.

hindi: आपका य 12 नंबर बैठा है पत्नी के स्थान में मान लेते उदाहरण
says: He restates the example in number terms: Mercury sits at 'number 12' in the wife's place, meaning Pisces (sign 12) in the 7th house, which is the spouse's house.

classical_check: Agrees that the 7th house is the spouse's place; the example itself is only a teaching case.

hindi: तो 12 नंबर क्या होता है बुध की नीचता य बुध नीच होता है बुध नीच होता 12 नंबर में
says: Mercury is debilitated (neecha) in sign number 12, which is Pisces.

Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra) places weak Mercury in the house of debt and service, so money handling and routine work suffer.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mercury in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) weakens commerce and decision-making in career.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces and exalted in Virgo (which he does not mention here).

gist: Advice that students will have to memorize all these placements gradually in a tabulated form.
He invites students to notice how interesting Mercury's debilitation at number 12 is, before he starts the example.

hindi: ये तो आपने हरे रंग की चीज यह पत्नी है आपकी या पति भी हो सकता है आपने हरे रंग की चीज यानी बुध पति को दिया तो क्या किया आपने सातवें घर में प्लेसमेंट की है
says: He explains the mechanism with the Mercury-in-7th example: giving a green item, Mercury's colour, to your spouse (wife or husband) amounts to placing Mercury in the 7th house, the spouse's house, so you have activated Mercury there yourself.
cells_derived_method: The receiver of the gift fixes the house: spouse is the 7th, mother the 4th, child the 5th, boss the 10th; the planet's sign in the chart then decides whether the activation is harmful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with debilitated Mercury in the 7th (lagna Virgo), giving green things to the spouse triggers the weak Mercury in the partner house.
Derived, not said by him: with Mercury in Pisces in the 4th (lagna Sagittarius), giving green things to your mother would trigger it in the home house instead.

hindi: आपने हरे रंग का कपड़ा दे दिया कागज नोट पकड़ाया अपनी पत्नी को नोट आपने उसको हरे रंग की सब्जी उसके साथ उसको झूठी खाने को दे दी आपने अभी भी बुद्ध एक्टिवेट किया
says: He lists the green items that trigger Mercury when handed to a spouse: green cloth, paper currency notes and green vegetables (plus an odd phrase about giving a leftover or 'jhoothi' portion to eat); each one, he says, activates Mercury again.
cells_derived_method: The listed items are Mercury's; the relation of the receiver decides the house, so the same acts toward other people would activate Mercury in other houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with debilitated Mercury in the 7th, handing notes or green cloth to the spouse repeatedly reactivates the weak planet in that house.
Derived, not said by him: with Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces), the same gifts would activate a strong Mercury and need not cause trouble.

classical_check: Lal Kitab style item-to-planet mapping (green cloth, notes, vegetables for Mercury) is common; Parashari texts have no such rule.

hindi: सातव घर में आपकी पत्नी से लड़ाई होगी आपकी उस दिन
says: The consequence he predicts: with Mercury activated in the 7th, you will quarrel with your wife on that very day, a same-day effect.

Derived, not said by him: exalted Mercury in the 7th (lagna Pisces) would more likely produce sharp talk than a lasting quarrel.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) makes the exchange verbal and quickly resolved.

classical_check: A same-day, act-triggered quarrel is not a classical rule; the 7th house does govern the spouse, but the prediction is his.

gist: He remarks on how strange it all is, repeating that it is a very strange thing.

ambiguity: 'अब वहा क्या देना है' reads as 'what is to be given there'; 'चिजी' is read as 'चीज़ें'.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is karaka of iron and metals, property, land and servants.

hindi: ऐसा बंदा अपनी गर्लफ्रेंड को भी मकान गिफ्ट कर देगा अमीर बनने के ग्रह होने चाहिए लेकिन उसके अमीरी के हिसाब से उसके पास जो मकान होगा उसको गिफ्ट कर देगा गाड़ी दे देगा ऑटोमेटिक
says: Such a person will even gift a house to his girlfriend, provided he has wealth-making planets; he gifts the house or a car in proportion to his wealth, automatically.
cells_derived_method: The gifting follows Saturn's items (house, car) in the relationship house; it needs wealth indicators such as strong 2nd and 11th houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gifts property or a car to partners, if the wealth houses support it.

ambiguity: 'अमीर बनने के ग्रह' is vague: he does not say which planets or houses make a person rich; 'ऑटोमेटिक' means it happens without effort.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; Saturn-karaka of property is classical, the girlfriend-gift prediction is his.

hindi: और उसके बाद ढेर लगा रहेगा उसके पास बॉयफ्रेंड या गर्लफ्रेंड जैसी भी स्थिति है यह ग्रहों का कमाल है चमत्कार है
says: After that, a pile of boyfriends or girlfriends, whichever fits the case, will be around the person, and he calls it the marvel of the planets.
cells_derived_method: The crowd of partners belongs to the 7th and 11th houses (relationships and social circle); it follows the earlier placement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) gives a stream of partners as in the example.

ambiguity: 'बॉयफ्रेंड या गर्लफ्रेंड जैसी भी स्थिति है' means depending on the person's gender; the cell is carried from the earlier Saturn-in-7th example.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; his own inference.

hindi: आपके ग्रह का वक्र उसको मार देता है
says: He starts a new point: the retrograde (vakra) motion of your planet 'kills' that planet, meaning it damages the planet's results; the sentence is cut at the end of the slice.
cells_derived_method: none: a general retrograde claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'वक्र' is read as वक्री (retrograde); 'मार देता है' is figurative; the rest of the thought is in the next slice and may add conditions.
classical_check: Differs from Parashara, where a retrograde planet is strong in cheshta bala; Lal Kitab and later practice treat it as harming the planet.

hindi: अगर यही वो शनि वक्री है तो सत्यानाश कर देगा और यही उचका है तो लाजवाब कर देगा
says: Continuing the Saturn-in-the-7th example: if this same Saturn is retrograde it will wreck the matter (satyanash), and if it is exalted it will make it superb.
cells_derived_method: For a Saturn in the 7th, the outcome depends on its state: retrograde or debilitated is destructive, exalted in Libra is excellent; the 7th house is where he was applying it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) is his 'superb' case.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra), and retrograde, would be the 'wreck' case.

ambiguity: 'यही वो शनि' points back to the Saturn in the 7th of the earlier example; 'उचका' is read as उच्च का (exalted).
classical_check: Differs on retrograde: Parashari texts treat a retrograde Saturn as strong in cheshta bala; calling it ruinous follows later or Lal Kitab practice.

hindi: यानी नॉन वक्री और वक्री होके शनि के लिए नीलम यदि धारण आपने कर लिया तो सातवा घर पूर्ण रूप से सेट कर दिया इसने सेट
says: Remedy: whether Saturn is retrograde or not, wearing a blue sapphire (neelam) for Saturn sets the 7th house completely right.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy claim for Saturn in the 7th, the same whether or not Saturn is retrograde.
ambiguity: He does not say if the stone suits every lagna; 'पूर्ण रूप से सेट' is a strong claim with no conditions given.
classical_check: Neelam is the classical gem of Saturn, but classical texts warn to test it first because it can act quickly and harshly, so his unconditional claim is stronger than the classics.

hindi: बृहस्पति के पास सारा ज्ञान है
says: Jupiter holds all knowledge, which is how he opens the next topic after the Saturn example.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-level karaka statement, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The caption fuses 'इसने सेट' with 'बृहस्पति के पास...'; read as a new sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is karaka of knowledge, wisdom and teachers.

gist: Recap of the course path: they spoke about only a few signs, and he adds that more are still to be done; he says they went to the chart, spoke about signs 1, 2 and 7 (garbled) and came back to the table.
He says many people will curse him because their own number is 3 or 6 and they want him to tell it at once; he asks them to wait until all topics are finished first.
Teaching style: he says the course has no fixed system and is like a Christopher Nolan film that moves forward and back, so students must use their heads about where they are going.
Garbled run of conditions about the Sun in the lagna, 7th or 3rd house and some navamsa sign, dismissed with 'let it sit, it is his wish'; no reliable rule can be recovered.
He says they have not reached the navamsa yet, it is a long story, and so far they have only shifted the signs.

hindi: पिछली बार मोदी जी की एक कुंडली में अभी जब राशियां हिलते देखोगे तो आपका माथा पकड़ लोगे साला सूर्य कर रहा है काम साला नहीं भाई है सूर्य मेरा कि चंद्रमा काम कर रहा है पता ना लगा
says: Recalling a chart (Modi ji's) from the last class, he says that when you see signs shift you will hold your head, because you can no longer tell whether the Sun or the Moon is the planet doing the work.
cells_derived_method: none: a method warning that sign shifts blur which planet acts, not house or sign specific here.
ambiguity: The caption is rough ('साला नहीं भाई है सूर्य मेरा'); only the confusion about Sun versus Moon is clear, and no claim about the person's life is made.
classical_check: Classical astrologers use bhava chalit to see house shifts, but a planet keeps its rashi sign in it; his 'signs themselves move' idea is his multi-sign house view.

hindi: दो नंबर की राशि है यहां सूर्य यहां बैठ और चंद्रमा भी यहां बैठा है और चलित में बैठ कर के चंद मामा यहां गए यह एक नंबर है तो नीच का हो गया
says: Worked example: Sun and Moon both sit in sign number 2 (Taurus) in the rashi chart, but in the chalit chart the Moon moves into sign number 1 (Aries), where, by his claim, the Moon becomes debilitated.
cells_derived_method: A planet whose chalit position falls in the next sign changes dignity: Moon from exalted Taurus to Aries (debilitated on his claim). The house is not named, but the later divorce talk points to the 7th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun and Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) with the Moon exalted in the rashi chart.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon shifted to Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is the fallen, weak Moon he describes.

ambiguity: The house is not stated in this sentence; 'चंद मामा यहां गए' is the Moon shifting to sign 1 in the chalit chart; 'यह एक नंबर है तो नीच का हो गया' relies on his claim that the Moon is weak at 1.
classical_check: Differs: in bhava chalit a planet keeps its rashi sign, so the Moon stays exalted in Taurus; and the Moon is debilitated in Scorpio, not Aries.

hindi: अगर यह नहीं हुआ तो पता लगा सूर्य देवता यहां गए सूर्य उच्च का हो गया और चंदा मामा उच ग
says: The other case: if the Moon does not shift but the Sun does, the Sun moves into sign 1 (Aries) where it becomes exalted, while the Moon stays exalted in sign 2 (the last word 'उच ग' is cut).
cells_derived_method: The Sun shifting from Taurus to Aries moves it from a neutral or enemy sign to exaltation; the Moon stays exalted in Taurus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the Sun shifted to Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is exalted, while the Moon keeps its Taurus exaltation.
Derived, not said by him: Sun and Moon unshifted in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) is the baseline chart.

ambiguity: 'उच ग' at the end is garbled; it most likely says the Moon remains exalted (उच्च का).
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun is exalted in Aries and the Moon in Taurus; the sign-shifting part is his own scheme.

hindi: अगर चंदा यहां से हट गया तो बंदे का तलाक होगा सूरज य से हट गया तो पत्नी के आने के बाद राजा बन जाएगा
says: Two outcomes: if the Moon is the one that shifts away, the person ends in divorce; if the Sun is the one that shifts away, the person becomes a king after the wife arrives.
cells_derived_method: The marriage and wife results point to the 7th house; which luminary shifts decides divorce versus rise after marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon shifted to Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra), the weak Moon case, matches his divorce outcome.
Derived, not said by him: Sun and Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio), with the Sun shifted, matches his rise after marriage.

ambiguity: 'यहां से हट गया' means moved to the other sign in the chalit chart; the houses are not named, but wife and divorce imply the 7th; 'राजा बन जाएगा' is figurative.
classical_check: Not a classical rule; the classics read marriage outcomes from the 7th house and its lord, Venus and Jupiter.

gist: Rhetorical aside asking where a person should go to bang his head in confusion.

hindi: और यह भी हो सकता है कि य राशि ही दो नंबर का नहीं कर रही राशि एक नंबर काम कर रही है लिखी तो दो है लेकिन काम एक नंबर कर रही है
says: It is also possible that the sign written as 2 is not the one working: the chart shows sign 2 but sign 1 is doing the actual work.
cells_derived_method: A planet written in sign 2 may act as in sign 1; the house decides which area shows it, and both signs must be tested for every house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a planet written in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) may be working as if in Aries.
Derived, not said by him: the same planet read as Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is the second lagna to test.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses the 55:03 and 56:02 captions; he does not give the rule that decides which sign works.
classical_check: Not found in Parashari texts; it supports the multi-sign house idea behind Rajat's main-part rule.

hindi: तो दिखने को दिख रहा है तलाक होगा ये दिखने को दिख रहा है चंद्रमा सूर्य यहां है उच्च का और ये हटा हुआ है
says: Reading only the written chart, it appears divorce will happen: the Moon and Sun sit here exalted while one of them is displaced; he stresses that this is only what shows on the surface.
cells_derived_method: Surface reading of the shifted-planet case: a displaced luminary looks like a divorce indicator for the 7th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun and Moon in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) with one displaced is the surface picture he describes.

ambiguity: 'ये हटा हुआ है' does not say which of the two luminaries is displaced; 'दिखने को दिख रहा है' shows he thinks this reading is only apparent.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a worked example of his sign-shift method.

hindi: दिख रहा है कि पत्नी के आने के बाद बहुत सुख होगा
says: The same configuration can also be read the opposite way: it appears that after the wife arrives there will be great happiness, so the surface chart gives two contradictory readings.
cells_derived_method: The happy reading comes from the exalted Sun or Moon staying in place; the sad reading comes from the shifted weak Moon; which holds depends on which sign works.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun shifted to Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) is exalted and gives the rise after marriage.

ambiguity: He gives the two readings without saying which is true; the point is that the written sign alone cannot decide.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a teaching point for his multi-sign method.

hindi: बड़े-बड़े ज्योतिषी फेल हो जाएंगे कहेंगे यार बंदे के तो चंद्रमा सातव में लेकिन है नीच का एक्टिवेटेड ये तो तलाक हो गया कैसे हो गया भाई समझ नहीं आएगा
says: Famous astrologers will fail here: they will see a Moon in the 7th that is debilitated and activated, predict divorce, and not understand how the real outcome differs; the reason lies in which sign actually works.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Moon in the 7th reads as divorce; the hidden sign (working versus written) can reverse the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) is the standard divorce-looking placement.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon read in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra), the weak position on his claim, is the case where the written sign misleads.

ambiguity: 'एक्टिवेटेड' means the Moon has been triggered; 'कैसे हो गया' leaves open whether the divorce happened or did not.
classical_check: A debilitated Moon in the 7th is classically a stress on marriage; his point that the written sign can mislead is his own.

hindi: सर राशि मूव एंड मूवमेंट कस राशि भी मूव करेगी कई बार दो राशि काम करेंगी कई बार तीन करेंगी
says: Signs themselves move: sometimes two signs will work in a house and sometimes three, so a house is not tied to a single sign.
cells_derived_method: none: a house-sign principle for every house; each house gets two or three working signs, so every house needs several sign readings.
ambiguity: 'मूव एंड मूवमेंट कस' is garbled; the clear part is that two or three signs can work for one house.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the fact that a house cusp can straddle two signs in chalit or Sripati systems; the 'signs move' wording is his own.

hindi: हो सकता है यहां यह हो सकता है कि यहां भी एक है यहां भी एक है और दो नंबर है ही नहीं फिर य तीन आ गई यह कैसे हो सकता है
says: A sign may even repeat and another vanish: it could be that sign 1 appears in two consecutive places and sign 2 does not appear at all before sign 3 arrives, and he asks how that can be.
cells_derived_method: When signs repeat and skip in the house sequence (1, 1, 3, skipping 2), the skipped sign still holds a share of influence in the houses it touches.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a 2nd house holding Aries in two consecutive cusps, with Taurus skipped, shows how one sign can cover several houses.
Derived, not said by him: Gemini arriving next in the 3rd after the skipped Taurus shows the intercepted sign.

ambiguity: The sentence is rough ('यहां भी एक है यहां भी एक है'); the signs 1, 1 and 3 are read from his numbers and the places are unnamed.
classical_check: Agrees with chalit and Sripati charts, where in higher latitudes a sign can be intercepted and another repeat across house cusps.

gist: He says it is a khichdi (mixed bag); otherwise everyone would become an astrologer and carry the method in a pocket, so enjoy the ride for now.
He says once you learn to steer the ship of this journey you need nothing more; those on whom God has shown grace get it, it needs a blessing, and it is very complicated.
He says slowly only the people truly interested in astrology will stay in the class and the rest will complain it is heavy and incomprehensible.
Study advice: do not try to understand, just listen and let it download and store in your head, and it will work later; you will be amazed how fierce life is.

hindi: और जादू करने वाले जो जोशी महाराज होते हैं व जादू करते कैसे हैं कुछ नहीं करते छोटी खुची पुची करते हैं
says: The astrologers (Joshi Maharaj) who seem to work magic actually do nothing grand: they only do small, simple things, which is what real remedies are.
cells_derived_method: none: a remark on how remedies work, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'जोशी महाराज' is a generic word for an astrologer; 'छोटी खुची पुची' is colloquial for small, minor things.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a practitioner's remark on the simplicity of remedies.

hindi: अभी तो धागों से इलाज हो जाता है कहीं नहीं मिलेगा यह परमात्मा ने अपने आप ही दिया पता नहीं कैसे
says: He says that even a cure can come through threads, that nothing like this is found anywhere else, and that God gave it of his own accord, no one knows how (a tradition claim about remedy, not medical advice).
cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy claim, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'इलाज' is health-flavoured; it is recorded only as his claim that thread remedies resolve problems.
classical_check: Mauli and coloured thread remedies are common folk practice; classical texts do not prescribe them.

hindi: या नीला धागा डाल दे व पीला धागा डाल दे बंदे की दर्द गायब हो जाती है ऑपरेशन उड़ जाते हैं फिर कहते हैं गुरु जी अबे गुरुजी ने कुछ ना किया सब साइंस है
says: Putting on a blue thread or a yellow thread, he says, makes a person's pain vanish and operations get avoided; people then say guruji did nothing, but he insists it is all science (health-flavoured claim recorded as his words, not advice).
cells_derived_method: none: a thread-colour remedy, not house or sign dependent; the colour-to-planet link (blue Saturn, yellow Jupiter) is implied but not stated.
ambiguity: He does not name the planets or the ailment; blue and yellow are read as Saturn and Jupiter colours by tradition only.
classical_check: Blue for Saturn and yellow for Jupiter agree with classical colour lists, but thread remedies and surgery claims are folk or Lal Kitab practice; no medical rule is endorsed.

gist: He urges students to learn everything, says people do not want to learn and want to be heroes, and tells them to go and struggle for it.
He says a hero lives in swagger, nobody wants to struggle, so put in effort and learn to rise above boredom.

hindi: आपका जो अभी जो अगली बात बताने वाला था जब बृहस्पति जा रहा था आपके तोते उड़ जाते के बच्चा जो आईस के लिए प्रोजेक्ट हो रहा है बाद में वो क्लर्क क्यों लगता है य बृहस्पति का रोल है
says: He previews a Jupiter point: why a child who is being projected as a future IAS officer later ends up a clerk is Jupiter's role; he says it will shock the listeners and will be discussed later.
cells_derived_method: none at this stage; the house or sign dependence of Jupiter's role is not yet given.
ambiguity: 'जब बृहस्पति जा रहा था' may refer to Jupiter's transit or to the point at which he was discussing Jupiter; 'आईस' is read as IAS.
classical_check: Classics make Jupiter karaka of status and success, so a career-promise link is plausible; the specific IAS-to-clerk claim is his own.

gist: He says the Jupiter point will be discussed soon but they should finish the present topic first.

hindi: य ऐसे नहीं है कि दिख रहा है जो दिख रहा है वही सत्य है ऐसा नहीं है
says: What the chart shows on the surface is not necessarily the truth: the visible sign or house placement can mislead, so it has to be checked against the working signs.
cells_derived_method: none: a general method warning, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say here what the true reading rests on; it follows from the sign-shift examples just given.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical habit of cross-checking the rashi chart with chalit and divisional charts rather than trusting one view.

hindi: तो यहां आ गया तीन नंबर या छ नंबर तीन नंबर है बुध महाराज का और यह है राहु का
says: Now the pair 3 and 6: sign number 3 (Gemini) is Mercury's, and the other (sign 6, Virgo) is Rahu's in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: a sign-lord assignment, not house dependent.
ambiguity: 'यह है राहु का' is read as sign 6 since the next sentences speak of 3 and 6 together; it could also be a loose reference to the pair.
classical_check: Differs: Virgo is classically Mercury's own sign only; giving Virgo to Rahu is part of his twelve-planet scheme.

hindi: बुध राहु बड़े पक्के आ रहे बुध राहु के घर में होता राहु बुध के घर में उच्च होता है तीन और छ बुध और राहु
says: Mercury and Rahu are close allies, and Rahu in Mercury's house is exalted (the numbers 3 and 6, Mercury and Rahu); the clause about Mercury in Rahu's house is left unfinished.
cells_derived_method: Rahu exalted in Mercury's sign gives its best results by house: 10th for career, 3rd for effort, 6th for rivals.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu exalted in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo) is strong for career and public status.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu exalted in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries) gives bold effort and skill in communication.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) is read as strong against enemies and in litigation on his claim.

ambiguity: 'बुध राहु के घर में होता' has no predicate; 'बुध के घर में' may mean Gemini only or both 3 and 6.
classical_check: Partly agrees: many texts give Rahu exaltation in Taurus or Gemini; the Mercury-Rahu closeness and the Virgo link are his own.

hindi: य बुध का है राहु का हैय यहां पर है गले पर तीन और छ नंबर यहां पर आप बैठ गए तो तीन और छ नंबर है
says: The 3-and-6 pair, Mercury's and Rahu's, sits at the throat in the body; if you sit here in his table it is the 3-and-6 zone.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-zone association for the pair, not house dependent.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर है गले पर' is a gesture to a table or body location; it reads as the throat, but could be a nearby region.
classical_check: Differs: classically Taurus governs the throat, Gemini the shoulders and arms and Virgo the stomach; the throat for 3 and 6 is his own scheme (vishuddha).

hindi: पैसा कागज दो पत्नी को कागज दिया पति को कागज दिया यह पति पत्नी यहां लगा सकते हैं बच्चे के साथ है
says: Money and paper are the items of the 3-and-6 pair: giving paper or money to a wife or husband activates it, and the same can be applied between spouses and with children.
cells_derived_method: The receiver fixes the house (spouse 7th, child 5th) in which the 3-and-6 planets are triggered, as in the Mercury example.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) is triggered by paper gifts to a spouse, a mild case.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Virgo in the 5th (lagna Taurus) is triggered by paper gifts to a child.

ambiguity: 'यह पति पत्नी यहां लगा सकते हैं बच्चे के साथ है' is loose; it is read as 'this can be applied to husband, wife and also children'.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a Lal Kitab-style item and receiver rule.

hindi: यह शत्रु है कोर्ट कचहरी में आपने कोर्ट कचहरी में कोर्ट कचहरी मान लेते हैं तीन या छ नंबर यहां पर है आपका एक्टिवेटेड
says: Enemies and court cases belong to this pair: take any court or litigation matter as signs 3 or 6, where your planets are activated.
cells_derived_method: Litigation shows in the 6th house (enemies, disputes); the 3 or 6 signs there get activated, so the cell matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 6th (lagna Capricorn) puts a litigation-active planet in the enemies house.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) puts exalted Mercury in the house of disputes, favouring the native in court.

ambiguity: 'यह शत्रु है' probably points to the 6th (enemy) house; 'मान लेते हैं' means he treats court as the example.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th house governs enemies and litigation; the 3 and 6 sign link with Mercury and Rahu is his own.

hindi: अगर मिक्स क में तो भी काम करेगा अगर य दो नंबर भी है तीन भी और चार भी है तो भीय काम करेगा आपका तीन और छ नंबर है
says: The 3-and-6 rule still works when a house is mixed: even if the house also carries signs 2 and 4 along with 3, the 3-and-6 effect works through the sign 3 share.
cells_derived_method: A house touched by signs 2, 3 and 4 gets a share from each; the sign 3 share keeps the Mercury-Rahu effect active alongside Venus (2) and Moon (4) influence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a 5th house shared by Taurus, Gemini and Cancer (lagna Aquarius) still carries the Gemini 3-and-6 share.
Derived, not said by him: a 9th house shared by Taurus, Gemini and Cancer (lagna Libra) also carries the Gemini share.

ambiguity: 'मिक्स क में' is garbled and read as 'if mixed (in a mixed house)'; the example houses are not given by him.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with a house cusp straddling signs in chalit; the idea that each share keeps full effect is his own and matches Rajat's main-part rule.

hindi: अब यहां क्या है राहु आपने यहां पर चाय पिलानी है कोर्ट कचहरी में सबको और खुद पीनी है
says: Remedy for Rahu in court matters: serve tea to everyone in the court and drink it yourself.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy for the Rahu side of litigation, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the 58:01 and 59:04 captions; 'सबको' means all those present at the court, and it is not stated how often.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a Lal Kitab-style item remedy (tea for Rahu).

hindi: आपको ऑटोमेटिक राहु प्लेसमेंट अच्छी हो जाएगी कोर्ट में जाकर के और आपकी स्ट्रेंथ गजब की बैठ जाएगी
says: The promised effect: your Rahu placement automatically becomes good once you do this in court, and your strength there becomes remarkable.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's placement in the 3rd or 6th improves, giving strength in competition and litigation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) becomes a strong helper in disputes after the remedy.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu exalted in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries) gains confidence and effort after the remedy.

ambiguity: 'प्लेसमेंट अच्छी हो जाएगी' says the placement improves, not that the chart changes; the effect is promised for court matters only.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; remedy-effect claim of the Lal Kitab type.

gist: He says they now take one house, that the class could go on endlessly, and that there are many things to understand.

hindi: तो यह ऐसे ही मृत्यु स्थान में चाय पत्ती राहु चाय पत्ती राहु
says: Tea leaves are Rahu's item, and he links the same item logic to the 'death place' (the 8th house); he repeats that tea leaf is Rahu to fix it in memory.
cells_derived_method: none: an item karaka for Rahu; how it applies to the 8th house is not spelled out.
ambiguity: 'ऐसे ही मृत्यु स्थान में' may mean the 8th house or be a loose aside; the exact link of tea to the 8th is not given.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu is linked with the 8th and with dark or stimulant items; tea leaf as Rahu's item is a folk or Lal Kitab idea.

hindi: हरी दाल जो है मूंग की वो है बुध
says: Green dal, that is moong, is Mercury's item.
cells_derived_method: none: an item karaka for Mercury, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: None; whole green moong is meant, not split moong.
classical_check: Agrees: moong is the classical grain of Mercury.

gist: He tells students to learn roughly bit by bit, and that more will come gradually.

hindi: सारी की सारी हरियाली जो है बुद्ध महाराज है
says: All greenery is Mercury.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour and item karaka for Mercury, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: green and plants are classical Mercury significations.

hindi: गाय को पालक खिला के देखो अगर आपके बुद्ध में दोष है पहली बार में गाय आपके हाथ से खाएगी नहीं सूं के छोड़ देगी दूसरी बार में खाएगी दैट मींस आपके यहां दोष चल रहा है
says: A diagnostic test for Mercury: feed spinach to a cow; if your Mercury has a dosha, the cow will not eat from your hand the first time and will only sniff and leave, and if it eats the second time that means the dosha is running in your life.
cells_derived_method: none: a practical test for any Mercury dosha, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He does not say what a cow eating at once means; the sentence implies no dosha but only describes the refusal and second-time acceptance.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; a folk test that links cow-feeding and Mercury.

hindi: कुछ ना कुछ तो आपके बुध का दोष है उसकी करेक्शन करनी है वाणी का दोष आया कहीं ना कहीं
says: If the cow test fails, some Mercury dosha exists and has to be corrected: a speech defect has come in somewhere.
cells_derived_method: none: a correction principle for Mercury, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'वाणी का दोष' may mean a literal speech problem or only faulty speech habits; the correction method is not given here.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury governs speech; the correction by test is not classical.

hindi: इसे लोग कहते हैं किए कराए का दोष है ये सर्च करना पड़ता है चंद्रमा का
says: Such a fault is what people call a 'kiya-karaya' dosha (something done to you by others, such as black magic); he says it has to be searched for in the Moon.
cells_derived_method: none: points to checking the Moon for such influence; the house or sign tests are not given.
ambiguity: 'ये सर्च करना पड़ता है चंद्रमा का' may mean look at the Moon's affliction or the Moon's house; it is not clear.
classical_check: Not a Parashari rule; the Moon and the 12th house are classically read for hidden or ritual harm, which is close but not the same.

hindi: कई बार हम भी फेल हो जाते हैं कि यार चंदा मामा खराब है बुद्ध खराब है पता लगा रा खराब है ज्योतिष की ऐसी की तैसी रा बंदे की खराब हो रखी है उसके कारण
says: Sometimes even he fails at first: the Moon seems bad, Mercury seems bad, and then it turns out that Rahu is the bad one, whose spoiling of the person is the real cause of the other problems; the sentence is cut at the batch end.
cells_derived_method: none: a diagnostic caution to look for Rahu behind afflictions of the Moon and Mercury, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'रा' is read as राहु; the sentence ends 'उसके कारण' with its result missing, and 'ज्योतिष की ऐसी की तैसी' is an exclamation of frustration.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that Rahu can distort the Moon and Mercury through conjunction or aspect; his 'real cause' framing is his own.

hindi: से व घर उसे खा रहा है पता लगा कोई पितर नाराज है कहीं ना कहीं ऐसी चीज गलती से गलत हो जाती है
says: The caption starts mid-sentence. He describes a case where a person feels the house is 'eating' him (constant distress tied to the home) and the investigation shows some ancestor (pitra) is displeased because something was done wrong, even by mistake. His claim: unexplained trouble linked to the home can come from an offended ancestor after an unwitting lapse.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The opening words are cut, so who is eating whom is inferred; he names no planet or house for the ancestor link in this sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts tie ancestral displeasure (pitri dosha) to the Sun, the 9th house and Saturn/Rahu/Ketu afflictions; the 'house eating the person' idea is vastu folk tradition, not Parashari.

hindi: अब पंगा क्या होता है व लोकेट नहीं होने देता ऐसे अक्सर केसेस होते हैं शनि का दोष होता है भयंकर
says: He says the real trouble in such cases is that the cause cannot be located or traced, that this pattern is common, and that it is the work of a severe Saturn dosha. When a problem refuses to be found, he reads Saturn as the planet doing the hiding.
cells_derived_method: The hiding power would be read from Saturn's house and sign: strongest in the hidden or loss houses (6, 8, 12) and when Saturn is weak (debilitated in Aries); more controlled when Saturn is in own sign or exalted, where he disciplines rather than obscures. He gives no house or sign, so these are all derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus. Debilitated Saturn in the 12th (hidden things, hospitals, losses) is the strongest form of the veil he describes; trouble stays unseen until late.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Own-sign Saturn in the 8th (secrets, chronic hidden matters) hides the cause for long, but he is strong so the hiding is steady rather than destructive.
Derived: lagna Libra. Exalted Saturn in the lagna puts the veil on the person's own body and identity, yet a strong Saturn gives endurance, so the problem is hidden but resisted.

ambiguity: 'Locate' may mean a doctor locating the disease or an astrologer locating the cause in the chart; the next lines suggest both.
classical_check: Classical texts give Saturn delay, obstruction, and chronic or hidden ailments, and the 6/8/12 houses hidden matters; the claim that he stops detection is his own wording.

hindi: ये के तीन दिन पहले रिपोर्ट कराई थी बिल्कुल ठीक थे अभी फो स्टेज के अंसर आया है अरे तो पहली दूसरी तीसरी स्टेज में क्यों नहीं डिटेक्ट हुआ वो डिटेक्ट नहीं होने देता
says: Illustration of the Saturn veil: someone had a clean report three days earlier and then a stage-four serious illness was found; he asks why it was not caught in stages one to three and answers that the affliction does not let it be detected. Recorded only as his claim; this is a medical-detection statement, not an astrological reading, and nothing here is a diagnosis or advice.
cells_derived_method: none: it is an illustration of the previous Saturn-hides-the-problem claim and adds no new house or sign rule.
ambiguity: 'It' is not named in this sentence; the following sentences name Ketu and Saturn. The caption words for the illness and stage are garbled ('अंसर' probably means cancer), so the exact condition is not certain.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not speak of tests or stages; only the general idea of Saturn or Ketu hiding or delaying a disease exists.

gist: Restates that even capable doctors cannot detect such a problem and that it does not let itself be seen, the same point as the Saturn-hides-the-problem lines just above.

hindi: पर्दा केतु और शनि शनि अंधकार वो पर्दा डाल देता है बंदे की किस्मत प
says: Ketu and Saturn are the 'curtain' planets: Saturn is darkness and he drops a veil over the person's fortune, so the real problem stays covered.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-nature statement with no house or sign condition.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether the veil is a natal placement effect or something that operates during a Saturn or Ketu period.
classical_check: Classical texts give Saturn darkness and obstruction and Ketu hidden, obscure and mysterious matters, so the concealment idea agrees in spirit.

hindi: कि ज्योतिष भी नहीं देख पाता उल्टा उससे भी टेंशन हो जाती है
says: Because of that veil even astrology cannot always see the problem, and the astrologer's failure to see it adds further tension for the person instead of relief.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: This reads as a caveat about the limits of chart reading; it is not a planet-house rule and he does not say which chart features go blank.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss the astrologer's own blindness.

hindi: पर हिम्मत नहीं हार क्योंकि ग्रह करा रहे ग्रह करा रहे
says: His encouragement for such hidden-problem cases: do not lose heart, because it is the planets that are causing the events; a causation framing only, with no remedy or timing given.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Motivational wording; it does not say whether the planets' effect can be changed by remedy.
classical_check: Consistent with the general karma-and-graha view that planets indicate the fruits of past action; no specific text is implied.

gist: Anecdote: people come to him from Sonipat, normally in one hour, but one group yesterday took four hours, crying and miserable, which sets up a travel-delay story.
He jokes to the visitor that his fortune must be broken, or he brought along someone with terrible luck, and that is why the trip took four hours.

Story continues: he tells the visitor he has brought a man of broken fortune who caused the delay; the companion replies he will never travel with him again because the man even delayed his own work by two and a half hours in a jam.

hindi: यह साथ होता है और हम झूठ कहते हैं ना झूठा खिलाते पिलाते इसका सोचो और नहीं तो आप किसी के साथ भी जाते हो साला उसके छोड़ अपना भी काम नहीं होता
says: Drawing the lesson from the story: the luck of the person you travel or sit with rubs off on you, so if you go along with someone of poor fortune your own work also fails, not only theirs. The middle of the caption (about 'jootha' food and drink) is garbled and may refer to sharing food or drink as a way fortunes mix.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The words about feeding and drinking 'jootha' are unclear; it may mean companionship in general or specifically sharing food. No planet or house is named.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a rule for one person's luck spoiling another's trip; this is a folk and experience-based claim.

gist: Sings a film-song pun: 'we will sink, darling, and take you down with us', about a bad-luck companion dragging you down too.

hindi: ये तीन और छह है अब यहां पर आपका राहु उच्च होता है बुध उच्च होता है
says: For signs 3 and 6 (Gemini and Virgo, the Mercury pair) he says Rahu is exalted and Mercury is exalted there. He treats the two signs together as one group, and does not say which of the two planets exalts in which sign.
cells_derived_method: Exaltation strength then changes with the house: Mercury strong in the 5th or 10th improves intellect and profession; Rahu strong in the 3rd improves bold communication and effort; kendras and trikonas give the most visible result. All house readings are derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd, a strong Rahu in the house of effort and media, favouring bold communication, writing and risk-taking.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Exalted Mercury in the 10th, a strong career placement for analysis, accounts, trade and speech.
Derived: lagna Taurus. Exalted Mercury in the 5th, sharp intellect and learning, a quick mind for study and advice.

ambiguity: Number 3 and 6 are read as sign numbers (Aries=1); 'यहां' could also mean 'in these two houses'. It is not said which sign carries which exaltation.
classical_check: Classical texts agree only that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; Rahu's exaltation is Gemini in one school and Taurus in another, and treating Gemini as exalted Mercury is not classical.

gist: Acts out Rahu's personality with a 'buddy, let's plan a drinking party, everything set' mimic as a joke about Rahu's party and liquor nature.

hindi: आपने अल्कोहल का कार्यक्रम कर सकते हैं चाय का काम कर सकते हैं टॉक्सिफिकेशन का नोटों का काम कर सकते हैं
says: With this Rahu-Mercury strength you can work in alcohol, tea, toxification (poison and chemical type work) and currency notes. These are the business lines he attaches to Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Which line pays depends on the house Rahu occupies: the 2nd gives food and drink and speech based earning, the 7th trade through partners, the 10th profession, the 11th gains. Signs colour it: Rahu in Gemini adds trade and communication. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo. Rahu in the 10th in Gemini, a career in liquor, tea trade or note handling and chemicals through trade and communication.
Derived: lagna Aries. Rahu in the 2nd in Taurus, wealth from food and beverage lines such as tea or liquor.
Derived: lagna Pisces. Rahu in the 7th in Virgo, these goods traded through partners or clients, with a service and analysis flavour.

ambiguity: The sentence is said right after the 3 and 6 exaltation line, so it may be limited to Rahu and Mercury in Gemini and Virgo; 'आपने' is probably 'आप'.
classical_check: Classical texts give Rahu intoxicants, poison and foreign things; tea and currency notes are modern readings. It is a business statement, not investment advice.

hindi: आप अपने जीवन में जितनी हरी चीजें देंगे ये हरी है ये नीली है
says: He contrasts green things with blue things: green belongs to Mercury and blue to Rahu. The lead-in 'the more green things you give in life' is unclear and may hint at giving green items as a remedy.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Garbled: the verb 'देंगे' could mean giving green items as a remedy or simply counting green things in life; the planet for each colour is not named in this sentence, and green as Mercury and blue as Rahu is inferred from the next sentence.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mercury green; blue is usually Saturn (black or dark blue) and Rahu smoky or dark, so blue for Rahu is partly his own scheme.

hindi: राहु का रंग नीला है नील पड़ते हैं नील शरीर प जो नील पड़ता है वो राहु है
says: Rahu's colour is blue; the blue-black marks (bruises) that appear on the body belong to Rahu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: None; it is a simple planet to colour and sign mapping.
classical_check: Classical texts give Rahu smoky or dark hues and bruise-like marks are a modern link; blue for Rahu is a variant.

hindi: अगर आपके राहु ने कहीं अटैक मारा है आपको चोट लगेगी नील पड़ जाएगा खतरनाक
says: If Rahu has struck somewhere in your chart, you will get hurt and a dangerous-looking blue bruise will form; he reads a blue bruise as the sign of a Rahu attack.
cells_derived_method: The part of the body hit would follow the house Rahu strikes by the Kalapurusha body map (1 head, 6 abdomen, 10 knees); the sign shows how violent or sudden. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo. Rahu in the lagna in Leo, a bruise or knock to the head or face area.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Rahu in the 6th in Scorpio, injury or discolouring around the abdomen or waist, with a sudden or hidden nature.
Derived: lagna Taurus. Rahu in the 10th in Aquarius, a bruise or hit around the knees, possibly during work.

ambiguity: 'Attack' is not defined: it could mean a Rahu dasha, a transit over a sensitive point or an aspect on a house.
classical_check: Silent: Rahu is classically sudden injury, poison and strange ailments, but bruise colour is not a classical test.

hindi: अगर ब्राउनिश कलर का पड़ रहा है तो केतु का अटैक है
says: If the mark is brownish instead of blue, it shows a Ketu attack rather than a Rahu one.
cells_derived_method: As for Rahu, the body part follows the house where Ketu sits: the 12th gives feet and the 2nd gives face or mouth. Derived by the Kalapurusha body map.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Ketu in the 12th in Sagittarius, brownish marks or injury around the feet.
Derived: lagna Aquarius. Ketu in the 2nd in Pisces, a brown mark or sore on the face or mouth region.

ambiguity: 'Brownish' may be literally brown or a rust or yellowish bruise colour.
classical_check: Silent: Ketu gives wounds and mysterious ailments classically, but a colour-based test is his own.

hindi: आपके कहीं ना कहीं डब्ल्यूबीसी में फर्क है हीमोग्लोबिन डाउन है आयरन डेफिसिट नाम का एक चेक कराएंगे होता है हमारे शरीर में आयरन को पकड़ता है सैचुरेशन आयरन की वो डिस्टर्ब होता है उसके कारण से ऐसा होता है
says: A medical aside to the Ketu-brownish-mark claim: he says such marks go with a blood count difference (WBC), low haemoglobin and iron-saturation disturbance, and he names an iron-deficiency test. Recorded only as his statement; it is physiology, not astrology, and not a diagnosis or advice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Captions are garbled; it is unclear whether he links the blood condition to Ketu, or simply explains why a brownish bruise appears.
classical_check: Silent: this is modern lab language, not found in classical Jyotish.

hindi: यहां पर नीच का कौन होता है शुक्र शुक्र नीच होता है छह नंबर में शुक्र नीचे
says: In the 3-and-6 sign group, the debilitated planet is Venus, and he says Venus is debilitated in sign number 6 (Virgo).
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus in Virgo reads weakest where relationship or pleasure matters most: the 7th (spouse), the 2nd (family and wealth) and the 10th (arts and luxury careers). All house readings are derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces. Debilitated Venus in the 7th, strain or coolness and criticism in marriage and partnerships.
Derived: lagna Leo. Debilitated Venus in the 2nd, weak family harmony and less comfort or sweetness in speech and money.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Debilitated Venus in the 10th, an artistic or luxury career is harder and bears more labour.

ambiguity: Caption 'छह नंबर' is read as sign 6 (Virgo) as the series does.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is debilitated in Virgo.

hindi: छ नंबर के अंदर अगर छ में नीचे तो तीन में भी नीचे है क्योंकि दोनों राशि याय छ में पहुंचा है तो यहां शुक्र दोनों के लिए साथ नीचे है इकट्ठा नीचे दोनों राशि काम करेंगे
says: His multi-sign principle: if Venus is debilitated in 6 then it is also debilitated in 3, because both signs belong to the same planet-pair (Mercury's two signs) and work together; Venus reaching 6 means Venus is debilitated in both signs at once.
cells_derived_method: Treat Gemini like Virgo for Venus: reduced relationship comfort, with the house deciding which area is hit (7th partners, 4th home, 11th gains). All derived from his pairing rule.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Venus in Gemini in the 7th, by his pairing rule read as debilitated, with spouse friction and criticism.
Derived: lagna Pisces. Venus in Gemini in the 4th, read as debilitated, with less comfort at home and in vehicles.
Derived: lagna Leo. Venus in Gemini in the 11th, read as debilitated, with weaker gains through friends or networks.

ambiguity: Part of the caption is garbled ('याय'); it is not clear whether both signs of the pair are always treated as one, or whether the second sign is only partly debilitated.
classical_check: Differs: classically Venus is debilitated only in Virgo; Gemini is a friend's sign for Venus (Mercury), so he adds a non-classical extension.

hindi: इसलिए जो लोग कहते सात नंबर का सूर्य नीच का है दो नंबर का क्या है दो भी नीच है
says: Using the same pairing logic, those who call the Sun debilitated in sign 7 (Libra) are right but incomplete: sign 2 (Taurus) is also debilitated for the Sun, since the two signs share a lord (Venus) and act together.
cells_derived_method: Sun debilitated in Libra or Taurus is read by house: 10th hits authority and career, 4th hits home and mother, 2nd hits family and wealth. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Debilitated Sun in the 10th, a struggle for authority and recognition in work.
Derived: lagna Aries. Sun in Taurus in the 2nd, read as debilitated by his rule, with ego friction around family, speech and money.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Debilitated Sun in the 4th, less peace at home and strained dealings with the mother or father figure.

ambiguity: Numbers 7 and 2 are read as sign numbers; 'दो भी नीच है' relies on the pairing idea stated just before.
classical_check: Part agrees: the Sun is debilitated in Libra; he adds Taurus, which classically is not a debilitation sign for the Sun.

hindi: उसकी पोटेंसी फर्क है एक में शुक्र का दोष आ रहा है एक में वरुण का दोष आ रहा है वरुण का दोष बहुत बड़ा देवता है ण इसलिए बहुत भयंकर फल होता है उसका
says: The two debilitations differ in potency: in one sign the fault comes from Venus, in the other from Varuna (Neptune), and since Varuna is a very great deity the result of that fault is far more severe.
cells_derived_method: Libra (Venus or Neptune lord in his scheme) carries the heavier Varuna fault and Taurus the lighter Venus fault; the house shows where the harsher result lands. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Sun in Libra in the 7th with the Varuna type fault, confusion, deception or illusion in marriage and partnerships.
Derived: lagna Scorpio. Sun in Taurus in the 7th with the milder Venus fault, ego and desire friction in the partnership, not the deeper confusion.
Derived: lagna Libra. Sun in the lagna in Libra, the heavier fault falls on identity and body, with self-image and vitality clouded.

ambiguity: He does not say which of the two signs carries the Venus fault and which the Varuna fault; Libra as the Varuna sign is inferred from Neptune being its second lord in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent: Varuna and the outer planets as lords of signs are not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: इसलिए वरुण इतना बड़ा देवता जब शनि वहां जाता तो उच्च का होता बहुत बड़ा दो नंबर का शनि कम बड़ा है
says: Because Varuna is such a great deity, when Saturn goes into that sign (Libra) it is exalted and gives a very great result; Saturn in number 2 (Taurus) is also treated as strong but smaller than the Libra case.
cells_derived_method: Saturn strong in Libra reads best in the 7th and 10th (stable partnerships, authority through discipline); Taurus is a lighter version, strongest in the 2nd and 9th. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Exalted Saturn in the 7th, slow but durable partnerships and a serious, responsible spouse.
Derived: lagna Capricorn. Exalted Saturn in the 10th, high rank earned through steady, disciplined work.
Derived: lagna Aries. Saturn in Taurus in the 2nd, a smaller version, careful accumulation of money and a measured speech.
Derived: lagna Virgo. Saturn in Taurus in the 9th, a modest strengthening of duty and fortune later in life.

ambiguity: 'Bigger' and 'smaller' refer to strength; it is unclear if he calls Saturn in Taurus exalted-like or only strong. The sentence runs across a caption break.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is exalted in Libra; Taurus is a friendly sign for Saturn but not an exaltation sign, so that part is his extension.

hindi: बड़े या शुक्र नीच का है शुक्र छ नंबर का आ गया क्या करेंगे पत्नी को श्रृंगार का सामान दीजिए
says: When Venus is debilitated (sign 6) he asks what you should do and speaks of the wife and adornment (shringar) items. The caption reads 'give', but the surrounding pattern (no white things when the Moon is debilitated, no Mars items) points to 'do not give the wife Venus's adornment items'.
cells_derived_method: The gifting caution bites hardest where Venus's debilitation touches the spouse and home: 7th, 2nd and 4th. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces. Debilitated Venus in the 7th, the gift of make-up or ornaments to the spouse is the case he cautions about.
Derived: lagna Leo. Debilitated Venus in the 2nd, family finances and food harmony are the area where the gifting caution would apply.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Debilitated Venus in the 4th, the household comfort and the mother figure are where the caution would show.

ambiguity: Garbled and likely a dropped 'not' in 'दीजिए'; the first words 'बड़े या' are unclear. The direction (give or do not give) is inferred from the following lines.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no gifting rule for debilitated planets; this resembles Lal Kitab style folk remedies.

hindi: पत्नी को या पति को आप भोजन साथ झूठा करके खला खाएंगे अगर आपकी लड़ाई टेंशन होगी क्लेश बैठेगा हर हालत के अंदर
says: If you share food with the wife or husband in a 'jootha' way (eating from the same plate or feeding each other) while the planet is debilitated, fights, tension and discord will settle in, whatever the situation. A tradition caution for spouses.
cells_derived_method: The caution is strongest where the food and spouse houses are touched by the debilitated planet: 2nd (food, family) and 7th (spouse). All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo. Debilitated Venus in the 2nd, shared-plate eating is where the discord would be tied to food and family.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Venus in Gemini in the 7th, by his pairing rule read as debilitated, discord between spouses through shared habits.

ambiguity: It is not stated which planet applies, only the Venus context just before; 'खला खाएंगे' is garbled and may mean feeding each other.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not contain this; it is folk tradition.

hindi: इसलिए यह बहुत ज्यादा ध्यान देकर चलना है कि ऐसी स्थिति में आप हैंड टू हैंड टच करके ना दे
says: So in such a debilitated-planet situation be very careful not to hand the item over directly (hand to hand with touch) to the spouse; place it down instead.
cells_derived_method: none: a general handling rule with no house or sign condition.

classical_check: Silent: a folk remedy with no classical source.

hindi: जब चंद्रमा नीचे होता है तो दही सफेद चीज चावल पानी चावल दूध दूध पानी का आइटम आपने बिल्कुल नहीं लेना
says: When the Moon is debilitated, do not take or give curd, white things, rice, water or milk items at all.
cells_derived_method: The caution bites where the Moon touches home, mother or spouse: 4th, 2nd and 7th. All derived for the debilitation sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Taurus. Debilitated Moon in the 7th, the white-things caution applies to the spouse.

hindi: पानी भी पूर्ण रूप से सफेद है और दूध भी तो दूध की बनी हुई सारी चीजें आप बर्फी ले रहे हैं दही ले रहे हैं सफेद रसगुल्ला ले रहे हैं ये अवॉइड करना है

hindi: चावल दूध पानी तीन चीज होती है वाइट सिर्फ याद रखें आटा वाइट नहीं है ये शुक्र हो गया सूर्य होता है

classical_check: Classically the Moon gives rice, milk and water, wheat the Sun and sugar and white refined items the Venus; so partly agrees.

gist: Reassures the audience that they will learn these colour and item links gradually and it will become clear over time.

hindi: इसके बाद आ गया चार नंबर चार नंबर चंद्रमा की अपनी राशि है

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Own-sign Moon in the 4th, contentment at home, a good mother and domestic peace.

Derived: lagna Cancer. Own-sign Moon in the lagna, a caring, sensitive nature with strong inner stability.

classical_check: Agrees: Cancer is the Moon's own sign.

hindi: स्वराशी और यहां बृहस्पति महाराज उच्च के होते हैं और यहां पर मंगल देवता नीच के होते हैं
says: In sign 4 (Cancer) Jupiter is exalted and Mars is debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces. Jupiter exalted in the 5th, strong intellect, children and wisdom.

Derived: lagna Aries. Debilitated Mars in the 4th, restlessness at home and loss of domestic peace.

ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer and Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: मंगल हाईली नेगेटिव मंगल नीचे होता है

hindi: चंद्रमा की अपनी राशि बृहस्पति उच्च का तो मंगल का सामान नहीं देना है मंगल है मीठा

hindi: आप लाल रंग की चीजें नहीं दे सकते

hindi: अब बृहस्पति का बड़ा अजीब बिहेवियर है अब रूल बुक टूट गई यह ग्रहों का खेल है बृहस्पति जब आता है तो चलने नहीं देता किसी को

hindi: और सातवें घर के बृहस्पति का मतलब होता है आपका जीवन साथी बहुत तेज जबान का होगा
