classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts call Jupiter the husband karaka and warn that a karaka in its own house can harm that house, but they usually praise Jupiter in the 7th for men; the dominance-clash reading is his own.

hindi: लेकिन उच्च राजा ऐसी पत्नी मिल जाए जिसका सातव घर में बृहस्पति हो राजा बना देगी पति को
says: But if a man gets a wife whose chart has Jupiter in the 7th, she will make her husband a king, raising him to a high and kingly status. 'उच्च राजा' is a loose phrase for a lofty, royal result.
cells_derived_method: The sign of Jupiter shows how reliable the lift is: exalted in Cancer gives a lasting, high rise; own sign Sagittarius a dignified rise; debilitated Capricorn a late or hard-earned rise. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Exalted Jupiter in a wife's 7th, the husband rises to a high rank and public respect.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Own-sign Jupiter in the wife's 7th, a principled and respected husband who grows steadily in standing.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Debilitated Jupiter in the wife's 7th, the husband's rise comes late or only after setbacks.

ambiguity: 'उच्च' may mean exalted Jupiter (Cancer) or just 'high'; the caption does not say, so the sign is left open.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts treat Jupiter as the husband karaka in a woman's chart and a strong Jupiter in the 7th as a prosperous, respected husband; 'makes him a king' is his exaggeration.

hindi: पति को राजा क्यों बनाएगी पति को क्योंकि बृहस्पति पुरुष ग्रह है
says: He gives the reason for the previous claim: Jupiter is a male planet, so in a woman's chart it stands for the husband, and that is why the husband gets lifted.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: None; it is a gender-of-planet statement.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is a masculine planet and the husband karaka in a woman's chart.

hindi: अगर ये लड़के की जन्मपत्री में ऐसा हुआ तो पत्नी तो बृहस्पति है नहीं वो शुक्र है या चंद्रमा है तो व पत्नी को रानी के दर्जे पर पहुंचा देता है
says: If Jupiter is in the 7th of a boy's chart, the wife is not Jupiter but Venus or the Moon, so Jupiter lifts the wife to queen-like status instead of lifting the husband.
cells_derived_method: The sign shows how strong the lift to the wife is: exalted Cancer gives the wife high standing and comfort, own sign Sagittarius a dignified wife, and debilitated Capricorn a weak or costly lift. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Exalted Jupiter in a man's 7th, the wife gets high standing, comfort and respect.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Own-sign Jupiter in a man's 7th, a dignified, well-regarded wife.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Debilitated Jupiter in a man's 7th, the lift to the wife is weak, with a rise that comes at a cost.

ambiguity: 'ऐसा हुआ' means Jupiter in the 7th as in the previous lines; the wife significators Venus and the Moon are named but the sentence does not say which one is used.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give Venus as the wife karaka for men and Jupiter in the 7th as a good spouse; the 'queen status' phrasing is his.

gist: Example for 'queen status': a man owns a very large factory, but the lanes to it can only be reached by scooter.
Example continues: the man never gets to drive the family Mercedes, goes to his messy factory by scooter, while his wife takes the car to a five-star kitty party every day.

hindi: यानी सातव घर में उस आदमी का स्त्री ग्रह उ चुका है तो पत्नी के नसीब है व पार्टी कर रही है व अप्सरा बन के घूम रही है
says: Drawing the lesson from the factory example: when the man's female significator (Venus or Moon) has been raised in the 7th house, the wife has the fortune: she goes to parties and moves around like an apsara while the husband is pushed around.
cells_derived_method: If the female planet is truly exalted, the cells are Venus in Pisces or the Moon in Taurus in the 7th; Venus in own sign Libra gives a similar luxurious wife. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Virgo. Exalted Venus in a man's 7th, a beautiful, refined, luxury-loving wife who lives in comfort.
Derived: lagna Scorpio. Exalted Moon in a man's 7th, a popular, comfort-loving wife with strong social standing.
Derived: lagna Aries. Own-sign Venus in a man's 7th, a well-adorned, sociable wife who enjoys status and leisure.

ambiguity: The caption 'उ चुका है' is garbled: it may be 'उच्च हो चुका है' (exalted) or 'उठ चुका है' (raised); he also does not say whether Jupiter or the female planet is the lifter here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give a strong Venus or Moon in the 7th a prosperous, attractive wife; the picture of the husband being pushed around is his own.

gist: Mocks the husband in the example: the 'apsara' wife and he is a helpless, peeled egg being pushed around, with a pencil-sharpener punchline.
Restates that such visible outcomes in life come from the planets, repeating his opening point that planets do the work.

hindi: इसलिए ज्ञान की स्थिति यह मंगल है मंगल है नीच का नीच का मंगल है ये तलाक कराएगा वैसे तो ये गारंटीड तलाक करेगा
says: A debilitated Mars (in the 7th house, from the surrounding discussion) will bring divorce; he says that normally it is a guaranteed divorce. He puts it as the default result unless other planets help.
cells_derived_method: Mars reaches the 7th house by aspect from the 1st, 4th and 12th too (his 7th, 4th and 8th aspects), so a debilitated Mars there also presses on the spouse house. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer. Debilitated Mars in the lagna aspects the 7th by its 7th aspect, so marital friction comes through aspect.
Derived: lagna Aries. Debilitated Mars in the 4th aspects the 7th by its 4th aspect, with domestic unrest spilling into the marriage.
Derived: lagna Leo. Debilitated Mars in the 12th aspects the 7th by its 8th aspect, with bedroom or expense related strain on the marriage.

ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; the 7th is inferred because he says 'ये सप्तम भाव है' two sentences later. 'ज्ञान की स्थिति' is garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in the 7th is the classical Manglik problem for marriage and debilitated Mars is worse, but classical texts add cancellations, and a flat 'guaranteed divorce' is stronger than they say.

hindi: अब मान लो और ग्रहों का सपोर्ट है तलाक नहीं होगा तो पति पत्नी के बीच लड़ाई होगी ये सप्तम भाव है प्रेम का है इतनी भयंकर आग लगा करेगी आपस में बात पूछो नहीं ये शाब्दिक बात है
says: If other planets support so that divorce does not happen, the husband and wife will still fight fiercely, because the 7th is the house of love and the fire between them is intense; he adds that these fights are verbal.
cells_derived_method: A stronger Mars in the 7th reduces the harm but not the heat: own-sign or exalted Mars gives loud, forceful but workable quarrels. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra. Own-sign Mars in the 7th, fiery arguments but a strong, protective partner and a bond that survives.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Exalted Mars in the 7th, an assertive partner and sharp debates, handled with discipline.
Derived: lagna Aquarius. Mars in friendly Leo in the 7th, proud and commanding clashes, with ego as the trigger.

ambiguity: The planet is not named in this sentence; it continues the debilitated-Mars line, so Mars in the 7th is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts say Mars in the 7th gives quarrels and heat in marriage even when separation is averted.

gist: Example: a sattvic girl from a cultured Jain or Baniya family has Mars in the 7th house, and remedies were already done for her.

hindi: मान लो कुंभ विवाह कर दिया कुंभ होता है घड़ा घड़ा होता है मंगल यानी कि तलाक होगा तो एक शादी नकली करा दी और नकली शादी करा के क्या हुआ ग्रह को कोई लेनदेन नहीं नकली
says: Remedy: Kumbh vivah, a symbolic marriage to a pot. Since Mars means divorce, a fake marriage is performed first, and because a fake marriage has no dealing with the planet, the planet's divorce effect is used up on the fake and the real marriage is spared.
cells_derived_method: The same remedy would be considered wherever Mars gives a Manglik problem (1st, 4th, 7th, 8th, 12th), with the sign setting how strongly it is needed. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Own-sign Mars in the 8th, the remedy is considered for marital longevity and sudden upsets, though Mars is strong.
Derived: lagna Capricorn. Own-sign Mars in the 4th, the remedy is for domestic unrest that spills over into the marriage.
Derived: lagna Gemini. Mars in Venus's sign in the 12th, the remedy is for strain in bedroom pleasures and expense.

ambiguity: None about the remedy; it is not stated whether the fake marriage is done before the real one in all cases or only for strong Mars.
classical_check: Agrees: Kumbh vivah is a standard traditional remedy for Mangal dosha in marriage matters.

hindi: इसलिए हम चोट लगाने का कार्यक्रम कर देते हैं पैर पर चोट आएगी बंदे को नकली चोट लगवा दी हो गया
says: By the same fake-instead-of-real logic, for someone whose chart shows an injury (for example to the foot) they arrange a small staged injury so the planet's injury is paid in token form and the real one is avoided.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not say how the staged injury is done or whether it is safe; recorded only as his tradition claim, not advice to hurt anyone.
classical_check: Silent: a substitution remedy of this kind is not found in the classical texts.

hindi: गाड़ी का एक्सीडेंट होना है स्टीकर लगा दिए गाड़ी प एक्सीडेंट वाला जो होता है ना फट गई गाड़ी वो एक साइड लगा दिया
says: Another substitution remedy: if a car accident is indicated, a sticker of a crashed or torn car is stuck on one side of the car, so the foretold accident is considered symbolically done.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is not said which planet or house the accident indication comes from, or whether the sticker removes the risk or only softens it.
classical_check: Silent: not found in classical texts; it is a folk substitution remedy.

hindi: देखना पड़ता है क यह बताते हैं आपके ग्रह कड़ी प कौन से हिस्से पर चोट लगेगी जब गोचर का ग्रह चलता है
says: One must check which body part will be hurt: the planets in your chart show the part, and the injury comes when the transiting planet moves over that point.
cells_derived_method: The body part follows the house the planet occupies by the Kalapurusha map (3rd arms and shoulders, 9th thighs, 12th feet), and the transit of a planet over it is the trigger. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aquarius. A planet in the 3rd in Aries marks the arms and shoulders; a transit over it brings a hurt there.
Derived: lagna Libra. A planet in the 9th in Gemini marks the thighs; a transit over it brings a hurt there.
Derived: lagna Aries. A planet in the 12th in Pisces marks the feet; a transit over it brings a hurt there.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह कड़ी' is garbled and probably 'ग्रह कुंडली'; he does not say which planet or which house gives the body part.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Kalapurusha body map and transit triggers are classical, but a rule that a chart planet names the injured part is his own.

hindi: गोचर एक अलग साइंस है कुंडली में दशा देखने की जरूरत नहीं अगर आपने गोचर समझ लिया
says: Gochar (transit) is a separate science of its own, and if you have understood transits there is no need to look at the dasha in the chart.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: It is unclear if he means transits replace dashas for all questions or only for timing injuries and events like those just described.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari practice uses dasha as the main timing and transits as a secondary check, so dropping dashas is his own position.

hindi: तो सिर्फ कुंडली देख के बैंड दशा फसा क्या आया भाड़ में गई कौन सा राहु कौन सा मंगल कोई लेन देन नहीं
says: He dismisses reading only the natal chart and dasha: 'what use, to hell with it', and says which natal Rahu or Mars it is has no real connection with what actually happens. Timing, in his view, comes from transit.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The caption 'बैंड दशा फसा' is garbled; the meaning that natal-plus-dasha reading is useless on its own is inferred from 'भाड़ में गई' and 'कोई लेन देन नहीं'.
classical_check: Differs: classical practice relies heavily on the natal chart and the dasha, so rejecting both is his own approach.

hindi: अब मंगल सातवें घर में बैठा है तो हर हालत में ये इस इलाके पे है मंगली तो है सरय मंगली शनि से भंग नहीं है
says: With Mars in the 7th house the person is Manglik in every case, and fully so ('सरय' read as a strong word), and the dosha is not cancelled by Saturn.
cells_derived_method: The sign changes how harsh it is: own sign Aries or exalted Capricorn gives a forceful but capable Mars, while Cancer debilitated is the worst. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra. Own-sign Mars in the 7th, Manglik by house but strong and protective, often seen as a milder case.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Exalted Mars in the 7th, a forceful, disciplined Manglik position.
Derived: lagna Aries. Mars in Venus's sign in the 7th, passion and temper tied to the partner.

ambiguity: 'सरय' is garbled and 'इस इलाके पे है' is loose; whether 'शनि से भंग नहीं' means no cancellation by Saturn's aspect or conjunction is not clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in the 7th is Manglik; some classical rules let Saturn's association reduce it, which he denies here.

hindi: अगर मंगली तो यहां पर एक तो ऑपरेशन कराएगा तो सिजेरियन बच्चे हो सकते हैं
says: For a Manglik woman with Mars in the 7th, one result is that she will go through an operation, so children may be born by caesarean. Recorded only as his claim; this is a medical-procedure statement, not a diagnosis or advice.
cells_derived_method: Mars's cutting and surgery nature is strongest when it is weak or afflicted: debilitated Cancer reads sharper than exalted Capricorn. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Debilitated Mars in the 7th, the sharpest reading of surgery and difficult birth, as he describes.
Derived: lagna Cancer. Exalted Mars in the 7th, the same surgery theme but with better control and recovery.

ambiguity: It is not said whether this is for a woman only (the context says a girl) or for any person with 'यहां'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give Mars surgery and cuts, but a caesarean link is a modern reading.

hindi: अगर कोई ग्रह सपोर्ट नहीं कर रहा है पति से क्लेश होंगे
says: If no other planet supports her (softens the Mars), the woman will have conflict with her husband.
cells_derived_method: none: it states a condition on other planets, not a house or sign condition.
ambiguity: The planet is not named here; it follows the 7th-house Mars line, and 'support' is not defined (aspect, conjunction or dignity).
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts say benefic aspect or association reduces Manglik dosha, and its absence leaves the marital friction.

hindi: तो इसका पति कौन होगा लड़की है मान लो मंगल पुरुष है मंगल स्त्री नहीं है तो इसका पति अल्कोहल पी कर के फिजिकल होगा उसके साथ अगर शराब नहीं पिएगा तो फिजिकल ही नहीं होगा कहीं बाहर चला जाएगा
says: For a girl with Mars in the 7th, since Mars is a male planet and stands for her husband, he will be intimate with her only after drinking alcohol; if he does not drink he will not be intimate at all and may go elsewhere. Recorded only as his claim about a husband's habits; not a diagnosis or advice.
cells_derived_method: The weaker or more afflicted the Mars, the stronger the dependence he describes. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Debilitated Mars in the 7th, the husband's dependence on drink for intimacy reads strongest.
Derived: lagna Libra. Own-sign Mars in the 7th, a strong husband, so the alcohol dependence reading would be much milder.

ambiguity: The caption runs on and is cut at the word limit; the sentence continues that he will have to drink alcohol. Whether it applies to every sign of Mars is not said.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give Mars in the 7th a hot-tempered spouse but not this alcohol and intimacy claim.

hindi: अब वो कंप्लेंट करेगी मेरे पति दारू पीता है तो कोई फायदा नहीं है पीना है उसने तुम्हारे ग्रही से तुम्हारे उपाय नहीं हु अगर इन्ह ग्रस्त बसा नहीं है तो ये क्या प्लेस करे
says: The woman will complain that her husband drinks, but he says complaining is useless: the husband has to drink because of her own planets, and her remedies have not been done. The last clause (if these afflicted planets are not settled, what can they place) is garbled.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The ending runs across a caption break and is unreadable; 'तुम्हारे ग्रही से' is probably 'तुम्हारे ग्रहों से'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not blame the wife's chart for the husband's habits in this way.

hindi: यहां चार नंबर के मंगल को मंगल को कौन जीत सकता है अकेले राहु महाराज है जो सबको जीत सकते हैं
says: For Mars in sign number 4 (Cancer, where he is debilitated), he asks who can overpower Mars and answers: only Rahu, who can defeat everyone.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's overpowering of Mars shows most where they meet: the 7th (partner), 10th (work) and 4th (home). All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn. Rahu over debilitated Mars in the 7th, the partner's anger is dulled or clouded by intoxication or illusion.
Derived: lagna Libra. Rahu over debilitated Mars in the 10th, drive at work is overtaken by shortcuts and scheming.
Derived: lagna Aries. Rahu over debilitated Mars in the 4th, domestic anger turns into restlessness and unrest at home.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' is read as sign 4 (Cancer, Mars debilitated) as in the previous slice, but it could be the 4th house.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not rank Rahu as the one planet that beats Mars, though Rahu is said to dominate the planet it joins.

hindi: राहु बृहस्पति की भी बैंड बजा देता है राहु सूरज की बैंड बजा देता है
says: Rahu can wreck even Jupiter and even the Sun, ruining their results when he gets hold of them.
cells_derived_method: The damage reads strongest where Rahu sits with the planet: Jupiter with Rahu in the 9th spoils fortune and dharma, the Sun with Rahu in the 10th spoils authority, and in the lagna the body and ego. All derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries. Own-sign Jupiter with Rahu in the 9th, fortune and guidance clouded (a guru-chandala type result).
Derived: lagna Scorpio. Own-sign Sun with Rahu in the 10th, authority and reputation eclipsed.
Derived: lagna Aries. Exalted Sun with Rahu in the lagna, vitality and ego are strong but shadowed and unstable.

ambiguity: 'बैंड बजा देता है' is colloquial; whether it needs conjunction, aspect or just a Rahu period is not said.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts have guru-chandala yoga (Jupiter with Rahu) and grahan yoga (Sun with Rahu).

gist: Remarks that for a long time they have been shouting 'Ketu, Ketu' (stressing Ketu), setting up the contrast that Rahu is even more powerful.

hindi: राहु इतना पावरफुल है कि वो सूरज को ग्रहण लगा देता है जो सूर्य ग्रहण लगता है वो राहु के कारण लगता है
says: Rahu is so powerful that he eclipses the Sun, and a solar eclipse happens because of Rahu.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: None; it uses the traditional Rahu-swallows-Sun idea for a point about Rahu's power.
classical_check: Agrees: classical tradition ascribes eclipses to Rahu and Ketu swallowing the luminaries.

gist: Asks the audience to think that the Sun itself and the whole solar system get eclipsed by Rahu, repeating how powerful Rahu is; the sentence is cut off at 'Rahu's grace'.

hindi: और राहु है कौन सारे के सारे जो काम कर रहे हैं स्वीपर है सारे काम सफाया अफाई कर रहे हैं सारे ज्योतिषी सारे संत
says: Who is Rahu? He answers that Rahu stands for sweepers and everyone who does cleaning work, and also for all astrologers and all saints.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'सफाया अफाई' is garbled and read as sweeping and cleaning (safai); why astrologers and saints are put in the list is not explained.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give Rahu sweepers and outcasts; astrologers and ascetic saints are usually Ketu's or Jupiter's, so that part is his own.

hindi: अब बताओ कहां टॉप टू बॉटम कहां जा रहा है अगर आप इनकी बेतिया खराब कर रहे हो आपके सूर्य को ग्रहण लगा देगा
says: Warning: if you mistreat or ruin these people (sweepers, astrologers, saints), Rahu will eclipse your Sun. He asks the audience to see how far this reaches, top to bottom.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'बेतिया' is garbled and may be 'बेटियां' (daughters) or 'बेइज्जती' (insult); the exact wrong done to them is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no such rule; it is a moral and karmic warning in his own style.

hindi: आपका तीसरा नेत्र बंद हो गया
says: When Rahu eclipses the Sun, your third eye (inner sight and intuition) is closed.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: He does not say whether the third eye is read from a house (6th or 12th) or only as a symbol.
classical_check: Silent: the third eye is a yogic idea, not a classical Jyotish placement rule.

hindi: सूर्य कहां है आंखें देखने की शक्ति ज्योति नाभि जहां आग लगी हुई है मंगल के साथ
says: In the body the Sun is the eyes, the power of sight and light, and the navel region where the fire sits together with Mars.
cells_derived_method: A Sun in the 2nd or 12th touches the eye region, and in the 5th the digestive-fire area; its strength by sign sets how strong these significations are. Derived tendencies only, not medical statements.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer. Own-sign Sun in the 2nd, strong sight and a clear, commanding face and voice.
Derived: lagna Scorpio. Debilitated Sun in the 12th, weak sight and eye strain tendencies, and a low reserve of light.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius. Exalted Sun in the 5th, a strong navel and digestive fire.

ambiguity: 'ज्योति' may mean the light of vision or inner light; the navel fire is linked to both Sun and Mars.
classical_check: Agrees in part: classical texts give the Sun the eyes (right eye) and vitality and Mars bile and fire; the navel is Kalapurusha's area for the fire.

hindi: सूर्य कहां है आपके शरीर के अंदर ईगो आपकी संभाल आपकी आत्मा इन सब पर ग्रहण लग जाएगा
says: Inside the person the Sun is the ego, one's self-guarding or self-care, and the soul, and when Rahu eclipses the Sun all of these get clouded.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'संभाल' is read as self-care or protection of oneself; the word may also mean upkeep or guardianship.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give the Sun the soul (atma), ego and authority.

hindi: और राहु का ग्रहण लगते ही क्या होता है राहु पावर पकड़ ले आपका एक ही शब्द चलता है बेबस
says: As soon as Rahu's eclipse falls on the Sun, Rahu takes hold of the power and only one word is left in your life: 'helpless'.
cells_derived_method: none

gist: Says nobody can tell what Saturn will do, that Saturn deserves an entirely separate treatment, calls him 'Munna Maharaj' and says Saturn is a story in himself.
Notes a running joke: he said nothing is greater than Ketu, soon will say nothing is greater than Rahu and then nothing greater than Saturn, like telling every girl she is the most beautiful.

Joke begins: a boy tells his girlfriend Mona she is the most beautiful apsara on earth; she answers that her friend Monal is a troublemaker who thinks she is prettier, and the boy says of course darling, you are mine.

Joke continues: Mona tells Monal the boy cannot stop praising her, Monal meets him separately and asks if she does not look like an apsara, he flatters her too that she is very beautiful, and the slice ends mid-joke.
Joke continues: the boy protests 'no, not like that', says Mona is not more beautiful than the other girl, that he never thought about it, and that he fell in love with Mona and also with Monal.
Joke continues: he is now dating both girls, telling each that she is an apsara, his life, and that no one on earth could be more beautiful than her.
Joke continues: in a few days he is caught, both girls learn he is dating and partying with both, and each asks angrily what he tells the other.

Joke continues: each says he told her the same thing, so which of the two is really more beautiful; they order the boy to be brought in, and Mangeram says he is as good as dead, either both leave him or both stay.
Joke punchline: asked who among them is prettier he says each of them is more beautiful than the other, and tells them to end the quarrel.

hindi: राहु केतु मंगल बुध एक दूसरे से ज्यादा ताकतवर है कोई कम नहीं

hindi: यह सब प्रकृति के खेल है कोई किसी का कुछ नहीं करा के दे रहा य सब हो रहा है किसी की भी जिंदगी में ऐसा चल रहा है तो कौन क्या कर सकता है

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में यदि शनि आपका पावरफुल है और यहां पर अन्य किसी पॉजिटिव ग्रह का योग है तो बंदा को कैसन बना देता है लड़की को हो सकता है किसी गलत काम में डाल दे

hindi: जब शनि एक नंबर या आठ नंबर होता है मंगल के घर में तो लूट मचाने वाली बात नहीं कत्ल कर देता है यहां लूट मचा देगा इंटेंसिटी का फर्क है

says: Claims that with cow urine kept at home even a heavy smoker's Jupiter stays sound, so the mind keeps working normally. Recorded as his tradition claim about the remedy, not health advice or a safe-smoking statement.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter does govern intellect classically, but no text ties a stored substance to protecting it.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में यहां गौ मूत्र गाय से संबंधित चीजें कमाल कमाल की चीजें बनती है
says: In that set-up he says cow urine and other cow-derived items kept in this zone give remarkable results; the vague 'wonderful things' is all he says, no specific outcome is named.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Could mean the products work wonders, or that wonderful products can be made; 'यहां' is the North-East zone.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Admits the class has drifted off topic, tells a student not to let it go retrograde, and says that detailing one sign fully would take many classes.
Transition line: now comes number 10 and number 11.

hindi: 10 नंबर में बृहस्पति नीचे होता है यहां कोई ज्ञान की बात नहीं करनी
says: At number 10 (Capricorn) Jupiter is debilitated, so he says no advice or 'wisdom talk' should be made here; Jupiter's guiding and teaching function is weak in this spot.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Capricorn is always weak by sign, but the life area hit follows the house: 2 (speech, family counsel), 7 (partner's counsel and beliefs), 10 (career ethics, mentoring).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Jupiter (lagna and 4th lord) debilitated in the 2nd: advice from the family is ignored and the person's own speech lacks weight.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter (6th and 9th lord) debilitated in the 7th: partner and the person differ on beliefs, counselling between them falls flat.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter (9th and 12th lord) debilitated in the 10th: mentoring and ethical authority at work are weak.

ambiguity: 10 is read as the sign (Capricorn) because Jupiter is debilitated and Mars exalted there in the next lines. 'No wisdom talk' could mean the person should not advise others, or that Jupiter-type remedies will not work.
classical_check: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn agrees with classical texts.

hindi: मंगल उच्च का होता है और शनि की तो रा राशि य है ही
says: In the same number-10 spot Mars is exalted and the sign is Saturn's own besides, so both Mars's peak strength and Saturn's ownership are present here.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Mars in Capricorn gives its best strength in kendra houses (1, 4, 7, 10); in the dusthana houses it gives stamina but also sudden or hidden friction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Capricorn, exalted Mars in the 1st: kendra exaltation (Ruchaka yoga classically), stamina, drive and command.
Derived: lagna Libra, exalted Mars (2nd and 7th lord) in the 4th: energetic domestic life, property and vehicles pursued with force.
Derived: lagna Gemini, exalted Mars (6th and 11th lord) in the 8th: strong endurance and research ability but abrupt events and surgical themes.

ambiguity: 'रा राशि य है ही' is garbled; read as 'Saturn's own sign it is anyway'.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn and Capricorn is Saturn's own sign.

hindi: बृहस्पति नीच का होता है नेगेटिव मंगल आपका उच्च का होता है पॉजिटिव
says: Labels the two planets at number 10 as opposite poles: debilitated Jupiter is the negative side and exalted Mars the positive side, so he works by strengthening the positive Mars rather than trying to repair Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: The same idea carries to any sign holding one exalted and one debilitated planet: the exalted one is the positive lever and the fallen one the negative. Cancer flips it (Jupiter positive, Mars negative); Libra pairs exalted Saturn with fallen Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, his lever is Mars (also the lagna lord) so the remedy sits naturally on the chart lord.
Derived: lagna Aries, in Cancer the poles flip: exalted Jupiter is positive and fallen Mars negative, so the lever would be Jupiter (yellow), not Mars.
Derived: lagna Taurus, in Libra exalted Saturn is positive and fallen Sun negative, so the lever would be Saturn.

ambiguity: 'नेगेटिव/पॉजिटिव' is his own labelling for dignity, not a classical term.
classical_check: Dignity pairs (exalted versus debilitated) are classical; calling them positive and negative poles for remedy choice is his own.

hindi: यानी मंगल की चीजें य दी जाए लाल रंग की चीजें मीठी चीजें फलती का ज्ञान ना बांटा जाए खाया पिया साथ जाए
says: Remedy for this spot: hand out Mars items, meaning red-coloured things, sweets and fruit (the word 'फलती' is garbled), and share food and drink, rather than giving advice or wisdom, which is Jupiter's currency.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'फलती' may be 'फल' (fruit) or 'फलित' (results); the 'खाया पिया साथ जाए' clause is loose and may mean eating together or sending food along.
classical_check: Red items and sweets (jaggery) for Mars are standard dana; the contrast with giving advice is his own.

hindi: भोजन सारा का सारा मंगल के पास है मंगल के पास सारी दवाइयां है
says: States that in his scheme Mars owns all food and all medicines.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'सारा' is an absolute claim; probably means the main ruler of these things.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Sun is the main health and medicine karaka, the Moon and Venus rule food and drink, and Mars covers surgeons, chemicals and vitality.

hindi: यह पति या पत्नी अपनी पत्नी को अगर अपने हाथ से दवाई देगा ना तो लगेगी
says: Claims that a husband (the line also says 'or wife') who gives medicine to his wife with his own hand will make it work, treating the spouse's hand as a carrier of Mars's healing. Tradition claim, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The pronouns are muddled: 'पति या पत्नी' then 'अपनी पत्नी को'; the next line gives the symmetrical version.
classical_check: Silent; a folk-remedy claim.

hindi: क्या मजेदार बात है डॉक्टर से लिखा के लाओ और अपने पति के हाथ से लो या पत्नी के हाथ से मंगल को पावरफुल करो एक्टिवेट करो सारी दवाइयां मंगल है
says: Practical form of the remedy: get the prescription from the doctor, but receive the medicine from your husband's or wife's hand to power up and activate Mars, since every medicine is Mars. He does not tell anyone to skip treatment.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; folk-remedy claim.

hindi: डॉक्टर बनने के लिए मंगल का पावर होनी बहुत जरूरी चीर फाड़ का मंत्री यही है
says: A strong Mars is essential for becoming a doctor because Mars is the 'minister' of cutting and tearing, meaning surgery.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'पावर' could mean exaltation or just general strength.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of surgeons and cutting, usually together with Sun or Jupiter for the medical profession.

hindi: नेता मंत्री एमएलए एमपी सब कुछ बनाता है मंगल की यहां दृष्टि है पॉजिटिविटी है
says: Mars is credited with producing leaders, ministers, MLAs and MPs, and its aspect at this spot (number 10) is a positive influence.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from where it sits, so the houses it lights up change with the house of the exalted Mars: authority points at 1, 4, 5 from the 10th; domestic and partner houses from the 1st.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mars in the 10th aspects the 1st, 4th and 5th: public authority with a command or political bent; the closest match to his neta claim.
Derived: lagna Capricorn, exalted Mars in the 1st aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th: leadership through personal drive that spills into home, spouse and sudden gains.
Derived: lagna Leo, exalted Mars (4th and 9th lord) in the 6th aspects the 9th, 12th and 1st: wins over rivals and service in public bodies; politics is less direct.

ambiguity: 'यहां' means number 10, which could be sign Capricorn or the tenth house (the career house); here read as the sign. 'दृष्टि' is aspect from Mars sitting there.
classical_check: Mars (with Sun and Rahu) for political power is accepted and the 10th house is status; Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th, consistent with classical drishti.

hindi: शादी करके आएगी लड़की अपने पति को एमपी एमएलए बना देगी नहीं तो कॉलोनी का प्रेसिडेंट तो बना ही देगी अपने आप क्योंकि मंगल एक्टिवेटेड है नेचुरली
says: Prediction: a bride whose Mars is naturally activated at this spot will lift her husband's public standing after marriage, to MP or MLA or at the least colony president. Tradition claim and rhetorical exaggeration.
cells_derived_method: The wife's exalted Mars works through the house it sits in: the 7th makes the partner the carrier of status, the 10th her own career ambition, the 11th gains through networks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Mars (5th and 10th lord) in the 7th: the husband is the channel for her standing; also Manglik-type heat in the marriage.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Mars (1st and 8th lord) in the 10th: her own career drive lifts the couple's public profile.
Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Mars (2nd and 9th lord) in the 11th: gains through family fortune and a wide network that the husband can use.

ambiguity: Whose chart (the bride's own) and what 'activated' means (natal exalted placement or remedy) is not said; MP/MLA is a figure of speech.
classical_check: Classical texts read spouse's rise from the 7th house and Venus or Jupiter; a bride's Mars lifting the husband to office is not a standard rule.

hindi: अगर यह इस प्रकार की चीजें एडिशन करती है तो बहुत फायदा है
says: If she also adds Mars-type things (red items, sweets, a red thread) on top of the natural Mars, the benefit is large; the remedy is layered on the natal strength.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'इस प्रकार की चीजें' is vague and refers back to the Mars items just listed.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the general idea of strengthening a planet by dana and colour.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति यहां पर पड़ा हुआ है 10 नंबर का तो ये कौन सा है कमर का एरिया है
says: Ties number 10 to the waist area of the body: if Jupiter lies at 10, the trouble zone is the waist.
cells_derived_method: He gives only the 10-to-waist link here. Under the classical body map other signs would point elsewhere (Virgo waist and intestines, Leo stomach and heart), so test both maps.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Capricorn: his map says waist and navel, the classical Kalapurusha map says knees; the two maps disagree and need testing.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in Virgo: the classical map gives waist and intestines, matching his stomach theme better than Capricorn does.

ambiguity: 10 may be the sign or the tenth house; he treats it as a body zone either way. His body map is not given in this slice.
classical_check: Differs: in the classical Kalapurusha, Capricorn and the 10th house are the knees, while waist and navel sit with Virgo or Libra.

gist: Meta remark: we are only looking at small sparklers now, details later; knowledge should spread by whatever route.

hindi: तो आपका जुपिटर का स्थान है नाभी है इसका पेट खराब रहेगा
says: Says Jupiter's body place is the navel, so a person with Jupiter troubled at this spot will have a persistently upset stomach. Health claim recorded as tradition, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: The stomach complaint comes with the life topics of the house where the debilitated Jupiter sits: career stress at 10, home and mother at 4.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter (9th and 12th lord) debilitated in the 10th: stomach upset arriving with career strain and weak mentor support.
Derived: lagna Libra, Jupiter (3rd and 6th lord) debilitated in the 4th: digestion linked to domestic stress and the mother's side.

ambiguity: 'नाभी' and the earlier 'कमर' overlap; both are treated as the same abdominal zone.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is classically linked to the liver, abdomen and fat; a navel assignment is his own.

hindi: अगर ये वक्री है तो पेट को खराब नहीं कर रहा उसके गैस्ट्रो गैस्ट्रोइंटेस्टाइनल ट्रैक्ट में यानी कि उसके कोलोन में और स्मल इंटेस्टाइन उसके अंदर खाना ही हजम नहीं होगा
says: If this Jupiter is retrograde the damage goes deeper than the stomach, into the gastrointestinal tract, colon and small intestine, so food will not digest at all. Health claim recorded as tradition, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none: the extra weight comes from retrograde status, not from a different house or sign.
ambiguity: 'पेट को खराब नहीं कर रहा' is garbled and probably means 'not only the stomach'; the literal sense is the opposite.
classical_check: Differs: classically a retrograde planet is stronger (cheshtabala), so 'retrograde makes it worse' is not a classical rule.

hindi: 10 नंबर क्या होता है उच्च का मंगल बृहस्पति या नीच का बैठा है पति से कलेश है कुत्तों की तरह भकता है लड़ाइया करता है ट टपा बहस कोई राय नहीं मिलती
says: At number 10, with exalted Mars and a debilitated Jupiter, the marriage is full of quarrels: constant bickering and barking at each other, no meeting of minds with the husband.
cells_derived_method: The marital friction is shaped by the house of the debilitated Jupiter: at 7 it hits the partnership head-on, at 2 it shows as sharp family speech, at 4 as friction over household peace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter (6th and 9th lord) sits fallen in the 7th beside a strong Mars in its peak sign: direct clashes over beliefs and duties; Mars then aspects the 10th, 1st and 2nd.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, debilitated Jupiter (lagna and 4th lord) in the 2nd: harsh speech and arguments that spill into the husband's family.
Derived: lagna Libra, debilitated Jupiter in the 4th: peace at home is lost over the husband's attitude.

ambiguity: The caption 'उच्च का मंगल बृहस्पति या नीच का' is garbled; the subject of 'भकता है' (who barks) is not clear. A woman's chart is implied because the strife is 'with the husband'.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter is the classical husband karaka for a woman and a fallen Jupiter strains marital harmony.

hindi: यह कमर पर एक लाल धागा बांध लो ऐसे अलग-अलग जगह पर धागे बांधे जाते कमर पर एक लाल धागा बांध लो परमानेंट मंगल की प्लेसमेंट करो
says: Remedy: tie one red thread around the waist (he notes threads are tied at different body places for different planets) as a permanent installation of Mars at this spot.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: A red waist thread for Mars is folk practice; classical Mars remedies are coral, Hanuman worship and red-lentil dana.

hindi: पेट ठीक होना शुरू हो जाएगा दवा लगनी शुरू हो जाएगी जीरो तो होगा नहीं क्योंकि बृहस्पति तो बैठा ही है इसको तो मार नहीं सकते
says: Expected result of the red thread: the stomach starts to heal and medicines begin to work, but the problem will not drop to zero because the debilitated Jupiter is still seated there and cannot be 'killed'. A remedy reduces the natal placement, it never erases it.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Consistent with the classical view that remedies lessen but do not cancel karma-based placements.

hindi: मंगल के बैठने मात्र से आपके झगड़े कम हो जाएंगे पेट की खराबी कम हो जाएगी और ऑटोमेटिक पॉजिटिविटी आ गई
says: Merely seating Mars by the thread is said to cut domestic fights, ease the stomach disorder and bring positivity automatically; one red thread is credited with three benefits.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Silent; effect size is unmeasured.

hindi: सिर्फ एक धागा पहनने से इतना आसान होता है यह है ना चश्मा सिर्फ चश्मा पहनने से जिंदगी सुधर गई हां एक स्विच दबा बत्ती न हो गई हां एक गोली खिलाता है डॉक्टर अगर सही है बुखार उड़ जाता
says: Argues that one thread can change life as simply as spectacles, a light switch or one correct pill curing a fever; the one-formula point is that a small, correctly chosen planetary placement does disproportionate work.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Analogy only; no rule about a specific planet.
classical_check: Silent; a rhetorical argument for simple remedies, with no measured evidence offered.

hindi: य शनि है अगर शनि की प्लेसमेंट भी करते हैं तो अपने घर को नष्ट नहीं होने देगा पकड़ के रखेगा
says: If Saturn is also installed at this spot, Saturn will not let its own house be destroyed; it holds on to whatever it governs here, which keeps things from collapsing.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'अपने घर' may mean Saturn's own sign (Capricorn) or the family home of the person.
classical_check: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn is strong and steadying, which agrees; the thread remedy is his own.

hindi: लेकिन शनि का क्या है सातवा घर है मल्टीपलीसिटी इसलिए बेटर है मंगल को प्लेस किया जाए
says: Objects that Saturn's seat is the seventh, the place of multiplicity (many people, many demands), so Mars is the better planet to install; Saturn's 7th-house nature scatters instead of holding.
cells_derived_method: The seventh is the house of partners and multiplicity; Saturn there is exalted in Libra and own-sign in Capricorn but still works through many parties.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Saturn exalted in the 7th: dignified but dealing with several partners or parties, so his 'multiplicity' fits.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn (7th and 8th lord) in its own sign in the 7th: steady, long-lasting partnerships, which cuts against 'scatter'.

ambiguity: 'शनि का सातवा घर' could mean Saturn's exaltation at 7 (Libra) or the seventh house; the link to the number-10 discussion is not clear.
classical_check: Saturn exalted in Libra (7th sign) is classical; 'multiplicity' for the 7th is his reading, classical texts treat the 7th as spouse and partnership.

hindi: याय बुध प्लेस करेंगे हरा धागा है
says: Alternative remedy: to install Mercury use a green thread, Mercury's colour.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The cell where Mercury is wanted is not named.
classical_check: Green for Mercury is the classical colour association.

hindi: पीला रंग लाना है चार नंबर था तो बृहस्पति को प्लेस करना है पीला धाका डालो
says: For number 4 (Cancer, where Jupiter is exalted) place Jupiter by bringing in yellow: wear a yellow thread.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Jupiter in Cancer shifts meaning by house: at 1 and 4 it forms Hamsa yoga (kendra), at 9 it supports fortune and dharma.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Cancer, exalted Jupiter in the 1st: Hamsa yoga, wisdom and grace in the person; yellow reinforces what is already there.
Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Jupiter in the 4th: Hamsa yoga, domestic comfort and the mother's blessing.
Derived: lagna Scorpio, exalted Jupiter (2nd and 5th lord) in the 9th: fortune, dharma and children's luck.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर था' may be sign 4 (Cancer, Jupiter's exaltation) or house 4; the Jupiter link suggests the sign.
classical_check: Yellow for Jupiter and Cancer as its exaltation are both classical.

hindi: हल्के पीले और लाल की मिक्सिंग वाला सूर्य है
says: Gives the Sun's colour as a mix of light yellow and red (saffron or orange-gold), used to choose the Sun thread.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Sun is classically copper-red or orange-red, so this is close.

hindi: वो तो लाना ही नहीं सातव घर में लाना ही नहीं वो तो आप लेके आए मौत है वो तो वैसे ही आग लगा के रखेगा सूर्य को तो करना ही नहीं
says: Prohibition: never install the Sun (no Sun-coloured thread) in the 7th; he calls it bringing death (figurative, no timing given) because the Sun there already acts like fire and would keep burning the house's matters.
cells_derived_method: The ban is a blanket on the 7th house, but the Sun's strength there changes by sign: fallen in Libra, exalted in Aries, own in Leo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Sun debilitated in the 7th: ego clashes and cold partnership, the case where his ban fits best.
Derived: lagna Libra, Sun exalted in the 7th: strong but hot partnership; a blanket ban looks doubtful here and needs testing.
Derived: lagna Aquarius, Sun in its own sign in the 7th: authority in partnership with ego friction.

ambiguity: 'सातव घर' could be the 7th house or sign 7 (Libra, the Sun's fall). 'मौत' is a figure of speech, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Sun in the 7th is classically harmful to marriage and the Sun is fallen in Libra, so this broadly agrees.

hindi: ऐसे घर में एक्टिवेट वाइट धागा लगाओ प्योर वाइट चचंदा मामा को एक्टिवेट करो
says: Instead, in such a 7th-type spot activate the Moon ('chanda mama') with a pure white thread.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'ऐसे घर' is taken to be the 7th just mentioned; not explicit.
classical_check: White for the Moon is classical (pearl, white cloth).

hindi: आपके उस धागे मात्र से काम होगा जब हमें लॉन्ग टर्म इफेक्ट चाहिए होते तो हम टैटू बनवाते हैं परमानेंट कलर डाल के रख दिया
says: States the thread alone does the job, and for a longer-lasting effect a tattoo is the permanent version: colour fixed on the body as a lasting planetary installation.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: The tattoo is offered as an analogy and as a possible route; he does not say which colour or planet.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text prescribes tattoos as a planetary remedy.

hindi: जब वास्तु में नीले पीले हरे गुलाबी कलर से कुछ होता है तो इससे क्यों नहीं होता 100% होता है
says: Argues by analogy: if colours (blue, yellow, green, pink) in vastu are accepted as having effects, coloured threads must too, and he asserts it works 100%, an unmeasured claim.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Colour remedies belong to later vastu and folk upay traditions; classical Jyotish uses gems, mantra and dana and never guarantees 100%.

gist: Praises thread-healing as a very new, beautiful branch that should spread and be learned by whatever route.

hindi: लोग कहते हैं बहुत महंगा पुखराज नीलम बता दिया सस्ते वाले धागे हैं पहनो और ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस को फॉलो करो
says: Answers the complaint that astrologers prescribe expensive Pukhraj (yellow sapphire) and Neelam (blue sapphire): wear the cheap coloured threads instead and follow 'human consciousness', his inner-awareness approach.
cells_derived_method: none

Derived: lagna Capricorn, Venus (5th and 10th lord) in its own sign in the 10th: Malavya yoga, style or fashion becomes a public profession.
Derived: lagna Virgo, exalted Venus (2nd and 9th lord) in the 7th: Malavya yoga, a magnetic partner and a dress sense that draws clients or a spouse.

ambiguity: 'पावरफुल प्लेसमेंट' is not defined (dignity, house, or aspects).
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a strong Venus, especially in a kendra, gives beauty, charm and taste (Malavya yoga).

gist: Jokingly calls Saturn 'Munna', our Munna Maharaj.
Garbled line on what Saturn is the god of ('जी का देवता है चिजी'); later lines suggest long life but it cannot be confirmed.

hindi: सारे शरीर की हड्डियां पूरा स्केलेटन शनि के पास है

cells_derived_method: none

hindi: आपकी लाइफ में वर्कर्स है काम है लोग हैं आप भीड़ सम्मेलन डेवलप कर लेते हैं आप बहुत बड़ा

cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: Saturn is not re-named in this sentence; it follows directly from the skeleton line.

hindi: आप मौत को मात दे देते हैं लाइफ की जिंदा रहने की सालों साल की क्षमता
says: A strong Saturn gives staying power, the capacity to stay alive for years upon years, 'beating death' in his phrase.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: A general longevity statement about Saturn, not a lifespan prediction.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the classical ayushkaraka (longevity karaka).

hindi: जिसका शनि पावरफुल हो जाए आठवें घर में वह मरता ही नहीं आसानी से चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए
says: When Saturn is powerful in the 8th house the person does not die easily whatever happens. A longevity tendency in hyperbole; no age or date is given.
cells_derived_method: The house is fixed at 8; 'powerful' is read as own sign (Capricorn, Aquarius) or exalted (Libra). The lagna decides which houses Saturn rules, which shapes the side effects of the long life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, Saturn (8th and 9th lord) in its own sign in the 8th: staying power and slow recoveries, with fortune tied to hidden matters.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Saturn (7th and 8th lord) in its own sign in the 8th: long life indicated while partnerships are strained.
Derived: lagna Pisces, exalted Saturn (11th and 12th lord) in the 8th: longevity with gains through hidden sources and heavy 12th-lord expenses.

ambiguity: 'पावरफुल' is not defined; 'मरता ही नहीं' is exaggeration.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 8th is classically said to give long life, though with troubles.

gist: Anecdote: doctors wonder why such people do not die, and you tell them to go but they stay because it is their own will.

hindi: अब ये सारे ग्रह जो आपके हैं जब जब जब बहुत लंबी लिस्ट है यह समझने का जब जब जब यह ग्रह अपने अपने स्थान के अनुसार वक्री हो जाते हैं तो पंगा डालते हैं
says: Whenever these planets turn retrograde, according to their own place in the chart they create trouble; there is a long list to understand.
cells_derived_method: The trouble depends on the cell: it shows in the life area of the house and in the way the sign shapes the planet; the same retrograde planet behaves differently in each of the 144 cells.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, retrograde Jupiter (5th and 8th lord) in its own sign in the 5th: unorthodox learning and delayed or reversed outcomes with children and studies.
Derived: lagna Aries, retrograde Saturn (10th and 11th lord) in its own sign in the 10th: work pressure that repeats, tasks redone and delayed recognition.
Derived: lagna Taurus, retrograde Mercury (2nd and 5th lord) in its own sign in the 2nd: speech corrected or reversed, financial talks revisited.

ambiguity: 'पंगा डालना' is not defined; the mechanism is promised for later in the class.
classical_check: Differs: classically a retrograde planet has extra strength (cheshtabala) and gives unusual or delayed results; 'retrograde makes trouble' is his own framing.

gist: Rhetorical question: how does a retrograde planet cause trouble? The answer is deferred.

hindi: तो हमारे पास ना दो ग्रह और हमारे हैं ही यह समझना पड़ेगा हमारे सूर्य देव भी हैं और चंदा मामा भी है यह वक्र नहीं होते अलग लिस्ट में
says: Besides the retrograde-capable planets there are two more, the Sun and the Moon, which never go retrograde and sit in a separate list.
cells_derived_method: none
ambiguity: 'वक्र' is read as 'वक्री'.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Moon never turn retrograde; Rahu and Ketu (mean nodes) are always retrograde, which he does not mention here.

hindi: सूर्य जो है सूर्य हमारा 10 वर्ष की आयु तक पावर पकड़ता है पूरी चंद्रमा पांच में पकड़ लेता है
says: The Sun gains its full power by age 10 and the Moon by age 5; they mature in early childhood.
cells_derived_method: none

classical_check: Differs: the commonly quoted maturity ages are Sun 22 and Moon 24; his 10 and 5 describe childhood stages instead.

hindi: पैदा होते ही बच्चे का चंद्रमा खेल खिलौने मस्ती हा हा बड़ा प्रेम उसको देख उसको देख के ऐसी सुख ऐसे आनंद मिलता है
says: A newborn's Moon phase means play, toys and fun, and a lovable child whom everyone enjoys looking at; he ties the Moon to infancy and the joy it gives others.
cells_derived_method: none
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Moon is karaka of infancy, the mother, and tenderness.

gist: Emotional elaboration on how sweet and beautiful a baby or daughter is, repeating the previous point.

hindi: मंगल जो है ये 28 वर्ष में पूरा बड़ा होता है बुध 32 में पूरा बड़ा होता है बृहस्पति 16 साल से शुक्र 27 शनि 36 राहु 42 और केतु 48
says: Gives full-maturity ages: Mars 28, Mercury 32, Jupiter 16, Venus 27, Saturn 36, Rahu 42 and Ketu 48; each planet's results peak only from that age.
cells_derived_method: The age is per planet, not per cell; the house and sign it sits in decide which life area wakes up at that age.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in its own sign in the 5th: learning ability and children's matters ripen around age 16 on this reading.

Derived: lagna Aries, exalted Saturn in the 7th: partnership results mature from about age 36.

ambiguity: 'बृहस्पति 16 साल से' could mean from age 16 or by age 16.
classical_check: Mostly agrees with the commonly quoted list (Jupiter 16, Mars 28, Mercury 32, Saturn 36, Rahu 42, Ketu 48); his Venus 27 differs from the usual 25.

gist: Neuroscience aside: the neocortex (front brain) finishes developing around age 25, with a few fast-developing exceptions.

hindi: लेकिन 25 साल तक सीखता रहता है इंसान इसीलिए उसको पहले ब्रह्मचर्य अवस्था क गई है 25 50 75 और 100

cells_derived_method: none

classical_check: Agrees: the four ashramas in 25-year blocks (brahmacharya, grihastha, vanaprastha, sannyasa) are traditional.

hindi: वैसे य विंशोत्तरी दशा के हिसाब से 30 60 90 और 120 होता है पर मोटे तौर पे
says: By Vimshottari dasha reckoning the same four blocks would end at 30, 60, 90 and 120, but roughly he uses the 25-year blocks.
cells_derived_method: none

gist: Parenting point: whatever is fed into a child sticks, and after about 25 the brain is set, so children of that age must be handled carefully.
Repeats that the Moon develops by age 5 and the Sun by 10, and so on.

hindi: मान लेते पढ़ाई के क्षेत्र में बच्चा रॉकेट की तरह चल रहा है रॉकेट अगरचे तो उसकी मंगल की दृष्टि है पढ़ाई से संबंधित

hindi: अब अगर मंगल के पास आपकी पढ़ाई है तो मंगल की एक बड़ी मजेदार क्षमता है आपको पढ़ने लिखने की जरूरत नहीं है आप वैसे ही पास हो जाओगे
says: If your studies come under Mars, he says Mars has a curious power: you do not need to read and write much and you will pass anyway.

hindi: अगर मंगल का पढ़ाई से लिंक हो गया तो मेहनत कम करो

hindi: जुपिटर आपका वक्री हो गया बीच-बीच में साल भर में दो चार बार पीछे आगे पीछे आगे होता रहता है

hindi: अब जन्म के बाद वक्री प्लेनेट में आप पैदा हुए तो जब जब अंतरिक्ष में वक्री होगा उल्टा चलेगा

hindi: लेकिन जब तक वह एक राशि में आगे आगे घूमता है और आगे घूमता है तो मोना और मिनल की तरह धरती तो घूम चुकी तो धरती के लिए वक्री हो जाता है

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical judgement always combines sign, house, lordship and planetary friendship (BPHS).

hindi: सूर्य दस्तक है इसके बाद बच्चों को चश्मे लगने का कार्यक्रम शुरू होता है
says: After the Moon phase the Sun 'knocks' as the next planet in a child's life, and that is when children start getting spectacles; he ties the Sun's arrival to eyesight trouble in childhood.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a general age-sequence claim, not tied to a house or sign.

classical_check: Silent on childhood phases; the Sun as the planet of the eyes is classical (see next row).

hindi: सूर्य नेत्र है
says: The Sun is the karaka of the eyes, so trouble with the Sun shows up as eye and vision problems.
cells_derived_method: The Sun's eye effect is read through the house it sits in (2nd and 12th are the classical eye houses) and its sign strength: strong sign means strong sight, weak sign means weak sight by tradition.

Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries); bright, strong eyes and a commanding look by tradition.

classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is the eye karaka in BPHS, with the 2nd house as the right eye and the 12th as the left eye.

hindi: पेट की खराबी बैठ जाती है अगर जुपिटर आपका वक्री है आपका पेट में हाजमा ही ठीक नहीं रहता
says: Health claim, recorded only: if your Jupiter is retrograde, a stomach disorder settles in and digestion is never right.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the claim varies with the house and sign: the 5th and 6th are the classical stomach and ailment houses, a strong Jupiter sign softens it, a weak sign hardens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 5th (lagna Leo); sign strength softens it, so only mild digestive sensitivity by his logic.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter in Taurus in the 6th (lagna Sagittarius); the ailment house with a Venus sign, where his claim would bite hardest.
Derived: retrograde Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries); exaltation outweighs retrogression by common practice, so little digestive trouble is expected.

ambiguity: He does not say whether it applies to any retrograde Jupiter or only to a badly placed one.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is karaka of the liver and fat area in classical texts, but no retrograde-specific digestion rule is given in BPHS. Medical claim, tradition only.

gist: He admits he does not know why this happens and says this remark is only about Jupiter.

hindi: नेप्चून का भी यही हाल होता है वोह भी यही करता है
says: Neptune behaves the same way as Jupiter: a retrograde Neptune likewise upsets the stomach and digestion.
cells_derived_method: Same logic as for Jupiter: the house (5th or 6th for stomach and ailments) and the sign Neptune occupies decide how strong the digestive effect is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Neptune in Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra); Pisces is the sign Neptune is associated with in his scheme, so the digestive claim would be strongest in the ailment house.
Derived: retrograde Neptune in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces); a watery sign in the stomach house, so a sensitive stomach by his logic.

ambiguity: He says 'the same condition' without repeating the word retrograde; it is assumed he means a retrograde Neptune.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is outside the classical seven-planet system.

hindi: मंगल वक्री हो गया 28 के बाद गड़बड़ करेगा
says: A retrograde Mars in the birth chart starts creating trouble after age 28, the age at which Mars matures.
cells_derived_method: The age is fixed; the area of trouble follows the house Mars sits in (7th partnership, 10th career, 4th home) and the sign shows how violent or controlled it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn); after 28 the trouble would centre on partner and partnership friction.
Derived: retrograde Mars in its own sign Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer); sign strength helps, but after 28 the friction would be about work and authority.
Derived: retrograde Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo); after 28 the trouble would show at home and in property matters.

ambiguity: The sentence begins on the last word of the previous caption chunk; 'गड़बड़' (trouble) is not specified.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat a retrograde planet as strong (cheshta bala) and intense, not simply bad; the 28-year maturity of Mars is from later popular lists, not BPHS.

hindi: मंगल ने पावर पकड़ रखी है आग लगा रखी है शादी नहीं होने देता है 28 तक
says: A powerful, fiery Mars holds the power and keeps the fire burning, so it does not let marriage happen until about age 28.
cells_derived_method: Marriage delay from Mars is strongest in the classical Kuja-dosha houses (1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 12) and weaker elsewhere; the sign (own, exalted or debilitated) changes the intensity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer); a classic Kuja-dosha placement, so marriage would wait until Mars matures at 28.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo); another dosha house, a delay with intensity in the marriage.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini); not a Kuja-dosha house, so the classical test would not expect a delay although his planet-wide rule says it does.

ambiguity: '28 तक' may belong to the next sentence; it is unclear whether this is about a retrograde Mars only or any strong Mars.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in certain houses delaying or troubling marriage is the classical Kuja-dosha idea; the fixed age 28 is not classical.

hindi: मंगल क्या है अग्नि फ्यूजन आगे क्या होगा डीएनए का फ्यूजन होगा
says: Mars is fire and fusion; the next step of that fusion is the fusion of DNA, meaning the union of two people and the passing on of genes through marriage and children.
cells_derived_method: Fusion themes would show through the houses of union and children (5th, 7th, 8th); the sign decides whether the drive is controlled or violent.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius); strong fusion drive linked to children and creativity.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus); an intense bonding drive, with marriage as the main fusion event.

ambiguity: It is not explicit whether 'DNA fusion' refers to marriage itself or to the child; the '28 तक' at the start belongs to the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars as fire and as the planet of blood and drive is classical; the DNA reading is his modern gloss.

hindi: मंगल के दम पर प्रॉपर्टीज बनती है जायदाद बनती है
says: Properties and estates are created on the strength of Mars; Mars is the engine of property-making.
cells_derived_method: Property results follow the house Mars occupies (4th land and home, 10th and 11th income-based buying) and its sign strength: strong sign builds property, weak sign loses or strains it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra); strong Mars in the house of land, so property gains.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo); property tends to be lost or bought abroad with difficulty.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer); property comes through profession, construction or authority.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of land and immovable property in BPHS.

hindi: शनि उसके अंदर बताता है कितनी बनेगी मल्टीप्लाई करूंगा
says: Within what Mars builds, Saturn shows how much will actually be created, acting like a multiplier on Mars's property result.
cells_derived_method: The multiplier depends on Saturn's house and dignity: a strong Saturn in a wealth or gains house scales property up, a weak Saturn in a dusthana caps or delays it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars is exalted in Capricorn in the 4th (lagna Libra). Saturn sits in its own sign there too, so both are strong in the land house and a large property total follows by his logic.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 11th (lagna Sagittarius); a strong multiplier of gains, so a Mars-built property grows large over time.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo); a weak Saturn in a dusthana caps or delays what Mars builds.

ambiguity: 'मल्टीप्लाई करूंगा' ('I will multiply') is garbled and he does not say whether the Mars-Saturn link is by conjunction, aspect or dasha order.
classical_check: Silent as stated: classical texts make Saturn the karaka of delay and longevity, not a property multiplier.

hindi: भूमि का संपत्ति का माल एक सारा मंगल है
says: Land, immovable wealth and goods (the whole 'maal') all belong to Mars as the single significator.
cells_derived_method: none for the karaka list itself; the house Mars sits in tells which asset type (4th land and house, 2nd stored goods) and its sign tells how well it holds.
ambiguity: 'माल' could mean goods and stock or simply wealth.
classical_check: Agrees on land and property (Mars as bhumi karaka); extending it to goods and stock is his wider reading.

hindi: भूमि पुत्र होते है
says: Mars is the Bhumiputra, the son of Earth, so land and earth qualities belong to it.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a name or epithet of Mars, not a house or sign rule.
ambiguity: The subject is not spoken (plural 'होते है'); Mars is assumed from the surrounding sentences.
classical_check: Agrees: Bhauma, Kuja and Bhumiputra are classical names of Mars.

hindi: चूहा ये मंगल के कारण से भूमि के अंदर रहता है
says: The rat is a Mars animal: it lives inside the ground because of Mars's earth connection.
cells_derived_method: none: an animal association for Mars, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: the rat as a Mars animal is not in BPHS (the rat is Ganesha's vehicle in popular tradition).

hindi: तो चूहे को प्रसन्नता दो मंगल प्रसन्न होता है
says: Remedy claim: keeping the rat pleased (not harming it) pleases Mars.
cells_derived_method: none: a folk remedy for Mars, not tied to a house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say how to 'give happiness' to the rat, and the next line is a joke about trapping and releasing it.
classical_check: Silent: a rat remedy for Mars is not in BPHS; it is a popular tradition claim.

gist: Joke: who will make the rat happy? People trap it, say release it in the jungle or chop it up, and run all their experiments on it; 'anyway, this is Mars'.

hindi: मित्र आपके 28 साल की जज के बाद आपको मित्र देगा
says: Mars, as the planet of friendship, gives you friends after age 28 once it matures.
cells_derived_method: Friends come through the house Mars occupies (11th friends, 3rd close circle, 7th partner) and the sign shows how strong or weak that friendship is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in its own sign Aries in the 11th (lagna Gemini); after 28 a large circle of energetic friends and gains.
Derived: Mars in its own sign Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo); after 28 friendships come through siblings, sport and shared effort.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn); friendship with the partner is weak, so the promised friends do not arrive.

ambiguity: 'जज' is garbled (likely 'उम्र'); the first 'मित्र' may be a vocative (my friend); the giver of friends is assumed to be Mars.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars is karaka of brothers and courage (3rd house), and friends are judged from the 11th house, not from Mars's maturity.

hindi: मित्र सबसे प्रथम मित्र आपका पति या पत्नी है
says: Your husband or wife is the very first friend in your life; the friendship he is talking about starts with the spouse.
cells_derived_method: By classical logic the spouse is read from the 7th house, its lord and the karakas Venus and Jupiter, so this friendship is judged there; the 7th sign gives its style.
ambiguity: He does not name a house or planet in this sentence; the link to Mars and the 7th house comes from the surrounding lines.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 7th house is the spouse house in all classical texts; calling the spouse the first friend is his framing.

hindi: यदि आपकी मित्रता का खाना खराब है तो पति-पत्नी में रिश्ता तो होता है बच्चे तो पैदा होते हैं मित्रता नहीं होती
says: If the 'friendship box' (khana, house) of the chart is damaged, husband and wife still have a relationship and even children, but real friendship between them is missing.
cells_derived_method: The damaged box is not named; if it is the 7th, an afflicting planet there decides the style, and if it is the 11th the damage shows as few or critical friends. The sign of that house shapes the flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if the friendship box is the 7th and Mars is debilitated in Cancer there (lagna Capricorn); marriage and children happen but companionship is thin.
Derived: if the friendship box is the 11th and it is afflicted in Virgo (lagna Scorpio); friends are few and critical, so the home lacks easy warmth.

ambiguity: He says 'खाना' (box, house) but not which house; it could be the 7th (spouse), the 11th (friends) or Mars's own box.
classical_check: Partly agrees: affliction of the 7th house giving a marriage without harmony is classical; the 'friendship box' as a separate unit is his own term.

hindi: तो सर रेट्रोग्रेड होगा तो 28 के बाद ढीला पड़ेगा मित्र छीनेगा और अलाव करेगा
says: If Mars is retrograde, after 28 the friendship gets slack: it takes friends away and causes separation (the caption 'alaav' is read as 'alag', apart).

classical_check: Silent: no classical text gives a retrograde Mars losing friends after 28; classical vakri Mars is read as strong and aggressive.

hindi: लेकिन अगर आपने मूंगा डाल लिया इसका इसका स्टोन है

classical_check: Agrees with the standard navaratna scheme (coral for Mars); classical gem texts add that a gem should be worn only if the planet is helpful for the lagna.

hindi: मूंगा मोती हो गया चंद्रमा का
says: Pearl (moti) is the Moon's gem, listed right after coral for Mars.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-to-gem mapping, not house or sign dependent.

hindi: सूर्य का हो गया माणिक्य
says: Ruby (manikya) is the Sun's gem.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-to-gem mapping, not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Agrees: ruby is the Sun's gem in the navaratna scheme.

hindi: यदि आपने इसका सूर्य तो बकरी होता ही नहीं लेकिन दोष होते हैं इसलिए माणिक पहनाते हैं
says: The Sun never turns retrograde, but it does carry doshas (afflictions), which is why ruby is prescribed for it; the caption word 'bakri' (goat) is read as 'vakri' (retrograde).

classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Moon are never retrograde in classical texts (Rahu and Ketu are always retrograde).

hindi: अगर आपने मूंगा पहन लिया तो मूंगा किस कलर का किस शेप का ये काउंट करेगा वही महंगा सस्ता होता है
says: If you wear coral, the colour and shape of the particular piece count, and those are what make a stone dear or cheap; he implies that quality decides how well it works.

hindi: याद रखें एक चीज को सबसे पहले समझ ले अपने इलाज में कंजूसी नहीं करनी

says: The pandit's claim (tradition): paying him a fee hurts, and that pain is deducted from your planet's quota of suffering; if you give in the name of the Supreme you avoid eight times as much, about 40,000, that you would otherwise lose to doctors. cells_derived_method: none: a general remedy-payment claim, not dependent on house or sign.

classical_check: Silent: dakshina to Brahmins in graha-shanti rites is classical, but the 'planetary quota' and eight-fold arithmetic are his own.

hindi: क्योंकि आप हमें देंगे तो ऐसे देंगे चलो यार परमात्मा कृपा करे डॉक्टर को आप देंगे साले कसाई
says: He explains the difference in how the money is given: you pay the pandit with a prayer-like 'let God be kind', but you pay the doctor while cursing him as a butcher; the willing, devotional giving is what matters.

hindi: सिर्फ हम ही अकेले हैं जिसको 1/8 हिस्सा देना पड़ेगा लेकिन दर्द तो होगा तो पंडित को देते हुए भी दर्द होगा तो ग्रह कटेगा

says: It is your own planet's allotted suffering that gets used up: the planet is bound to deliver its pain, so it will, and the payment simply settles part of it.
cells_derived_method: none: a general idea about planetary karma, no house or sign is named.

hindi: जब पैसे आते हैं 0000 खुशी नहीं होती यह वाली खुशी दी ना उसने तो तो वो थोड़ा दर्द भी देगा उफ 40000 लुट गए हे भगवान
says: A planet that gives the joy of money coming in also hands out an equal measure of pain, the 'oh God, 40,000 gone' moment when the money leaves; joys and sorrows come as a pair.

hindi: तो अगर आप 40 आए प खुश नहीं हुए तो 40 जाने प दुख भी नहीं होगा
says: If a gain does not make you happy, a loss of the same size will not make you sad; staying even-minded when money arrives takes the sting out when it leaves.
cells_derived_method: none: it is an equanimity principle, not house or sign dependent.

classical_check: Silent: this is a practical philosophy, not a classical rule.

says: For a person who stays unmoved, the planet will not bother handing out small blows or small pleasures up to about the 40,000 level, so both are cancelled out.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is involved.

hindi: 32 का बुध चलेगा 16 बृहस्पति 27 का शुक्र 36 42 ये आपके प्लेनेट के पकने का उम्र है
says: He gives the ages at which planets mature (ripen): Mercury at 32, Jupiter at 16, Venus at 27, and then 36 and 42 with the planet names not spoken; Mars was given as 28 earlier.

hindi: जिसके बाद आपको इन चीजों का ज्ञान आता है
says: After a planet's ripening age you gain real knowledge and understanding of the subjects that planet rules, so the maturity age marks when its lessons are learned.

hindi: आपको अपग्रेड करना है बात दूसरी है नहीं तो पत्थर वही पत्थर 100 साल चलेगा इसलिए एक ही बार बढ़िया पहनो

hindi: बच्चा को चल रहा आजकल नया ले भैया नीलम काम नहीं कर रहा बदल दोगे

hindi: तयारी कर क् कर बृहस्पति यूपीएससी की तैयारी कर रहे और क्लर्क की जॉब प आ गए उसमें शनि महाराज का रोल है

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn limits, delays and reduces results in all classical texts.

hindi: कई लोग मंगल वाली शेप में पहनते कुछ अलग होता है ट्रायंगल शेप की टशन होती है ना

hindi: य भी बड़ी मजेदार बात है जो रेक्टेंगल शेप है वो ईस्ट की है ट्रायंगल शेप है वो हमारे रेड जोन की है

hindi: अब इस जन्म पत्रिका में 29 डिग्री का लगन है सबसे बड़ा पंगा

hindi: अब यहां पर दो नंबर की राशि भी काम कर रही है और तीन भी करेगी तो
says: In this chart the first house is worked on by sign 2 (Taurus) and also by sign 3 (Gemini), so the house is multi-sign and both signs carry influence.

Derived: Taurus holds only one degree of the first house, so it is the minor share, yet he says it also works.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut off at 'तो'; the 'two and three' are sign numbers, Taurus and Gemini.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: house spans that cross sign boundaries are recognised in bhava chalit and sripati methods, where a house takes parts of two signs.

hindi: हमारा पंगा क्या हो गया दो बटा यह हमारा हो गया दो बती
says: He names the complication of this chart 'do-bati' (two over three): the ascendant sits at the edge of sign 2 (Taurus) and sign 3 (Gemini), so the first house is shared by two signs.
cells_derived_method: With the ascendant at 29 degrees Taurus, an equal-house division gives house 1 from 29 degrees Taurus to 29 degrees Gemini, so one degree of Taurus and 29 degrees of Gemini; the reading uses both sign lords, Venus and Mercury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: first house read as Taurus (lagna Taurus); Venus is the lord, steady and sensual, and this is the minor share by degrees.
Derived: first house read as Gemini (lagna Gemini); Mercury is the lord, restless and talkative, and this is the major share by degrees.

ambiguity: 'दो बटा' is garbled and is read as 'two by three' (sign 2 and sign 3); which degree the ascendant is at is given earlier (29 degrees).
classical_check: Agrees in principle: a lagna at a sign boundary (sandhi lagna) is recognised and calls for checking both signs.

gist: Pun on 'do-bati': two cups of tea split among three, and he calls this a new research subject.

hindi: दो बती यानी तीन नंबर और दो नंबर चलेगी आपको
says: 'Do-bati' means that both sign 3 and sign 2 will run for the native, so the chart has to be read with both signs working on the first house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: house 6 runs from 29 degrees Libra to 29 degrees Scorpio, so Scorpio holds 29 of its 30 degrees and is the major sign of the 6th.
Derived: house 7 runs from 29 degrees Scorpio to 29 degrees Sagittarius, so Sagittarius holds 29 degrees and is the major sign of the 7th.

classical_check: Agrees in principle: bhava chalit and sripati readings give a house a share of two signs.

hindi: बहुत बहुत कुछ सीखने के बाद भी जब तक प्रैक्टिस नहीं करोगे कभी भी जिंदगी में खोपड़े में चल नहीं पाएगा कि पूरी कुंडली आपने दो नंबर से भी घुमा दी और तीन से भी घुमा दी और यहीं से निकाल लिया हाथ हाथ एक्टिवेशन किसका है

classical_check: Partly agrees: classical practice also tests both lagnas when birth time is doubtful; the 'whose activation' step is his own.

hindi: अब यहां पर पंगा क्या आ रहा है दूसरे घर में अगर हम नेप्चून और यूरेनस को हटा दें तो कोई पंगा ही नहीं है

hindi: अब यूरेनस कह रहा है अपनी राशि का इंद्र मैं सातवां घर खराब नहीं होने दूंगा मौत हो जाए भले

classical_check: Silent: Uranus is outside the classical system; a planet in its own sign protecting its house is a classical idea.

hindi: नेपच्यून कह रहा है मौत होके रहेगी मैं नीच का हूं यहां

hindi: अब य राहु केतु मंगल में ढूंढते मंगल की अगर यह दोनों ना देखे जाए तो मंगल की पूर्ण दृष्टि है

hindi: कभी भी जिंदगी में स्टमक रिलेटेड कोई इ नहीं होना चाहि इंसान को इनको पेट की समस्या देगा शादी खराब करेगा

hindi: और मंगल की राशि है नीच का ही है तो खराब तो करके छोड़ेगा

hindi: य लगन 28 29 डिग्री का है अब जितने ग्रह 29 से पीछे के हैं यह सारे के सारे उसके अंदर है जो आगे वे आगे भाग जाएंगे
