says: Enjoyment will be plentiful: without studying, this combination makes the person a king while he simply sits, so study is not needed, only pleasure.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named in this sentence.
ambiguity: The subject of 'राजा बनाता है' is not spoken; it is read as the Venus-Pluto pair. 'राजा' is figurative for wealth and comfort.
classical_check: Silent: Venus and Pluto together are not classical; the idea of ease without study is his claim.

hindi: ये शुक्र पढ़ने नहीं देगा जिंदगी में
says: This Venus will not allow studying in life; it pulls the person toward pleasure and away from books.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named.
ambiguity: The sentence crosses the caption chunk boundary at 'देगा'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted Venus in the 5th can distract from study; the absolute claim is his own.

hindi: शनि बैठा सातवें घर में अर्निंग 101 पर होगी
says: With Saturn sitting in the 7th house, earnings will be at 101 percent, meaning very strong income. This is an income claim, recorded only and not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the earnings claim follows Saturn's dignity in the 7th: exalted or own sign helps, debilitated hurts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries); a strong Saturn, so earnings through partnership and trade are firm.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer); steady, disciplined earnings through dealings and partners.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra); the earnings claim weakens, with friction in partnerships.

ambiguity: This can be a case people mis-read from the main chart; it is not clear whether he means the house after chalit; '101 पर' is read as 'percent'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn in the 7th is classically linked with gain through business dealings, though delay in marriage dominates; the 101 percent figure is his.

gist: Garbled lines about Saturn sitting seventh from itself, running ahead, and a 'professor' who takes problems.

hindi: तो इसकी दसव पर दृष्टि है
says: So Saturn's aspect falls on the 10th, meaning its 10th aspect or the 10th house.
cells_derived_method: none: it is not clear which house Saturn sits in.
ambiguity: 'दसव पर' may mean its 10th aspect or the 10th house; 'इसकी' is read as Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees that the 10th is one of Saturn's special aspects (3rd, 7th, 10th).

hindi: अब आप मजे का योग देखें शनि यहां देख रहा है सूरज यहां देख रहा है दोनों एक दूसरे के घर में बैठे और दोनों ने अपने अपने घर को पकड़ रखा है
says: A fun yoga: Saturn and the Sun each sit in the other's house, an exchange (parivartana), and each aspects its own house, so both hold on to their own houses.
cells_derived_method: The Sun sits in Saturn's sign (Capricorn or Aquarius) and Saturn in the Sun's sign Leo; the houses where this falls decide the area: 4th and 9th for home and luck, 1st and 7th for self and partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Leo in the 4th with the Sun in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus); exchange of home and fortune houses.
Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 9th with Saturn in Leo in the 4th (lagna Taurus); fortune and home are tied together.
Derived: Sun in Aquarius in the 7th with Saturn in Leo in the 1st (lagna Leo); exchange between self and partner houses.

ambiguity: Which houses these two sit in is not named ('यहां'); the signs are the Sun and Saturn exchange pair, with either Capricorn or Aquarius for Saturn's side.
classical_check: Agrees: parivartana yoga between two planets is a classical strong yoga; Sun and Saturn are natural enemies, so the result is mixed.

hindi: ना तो कहते मैं छोडूंगा ना कहते नष्ट होने दूंगा गजब कॉमिनेशन है
says: Neither planet says 'I will leave' and neither says 'I will let it be destroyed', so each protects its own house, and he calls it a wonderful combination.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named in this sentence.
ambiguity: The subject is carried from the previous sentence and is read as the Sun-Saturn pair.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a parivartana yoga makes both planets hold and strengthen each other's houses.

hindi: यद य व्यक्ति विदेश चला जाए ना रॉकेट है इसको विदेश से भी धन आएगा विदेश से गिफ्ट आए
says: If this person goes abroad he will shoot up like a rocket, and money and gifts will come from abroad. This is an income claim, recorded only and not advice.
cells_derived_method: none: no house or sign is named; the foreign link would be read from the 9th and 12th houses.
ambiguity: 'यद य' is a garbled start for 'अगर'; the cause is read as the Sun-Saturn exchange.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts link a strong 9th and 12th and Saturn with life abroad; the 'rocket' claim is his.

hindi: सूर्य शनि जिसकी कुंडली में साथ है मोटे तौर पर समझ लो सूर यदि दसवा है सातवा सातवा है चौथा है और भाव और तीसरे और शनि की दृष्टि सूर्य पर है वो
says: A broad rule for charts where the Sun and Saturn are together or Saturn aspects the Sun: it applies when the Sun is in the 10th, 7th, 4th or 3rd house; the sentence is cut off before the result is stated.
cells_derived_method: The effect would depend on the Sun's house: 10th career and status, 7th partnerships, 4th home, 3rd effort; the sign changes its strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) with Saturn's aspect; high status tempered by delay and hard work.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius) with Saturn's aspect; a dignified but cold partnership.
Derived: Sun in Scorpio in the 4th (lagna Leo) with Saturn's aspect; a heavy, secretive home life.

ambiguity: The sentence is truncated at the chunk end and the result is missing; 'सातवा सातवा' is a stutter; the houses may be the Sun's or the Sun-Saturn pair's.
classical_check: Silent as stated: Sun-Saturn conjunction and aspect are classically a mixed, delaying combination.

hindi: व्यक्ति विदेश सटल होता है 99 पर अगर योग डिस्टर्ब तो इसको विदेशों से भी बहुत समान आता है ऑटोमेटिक
says: He says a person with the foreign-settlement yoga settles abroad with near certainty, and that even when that yoga is disturbed, a lot of goods and belongings still arrive from foreign countries on their own; the yoga itself is not named in this sentence.
cells_derived_method: none; the yoga is not named, so no cell can be derived. Classically foreign links are read from the 12th, 9th and 3rd houses and their lords, but he states none of this here.
ambiguity: The '99' is probably '99 percent' or garbled; the yoga itself was defined before this chunk, so the cause is unknown.
classical_check: Classical texts give foreign-settlement combinations through the 12th and 9th houses and Rahu; this sentence names none, so it neither agrees nor differs.

gist: Filler transition: the planets keep going round and round, then he turns back to the sample chart on screen.

hindi: अब हम देख के चले लगन में यह तीसरा घर खाली है और यहां केपी चार्ट में य इतने सारे चौधरी बैठ गए
says: Looking at the sample chart, he points out that the 3rd house is empty in the lagna (D1) chart, yet in the KP chart the same house holds a crowd of planets; so one person's chart can show a house empty in one system and heavily occupied in another.
cells_derived_method: House occupancy differs between the sign-based D1 chart and the cusp-based KP chart, because KP houses are unequal and start at the cusp, so a planet can fall into the next house. A house topic then fires only in the system where planets really sit: the 3rd house (courage, siblings, effort) empty in D1 but loaded in KP would be read as active in KP.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with lagna Aries, Gemini holds the 3rd house; if KP cusps place Mars and Mercury here, sibling and effort themes show up strongly in KP although D1 looks empty.
Derived: with lagna Scorpio, Capricorn is the 3rd house; a crowd here in KP would push ambition-driven, disciplined effort that the empty D1 3rd does not show.
Derived: with lagna Leo, Libra is the 3rd house; a KP crowd here would make courage and communication work through partnerships and trade.

ambiguity: Which houses carry one planet and which carry three is shown on screen and is not in the words.
classical_check: Parashari reading uses whole-sign or bhava chalit houses; KP cusps are a 20th-century system, so the D1-versus-KP difference is KP doctrine, not older text.

gist: Points at the screen: one house holds a single planet and another holds three; no rule is stated in the words.
Tells students to stop saying 'my Saturn sits here' because he has already had thousands of such questions in so many classes.

hindi: मेरा शनि बारवा है केतु मेरा छठा है भाई वो नहीं है वो वहां नहीं है जहा तुम्हें दिखाया जा रहा है
says: Answering people who say 'my Saturn is in the 12th, my Ketu in the 6th', he says the planet is not actually there; the house shown by the ordinary chart is not where it really acts, so such quoted placements are wrong.
cells_derived_method: The shown house is only the whole-sign D1 house. If bhava chalit or KP cusps move a planet one house forward or back, its topic changes: a Saturn shown in the 12th (loss, foreign, sleep) could really act in the 11th (gains) or the 1st (self); a Ketu shown in the 6th (enemies, debts, health) could act in the 5th or 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries) reads as expense and isolation in D1; if the cusp view moves it into the 11th, the same Saturn works as slow, steady gain.
Derived: Ketu in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini) reads as cutting off enemies and debts; if it really sits in the 7th by cusp, the same Ketu detaches from partner and business dealings instead.

ambiguity: He does not say here which system shows the true house; later talk points to KP and bhava chalit cusps.
classical_check: Partly agrees: bhava chalit is classical and does shift planets across houses; no classical text calls the whole-sign house wrong, they use both views.

hindi: इसलिए ा प अंधा बिकता है छठे राहु के लिए ये करें पांचवा मंगल के लिए वो करें उससे फलित नहीं होता
says: He says the remedy lists that sell blindly, such as 'do this for Rahu in the 6th' or 'do that for Mars in the 5th', do not produce results, because the planets are not really in those houses; a remedy built on a wrongly read house fails.
cells_derived_method: Popular remedy tables are keyed by planet and shown house only. If the effective house differs, the correct remedy follows the effective house topic: a Rahu working in the 5th (children, mantra, intelligence) needs a different fix than Rahu in the 6th (enemies, debt); Mars in the 5th differs from Mars in the 4th (home, mother).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo): the table remedy targets enemy and debt trouble, but if the cusp puts it in the 5th the real issue is children or study and the enemy remedy is misdirected.
Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 5th (lagna Cancer): the table gives a remedy for children and intellect; if the effective house is the 4th, home and mother matter more and the remedy misses.

ambiguity: 'अंधा बिकता है' is garbled; read here as 'sold blindly'.
classical_check: House-wise planet remedy tables are mostly Lal Kitab and modern popular practice; classical Parashari remedies are keyed by planet and dasha, so this critique hits the popular tables.

gist: Says those who sell such remedy videos only collect hits and fifteen ads in each class.
Says people will accept his method only when it tells their own life correctly; that is what students are here to learn.
Says he is still learning too; the subject is so vast it is an intoxication, and he studies in it for 24 hours.
Opening words are garbled; the rest says there is so much to learn and to know.
Says so many videos and people press him to teach and ask the fee; he replies free, because he has no time.
A channel invited him to their Noida studio and said he would become famous; he refused because he has no time.
Says fame is pointless: even if a lakh, then ten lakh, then a crore people know you, what do you gain.
Asks what the aim of life is and calls those who aim at fame fools; then asks if the aim is to earn money (finishes in the next chunk).
Says money will come anyway if it is in one's destiny, so it is not a real life goal.
Asks again what the aim of life is and says that unless one sets an aim, the aim by default is death.
Garbled line about 'my kid's aim' of completing prarabdha and wiping someone off the earth; cannot tell what is meant.
Says the real aim is to ask what karma to do, what energy, peace and joy to take; calls this only verbal talk.
Fifteen years ago people pushed him into becoming an astrologer before he even had a beard or moustache.
People came calling him dada ji and asking him to see a horoscope; he told them he is only an uncle and did nothing himself, it is the grace of a past life.
Says he has not studied, only writes; the skill is not his own but came free as prasad through his parents' grace, so students should not over-strain.
Jokes that parents are kept for earning blessings, to be milked of their blessings before they go.

hindi: लेकिन ताकत क्या सीखनी है उनका आशीर्वाद लेना पित्रों की कृपा लेना इसी में टाइम लगाओ
says: He advises that the real strength to learn is getting the blessings of parents and the grace of ancestors (pitras), and that students should spend their time on this rather than on technique alone.
cells_derived_method: none; the sentence is not house or sign dependent. Classically ancestors and father link to the 9th house and Sun, but he does not say so here.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical pitru-dosha and parental-service remedies (9th house, Sun); silent on any specific rule.

gist: Says parents leave behind so much and give it to their children free of charge.
Jokes that when students become parents they would give to him too and he would be happy, but they should give to their own children, deserving or not.
Says whether the children did anything for you or not, you still give; therefore do this work.

hindi: यह कुंडलियां समझो कौन कहां बैठा है
says: He tells students to study these charts carefully and know exactly which planet sits where, treating accurate placement as the first skill before any remedy or prediction.
cells_derived_method: none; the sentence is an instruction to read placement correctly and does not depend on a house or sign.
ambiguity: Could be only a call to look carefully, not a rule; kept as a low-weight principle.
classical_check: Classical texts agree that correct planet placement is the base of every reading; nothing specific is stated here.

hindi: अब इसमें लाल किताब की खिचड़ी और घुमानी पड़ेगी
says: He says his method now needs Lal Kitab ideas mixed into the standard chart reading, like stirring one more ingredient into a khichdi.
cells_derived_method: none as stated; Lal Kitab judges mainly by house rather than sign, which leads into the next sentence about a house overriding a planet's sign strength.
ambiguity: He does not say which Lal Kitab rule he means.
classical_check: Lal Kitab is a separate 20th-century system with house-based results, debts (rin) and its own remedies; Parashari texts do not mix it in, so this is his own blend.

hindi: ऐसा हो सकता है ग्रह उच्च का दिख रहा है लेकिन अपने भाव के कारण वो नीच काम कर रहा है फिर बड़े बड़े जोशी फेल हो जाते हैं उसके अंदर
says: A planet can look exalted by sign yet behave like a debilitated one because of the house (bhava) it effectively sits in; astrologers who judge only by sign dignity then go wrong, even senior ones.
cells_derived_method: Sign dignity (exalted) and house result are two separate layers. Where the effective house is a dusthana (6, 8, 12) or works against the planet's own significations, exaltation is cancelled in results; where it is a kendra or trikona it holds. So judge sign strength and house strength together.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra) looks strong by sign, but the 8th brings emotional upheaval and secrecy, so it can act like a weak Moon.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 12th (lagna Taurus) has full sign strength, but the 12th drains status and father-linked support, so recognition comes late or abroad.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 6th (lagna Aquarius) gives strong advice and wisdom, but the 6th turns the gift towards debts, disputes and service work.

ambiguity: 'अपने भाव के कारण' could mean the house in the printed chart or the effective house after a cusp shift.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts weigh bhava placement (dusthana versus kendra) beside sign dignity, though not as a fixed rule that exaltation turns into debilitation.

gist: People tell him their chart has rajyoga yet he says they will struggle; he jokes he will refund their money and they can go struggle elsewhere.

hindi: जो बता रहे उसको समझो प्रत्यक्ष को जानो सपनों में मत रहो आपके जीवन में प्रत्यक्ष में क्या हो रहा है
says: He tells people to check a reading against what is visibly happening in their life now and not to cling to promised yogas like rajyoga; a chart reading counts as true only when it matches events.
cells_derived_method: none; a verification principle that is not house or sign dependent.
classical_check: Classical texts expect yoga results to be tested against strength and dasha; the verify-with-life stance is a method point and is silent in the classics.

hindi: जोथी दो मिनट में टेस्ट होता है उसके सामने बैठे व आपको रामायण बता देगा कि भैया यह हुआ चार बातें टैली हो गई हो गया नहीं तो आपके बारे में कैसे वो बता सकता है
says: He says an astrologer can be tested within two minutes: he should narrate your past events, and if about four of them tally he is credible; otherwise he cannot be trusted to speak about your future.
cells_derived_method: none; a test of the astrologer, not a house or sign rule.
ambiguity: The first word 'जोथी' is a garbled 'jyotishi'; the sentence runs across two caption chunks.
classical_check: Classical texts do not give this test, though checking a birth time against past events (rectification) is a standard classical practice.

gist: Says they will take up Saturn next, but there is no time today.

hindi: क्या आप पतरी देख के तिल बता सकते हो बंदे के रे य तिल है
says: He asks whether a chart can be used to tell the exact moles on a person's body, implying that a good reading can name them and that this is another way to check an astrologer.
cells_derived_method: none here; the house-to-body-part mapping is used in the next mole row.
ambiguity: A rhetorical question; no method is stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Parashari texts mention marks and scars only in passing; the main source for body moles is Samudrika Shastra, so this is only partly classical.

gist: Parrot joke: the client's 'parrots fly away' in shock when you name his mole, he goes to the market for four more, and they fly off again when you name his injury; he will have no choice but to become a devotee.
Says this is a study that has to be known.

hindi: राहु शनि ये तिल देते हैं केतू तिल देता है
says: He names Rahu and Saturn as givers of moles, and Ketu as also giving moles; these three planets are the body-mark indicators.
cells_derived_method: The planet says what kind of mark and the house says where on the body, with the sign refining the region: Rahu and Saturn suggest dark marks, Ketu a small spot or scar-like mark. Location follows the house body part (3rd arms, 6th waist, 12th feet) and the sign's body part.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd (lagna Aries): a dark mole on the arm, shoulder or hand, since both the 3rd house and Gemini point there.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo): a dark mark on the waist or lower abdomen from the 6th, with the knee area from Capricorn as a second place.
Derived: Ketu in Aquarius in the 12th (lagna Pisces): a small spot or scar on the foot or ankle, since the 12th house and Aquarius both point to the lower leg and foot.

ambiguity: He does not say how Ketu's moles differ from those of Rahu and Saturn (colour, size).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn and Rahu are classical karakas for dark marks and Ketu for marks and scars, but the main text for body moles is Samudrika Shastra, not Parashari.

gist: Says if you make a man count his own moles he faints, and calls it great fun.
Says astrology is a huge science and a matter of fun (caption word 'masi' is garbled).
Once an astrologer came to him with 500 horoscopes for his son; at that time he used to tell the bride's height.

hindi: मैंने कहा था 5 फुट दो से 3 इंच कुछ ऐसी बताए मुझे याद नहीं इतनी हाइट की लड़की मिलेगी इतने किलो की वो आके चरण छलिए मेरे दो साल के बाद और लेकर आया किय बहन मिली है मैंने तो उतनी है
says: He claims he once told that astrologer his son's bride would be about 5 ft 2 to 3 inches tall and of a stated weight, and two years later the father came back, touched his feet and said the girl he found matched exactly; no method for reading a spouse's build is given.
cells_derived_method: none; it is an anecdote with no method. Classically a spouse's looks come from the 7th house, its sign and lord, and Venus, but he does not say so here.
ambiguity: The numbers in the caption are unreliable (height range and weight are garbled), and the sentence runs across two caption chunks.
classical_check: Classical texts describe the spouse's looks through the 7th house, its lord and Venus but give no height or weight figures; this is his own claim.

gist: Says that sometimes when his mind races he tells such details.
Gives sample predictions such as 'your payment is stuck, you will get a cheque and not cash' and says it is not he who tells this but the divine, by grace.

hindi: के पीछे आपके पांचवे दव पांचवे और नव घर का खेल होता है
says: He says the insight and grace behind such accurate telling comes from the play of the 5th and 9th houses; the intuitive or blessed ability to know things is a 5th and 9th house matter.
cells_derived_method: The 5th (past merit, mantra, intuition) and the 9th (dharma, guru, blessings, fortune) are trikona houses; the sign on them sets the flavour: fire signs give direct, confident insight, water signs feeling-based insight, air signs reasoned insight, earth signs practical, tested insight. Planets in these houses and their lords add to or reduce it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 5th (lagna Cancer) points to deep, hidden or occult-type intuition and research ability.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (lagna Aries), its natural 9th sign, gives strong dharma, guru grace and faith-based insight.
Derived: Virgo on the 9th (lagna Capricorn) gives grace through analysis and service; knowing arrives by careful study rather than sudden inspiration.

ambiguity: 'पांचवे दव पांचवे' is garbled; read as the 5th and the 9th, the 9th being named afterwards as 'nav ghar'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th and 9th are the trikona houses of purva-punya, mantra, guru and fortune, and tradition links intuition and grace to them.

gist: Housekeeping: says he will first take the distracting questions, there are very many, there will be a shortage of time, and he will take as many as he can.
First audience question: if a planet in the 9th house is retrograde and in its own sign, can its deity be worshipped or its stone worn.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस में अगर आपका देव ग्रह रेट्रोग्रेड है अपनी राशि का तो पहली बात तो वह अपनी राशि का है भी कि नहीं क्योंकि व बैठा है कि नहीं बैठा
says: Answering the question on a retrograde 9th-house planet in its own sign, his first check is whether it is really in its own sign at all, because the planet may not actually be sitting where the printed chart shows it.
cells_derived_method: Own-sign strength depends on the true sign position, which can shift when houses are multi-sign or when a planet sits near a sign border. Own signs: Sun Leo; Moon Cancer; Mars Aries and Scorpio; Mercury Gemini and Virgo; Jupiter Sagittarius and Pisces; Venus Taurus and Libra; Saturn Capricorn and Aquarius. A planet shown in its own sign in the 9th must be re-checked against its effective sign before the own-sign result is used.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries) looks like own-sign dharma strength; if its effective position is across the border in Scorpio, the own-sign claim should be dropped.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius in the 9th (lagna Gemini) gives disciplined fortune only if it truly stays in Aquarius; near the Pisces border it would be read in Jupiter's sign instead.
Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces) counts as own-sign fighting strength for father and fortune matters only if the effective sign is still Scorpio and not Libra.

ambiguity: 'देव ग्रह' is unclear; it may mean a benefic planet or the planet of one's worship, and the questioner's planet is not named.
classical_check: Classical texts accept own-sign dignity from the printed sign; his demand to re-verify the true placement is his own multi-sign view, partly matching sign-border (sandhi) and bhava chalit practice.

hindi: दूसरी बात वो राशि भी वहां है कि नहीं
says: His second check is whether the sign supposed to be on that house is actually present there at all; in some charts the sign you assume for a house is missing or replaced by another.
cells_derived_method: If the sign is absent from the house, own-sign or exaltation rules tied to that sign do not fire for a planet there. In an unequal-house chart a sign can be skipped between two cusps and another sign repeated, so a planet in that house takes on the repeated sign's nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter placed in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) would be exalted only if Cancer is really present on that house; if the cusp sequence skips Cancer, the exaltation does not apply.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) counts as own sign only if Pisces is really on that house; if a neighbouring sign is repeated instead, its lord's nature colours the 9th.

ambiguity: He does not say here which system drops the sign; the next rows show it is the cusp sequence.
classical_check: Silent in classical whole-sign reading, where every sign is always present as exactly one house; a missing sign can arise only in unequal-house systems such as Placidus or KP. It fits the multi-sign house idea.

hindi: अभी हमने वो कुंडली नहीं देखी जिसमें राशि भी मव एक राशि गायब है मूव नहीं हुई राशि गायब
says: He says we have not yet looked at the kind of chart in which a whole sign is missing from the house sequence, a sign that has not moved into any house, so the chart runs on eleven signs.
cells_derived_method: In a whole-sign chart all twelve signs appear once, so a missing sign occurs only when house boundaries are set by cusps and a sign falls wholly inside one house. A planet in the missing sign has no house of its own to deliver through. Which sign goes missing depends on the lagna and cusp degrees.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with lagna Virgo and a late-degree rising point, Taurus on the 9th could be swallowed inside the neighbouring house and never open a house of its own.
Derived: with lagna Libra, Capricorn on the 4th could be skipped between cusps, leaving home, mother and property themes without their own sign.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('राशि भी मव'); the missing sign is not named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari whole-sign reading; in Placidus and KP a sign can be intercepted, which matches the idea, though he calls it missing and not intercepted. It also fits the multi-sign house view.

hindi: ब दो नंबर की राशि काम ही नहीं कर रही अब बताओ
says: In the chart he is describing, sign number 2 (Taurus) is not working at all, so whatever sits in that sign gives no result; he then asks the audience what answer is possible for the retrograde-planet question in that case.
cells_derived_method: A deactivated sign gives no result for planets placed in it. Taurus is Venus's sign and the Moon's exaltation sign, so Venus and Moon matters (money, comfort, mind) suffer most; the house topic carried by the sign loses its sign support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with lagna Virgo, a deactivated Taurus on the 9th mutes fortune and father themes even if good planets sit there.
Derived: with lagna Aries, Taurus is the 2nd house itself; if it is deactivated, wealth, speech and family themes lose their natural sign support.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' is read as sign number 2 (Taurus) because the next sentence puts the exalted Moon there; it could be house 2 in isolation.
classical_check: Not a classical Parashari rule; it is his own doctrine. Western astrology reads an intercepted sign as muted, which is similar but not the same.

hindi: नौवे घर में उच्च का ग्रह बैठा हुआ है चंद्रमा और दिख तो रहा बंदा कंगला है क्योंकि दो नंबर की राशि डी एक्टिवेटेड है
says: Example chart: the Moon sits exalted in the 9th house, which should make the person rich and fortunate, yet he is a pauper because sign 2 (Taurus, the Moon's exaltation sign) is deactivated in that chart; exaltation gives nothing if its sign is dead.
cells_derived_method: The same logic holds for any exalted planet: exaltation pays only if its sign is active as a house sign in the chart. If the exaltation sign is dead, the exaltation exists only on paper.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) would fail the same way if Cancer were the dead sign; luck and guru grace stay on paper.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) promises fortune through love, arts and a spiritual path, but a deactivated Pisces would leave it unpaid.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 9th (lagna Capricorn) promises fortune through intellect and trade, but a dead Virgo would leave the promise unfulfilled.

ambiguity: The chart's lagna is not stated; the cell Taurus in the 9th is deduced from the Moon being exalted in the 9th house.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat an exalted planet in the 9th as very auspicious and do not cancel it for a missing sign; this is his own rule.

hindi: कुंडली में एक नंबर के बाद सीधी तीन नंबर आ गए और वो तीन नंबर दो घर में रिपीट हो गई उसका क्या करोगे
says: He describes a sign sequence on the house cusps that runs 1 and then straight to 3, with sign 2 skipped, and sign 3 then repeating in two consecutive houses; he asks what you would do with such a chart.
cells_derived_method: On unequal-house cusps, if one cusp is late Aries and the next is early Gemini, Taurus lies wholly inside the first house and is skipped; if the following cusp is also Gemini, Gemini repeats on two houses, so both houses carry Gemini's nature and Mercury colours two topics together.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: with lagna Libra, a planet in Gemini in the 9th where Gemini also holds the next cusp gets dharma and career themes both flavoured by Mercury's speech-and-trade nature.
Derived: with lagna Virgo, a planet in Gemini in the 10th with Taurus skipped just before it reads career through Mercury only, and Venus's Taurus themes of steady wealth add nothing.

ambiguity: The numbers could be house numbers or sign numbers; he used sign numbers in the previous sentence (the Moon exalted in sign 2), so sign numbers are assumed.
classical_check: Matches how unequal-house (Placidus, KP) cusps behave at some latitudes and times, with intercepted and repeated signs; Parashari whole-sign reading never shows it.

hindi: ये बहुत ये हर केस पूरा देखना पड़ता जैसे वास्तु में पूरा नक्शा चाहिए मेरे उत्तर दिशा में यह है अब क्या बताए
says: He says every case must be studied as a whole, just as vastu needs the full floor plan: if someone says only 'in my north direction this is there', nothing can be told; the same holds for a chart, where one planet or one house alone is not enough.
cells_derived_method: none; a whole-chart principle that is not house or sign dependent. It carries a vastu link: one direction cannot be judged without the full plan.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts say to judge the chart as a whole (lagna, lords, aspects, dasha), and vastu texts need the full plan.

gist: Analogy: a doctor asks for a full blood report and patients often swear at him.
Analogy continued: people take whatever reports and then an MRI, nothing shows; he says it is only because nothing showed that you know, otherwise you would be gone too.

hindi: इसलिए ऐसा बैठा तो रेट्रोग्रेड प्लेनेट अगर उच्च का भी बैठा है नौवे में तो भी अगर कुंडली लाव करती है स्टोन
says: His conclusion on the first question: even if a retrograde planet sits exalted in the 9th house, a stone can be worn only if the whole chart allows it; the decision follows the full chart, not the retrograde or exalted label alone.
cells_derived_method: Gemstone permission depends on the planet's role for the lagna, not on its dignity alone: the usual rule avoids strengthening lords of 6, 8 and 12 and maraka lords. Retrograde exalted planets in the 9th then differ by lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted and retrograde in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) rules the 2nd and 5th, so the stone case looks open, still to be checked against dasha and other factors.
Derived: Mars exalted and retrograde in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) rules the 7th and 12th, so coral is normally not advised despite the exaltation.
Derived: Mercury exalted and retrograde in Virgo in the 9th (lagna Capricorn) rules the 6th and 9th, a mixed case that needs caution before any emerald is worn.

ambiguity: 'लाव करती' is read as 'allow karti'; he gives no explicit gemstone rule beyond the whole-chart condition.
classical_check: Agrees with classical gemstone practice of deciding by lordship and chart strength rather than dignity alone; silent on the retrograde point.

gist: Audience question: when planets turn retrograde in the sky, does it affect everyone or only people who had that planet retrograde at birth.

hindi: सारी दुनिया के लिए वक्री वन शॉट वक्री
says: His answer: when a planet turns retrograde in the sky it is retrograde for the whole world at once, in one shot, not only for those born with that planet retrograde.
cells_derived_method: The retrograde phase is the same in time for everyone; what differs per person is the house and sign it passes through from their lagna, so the same event touches different topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet retrograde in Pisces falls in the 12th for lagna Aries, so expense, foreign and sleep topics are stirred.
Derived: the same retrograde in Pisces falls in the 6th for lagna Libra, so debts, work and health routine are stirred.
Derived: the same retrograde in Pisces falls in the 7th for lagna Virgo, so partnership and marriage topics are stirred.

ambiguity: The answer may continue past this chunk; he does not say whether the strength of the effect is equal for all or only the state is shared.
classical_check: Agrees astronomically: retrograde is an apparent motion seen from Earth and is the same for all; classical gochar then reads its effect per natal chart from the Moon or lagna.

gist: Repeats that a retrograde is universal: retrograde for the whole earth at once, as already said in the previous answer.

hindi: जिस जिसकी कुंडली में जैसा जैसा है जिस जिस राशि में जिस जिस डिग्री का है उस उस हिसाब से काम करेगा जिस जिस कॉमिनेशन में यह सबके अलग है टस के भी अलग है
says: He says that although a retrograde phase is the same for everyone, its effect works according to each person's own chart, meaning the sign, the degree and the combination the planet is in; so it differs for every person, even for twins.
cells_derived_method: The same retrograde planet falls in a different house from each lagna, and the sign nature, degree and combination add to it, so one event in the sky gives a different reading in each chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a retrograde planet in Gemini falls in the 3rd for lagna Aries, so effort, courage and siblings are stirred.
Derived: the same retrograde in Gemini falls in the 9th for lagna Libra, so fortune, father and dharma topics are stirred.
Derived: the same retrograde in Gemini falls in the 7th for lagna Sagittarius, so partnership and marriage topics are stirred.

ambiguity: 'टस' is read as 'twins'; the degree he mentions probably points to the position inside the sign, near or far from a border.
classical_check: Agrees: classical gochar is read per natal chart (house from lagna or Moon, sign and degree), and the twins point matches the need for the exact birth time.

gist: Audience question: if a number is missing in someone's Lo Shu grid but the matching planet is well placed in the kundali, should he still do that planet's remedy, when numerology suggests a remedy and astrology says all is fine.

hindi: एस्ट्रोलॉजी के अकॉर्डिंग रेमेडी बिल्कुल बढ़िया गई न्यूरोलॉजी न्यूरोलॉजी का बाप है एस्ट्रोलॉजी इसी से निकला है सब
says: His answer to the Lo Shu question: when numerology and the chart disagree, go by the chart, because astrology is the parent of numerology and all of it came out of astrology; a missing Lo Shu number needs no remedy if the planet is well placed in the kundali.
cells_derived_method: none; the sentence is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: 'न्यूरोलॉजी' in the caption means numerology; the meaning of 'गई' (numerology goes out of the window) is inferred from context.
classical_check: Not classical: the Lo Shu grid is a Chinese magic-square tradition and modern numerology is separate from Parashari Jyotish; the claim that numerology came out of astrology is his own view.

gist: Sets up the example: among the numbers one to five, if your number is 1, everyone says numerology calls it the best.

hindi: और वो एक नंबर ही आठवें घर में बैठा खराब तो आपके लिए नहीं है क्योंकि आठवें घर में मृत्यु न में बैठ गया वो
says: He says a number that numerology praises, such as 1, is not good for you if the planet behind that number sits in your 8th house, the house of death and loss; the house result overrides the numerology label.
cells_derived_method: The 8th house (obstacles, sudden change, crisis) turns a planet that numerology calls favourable into an unfavourable one for that person. The sign then sets how hard the harm is: in a friend's or own sign it is milder, in an enemy's or debilitation sign worse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Sagittarius in the 8th (lagna Taurus) is in Jupiter's friendly sign, so number 1 is damped rather than destroyed.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 8th (lagna Capricorn) is in its own sign and strong in itself, yet the 8th still delays the gifts of authority until after a crisis.

ambiguity: He says 'number 1' and 'राशि' loosely; number 1 is assumed to be the Sun by the numerology convention, though it could mean sign number 1 (Aries, Mars).
classical_check: Numerology's planet-number link is not Parashari. The idea that the 8th house weakens a planet's good results agrees with the classical view of the 8th as a dusthana.

hindi: और वहां पर बैठा मान लो शनि तो आपका अगर एक नंबर रूलिंग प्लेनेट होगा तो एक नंबर उठा देगा वो आपके लिए
says: He adds that if Saturn also sits in that 8th house, then for a person whose ruling planet is number 1, Saturn will uproot number 1 for him; the second planet in the 8th removes the first one's support.
cells_derived_method: The conjunction in the 8th is read by the relative strength of the two planets in that sign: the one stronger by sign dignity dominates the other.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Saturn together in Libra in the 8th (lagna Pisces). Saturn is exalted here. The Sun is debilitated here. Saturn overpowers number 1 most strongly.
Derived: Sun and Saturn together in Aquarius in the 8th (lagna Cancer). Saturn is in its own sign and the Sun is in an enemy's sign, so Saturn still dominates but less completely.

ambiguity: Number 1 is assumed to be the Sun; the verb 'उठा देगा' is read as 'will remove or ruin'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a malefic like Saturn joining a planet in the 8th is a classical weakening, but the numerology link is not Parashari.

hindi: सब्जेक्टिव याद रखो न्यूरोलॉजी एक यूनिवर्सल प्रिंसिपल है एस्ट्रोलॉजी सब्जेक्टिव है सिर्फ एक व्यक्ति का एक प्रिंसिपल है वो दूसरे का है ही नहीं जितने लोग उतने प्रिंसिपल बनते
says: He says to remember that numerology is a universal principle while astrology is subjective: a chart principle belongs to one person only and does not apply to another, so there are as many principles as there are people.
cells_derived_method: none; a method-level principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across two caption chunks.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that each chart is read as a whole for its own native; numerology, which uses name or date numbers, is the more generic system.

hindi: जितने लोग उतने प्रिंसिपल जत पिंडे तत ब्रह्मांडे इसलिए एस्ट्रोलॉजी बाप है इसका
says: He quotes 'as in the body, so in the cosmos' (yat pinde tat brahmande): each person is a cosmos of his own and so carries a separate principle, which is why astrology, being personal, is the parent of numerology.
cells_derived_method: none; a philosophical principle, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The caption 'जत पिंडे तत ब्रह्मांडे' is read as the Sanskrit maxim 'yat pinde tat brahmande'.
classical_check: The maxim is a standard Vedic and Tantric statement of microcosm and macrocosm; using it to rank astrology above numerology is his own step.

gist: Says that in numerology they call number five very grand and very good.
Garbled digits and words about the Lo Shu square (492, 36) with a remark that astrology is its father; cannot tell what he claims.
Announces that he will now talk about the Lo Shu grid.
Says the Lo Shu grid can be learned in seven to ten sittings and then it is finished (opening words garbled).
Jokes that the subject will drive you mad, and that while explaining he does not realise how much nonsense he can talk because it is so vast.
Says Lo Shu has only a few boxes to explain and then the job is done, after which one can keep making combinations and write any number of books.
Audience question: a person donates clothes, new or old; does that not suit him; and if his Venus placement is linked to a house (the number is garbled) while he donates Venus items, what follows.

hindi: नुकसान होगा इसलिए कपड़े दान करें नहीं पैसे ले ले उससे काम वाले को दे रहे हैं एक रप ले लो
says: Answering the clothes question, he says that if Venus is tied to that house in the chart and the person donates clothes, a Venus item, he will lose; so clothes should not be given free but sold for a token payment, even one rupee when given to a worker.
cells_derived_method: Whether giving away a planet's items hurts depends on how well that planet sits. By his logic a well-placed Venus is weakened by free donation of its things, while an afflicted Venus in a dusthana or in debilitation is not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) is in its own sign and in a kendra, so by his logic giving clothes away free would weaken it.
Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) is exalted and in a kendra, so the same caution applies.
Derived: Venus in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) is debilitated and in a dusthana, so the caution does not apply and donation might even relieve it.

ambiguity: The house number in the question is garbled (perhaps the 12th) and the question and answer run across two caption chunks; it is not clear if the rule is limited to Venus tied to that one house.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with Lal Kitab-style advice not to give away items of a strong planet; the one-rupee token-payment device is not found in classical texts.

hindi: आपका चंद्रमा उचका है और आप चांदी बांटते फिर रहे हो आप कंग हो जाओ
says: He says that if your Moon is high (strong) and you keep distributing silver, a Moon item, you will become a pauper; do not give away items of a planet that is your strength.
cells_derived_method: The Moon is strongest in Taurus (exalted) and Cancer (own sign) and in kendra or trikona houses; there, giving away silver or white items weakens it by his logic. In Scorpio (debilitated) or in the 6th, 8th or 12th the same donation would be relief rather than loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries) is in its own sign and a kendra; freely giving away silver or milk would drain peace and money by his logic.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 1st (lagna Taurus) is exalted in the lagna; he would say do not give away silver, since it is the person's main strength.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) is debilitated and in a dusthana; here a silver donation fits the usual dana advice for a weak Moon.

ambiguity: 'उचका' is read as 'raised' meaning strong or exalted; 'कंग' is a garbled 'kangal' (pauper).
classical_check: Differs from the common practice of donating silver for the Moon in general; agrees with the Lal Kitab caution against giving away items of a strong planet.

hindi: आप कह रहे हो लोगों को खाना खिला रहे हैं आप शुक्र बांट रहे हो पैसे लो एक रप ले लो आपका ग्रह डाउन हो जाएगा
says: When someone says he feeds people as charity, he says that is giving away Venus; take payment, even one rupee, or your planet goes down; a free gift of a strong planet's thing weakens it, a token sale does not.
cells_derived_method: none beyond the previous two rows; the same logic applies whenever Venus is the strong planet.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether all food counts as a Venus item or only rich or sweet food.
classical_check: Venus as the karaka of food and comforts is traditional; the one-rupee payment is not classical.

gist: Audience question: when a baby is born and we give someone's jootha (leftover food), and given what was said earlier about giving or not giving jootha, should it be given to the child.

hindi: फिर बच्चे को हम झूठ नहीं देते किसी के हाथ से पहली बार खिलाते हैं झूठ नहीं देते झूठे की तो कोई बात ही नहीं बच्चे को किसी व्यक्ति के हाथ से देते ताकि उसके गुण उसम आ
says: He says a newborn is not given anyone's leftover food; the first feeding is done from the hand of a chosen person so that the feeder's qualities pass into the child, and leftovers do not come into it at all.
cells_derived_method: none; the sentence is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in a garbled phrase about taking leftover ('ठे का कोई ले नहीं'); it is read as 'no question of taking leftover'.
classical_check: Annaprashana (first grain feeding) is a classical samskara; the idea that the feeder's qualities pass to the child is a folk belief and is not in the Jyotish texts.

gist: Audience question: if one marries a Mangalik, will his Mangal dosha harm us.

hindi: मंगल के दोष या किसी प्रकार के शादी से संबंधित दोष के लिए अगर किसी व्यक्ति का शादी से पहले भी कहीं सेक्सुअल रिलेशन हो लेता है या बाद में तो भी ग्रह हल्के पड़ जाते हैं
says: He calls it very controversial but says that for Mars dosha or any marriage-related dosha, if the person has a sexual relationship somewhere, before or after marriage, the planets get lighter and the dosha weakens.
cells_derived_method: Mars dosha is read from Mars in the 1st, 2nd (south Indian), 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th; his claim lightens it for any of these. How heavy it is before lightening depends on the sign: Mars in an own or exalted sign is softer, in debilitation heavier.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) is exalted and is one of the classical cancellation cases, so his lightening would add little here.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo) is in its own sign, which tends to soften the dosha already.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries) is debilitated and the dosha stands heavy, so his claim of lightening would matter most here.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across two caption chunks, and it is not clear whether he endorses the claim or only reports it; he calls it controversial and says society will not accept it.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; classical cancellation (bhanga) of Mangal dosha works by sign, aspects and the partner's own Mars, not by relationships.

gist: Asks who in society will accept such a thing and calls it a strange matter.

hindi: क्योंकि प्लेनेट को सब्सिडाइज करना बहुत जरूरी है नहीं तो व आपको खा जाएगा नहीं तो अब आपको खा जाएगा
says: He gives the reason behind that claim: a strong planet has to be subsided or satisfied through its natural expression, otherwise it will eat the person; the dosha planet's energy needs an outlet.
cells_derived_method: none; the sentence is not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The planet is not named in this sentence; Mars is assumed from the Mangal dosha context.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; it resembles the remedy logic of channelling a planet's energy, which is found in Lal Kitab and tantric practice.

hindi: और मंगली व्यक्ति अगर नहीं है तो डेंजरस है उस शादी में झंझट तो आएगा अब नहीं आएगा तो कभी तो आएगा
says: He says that if the partner of a Mangalik is not Mangalik, the match is dangerous: trouble will come in that marriage, if not now then some day.
cells_derived_method: Mangalik status comes from Mars in the 1st, 2nd (south Indian), 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th; matching is done by comparing both charts' Mars cells, so the sign of Mars decides how strong the dosha is that the partner must balance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) makes the person Mangalik; a non-Mangalik partner would, by his rule, face trouble in the marriage.
Derived: Mars in Sagittarius in the 12th (lagna Capricorn) is Mangalik by the 12th only, a milder form in many traditions, so the warning would be weaker.

ambiguity: 'मंगली व्यक्ति अगर नहीं है' is read as the other partner not being Mangalik.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical matching rule that a Mangalik should marry a Mangalik or have a cancellation; 'will come some day' is his own emphasis.
